※ ※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※

Could this be called aerial warfare?

Reinhard had leapt toward Sirius, knocking his opponent from the tower and sending her flying through the sky. Touching down on the white walls of the clock tower, he flew off like a bullet by slightly bending and stretching his knees again.

Sirius: [Hahaha! Ah, how impressive you are!]

As the heroic figure flew toward her, she raised her voice, ecstatic, and waved her arms about. Accompanying that motion was the piercing whine of her chain unraveling from her wrist.

That fully extended chain could now be used as a whip, although its merit as a weapon relied more in its intimidating appearance and violent sound, rather than convenience. Only a deviant with no common sense would opt for such a weapon.

That iron snake had undoubtedly tasted the blood of more than just a few people, and, at this moment, it was partaking in one of its routine hunts. Attempting to crush its prey with its iron jaws, the whistling wind it created resembling applause.

But even that blunt snake, who could approach the speed of sound, was clueless.

——In this world, there was a human existence as departed from common sense as Sirius, albeit in a different manner.

Reinhard: [A chain, how troublesome.]

Hearing the sound of the chain entering the fight, the Sword Saint frowned and gave a troubled mutter.

In the midst of such an intense battle, he seemed to be letting out a slight grievance that was better suited to the atmosphere of a mild annoyance in one’s daily life.

Sirius: [Hahaha!]

Sirius, on the verge of panting, revealed her passionate laugh to the spectators.

Surely, that was inevitable. However, the reasoning behind Sirius’s delight was mysterious. Whether it was because of desperation, or whether she was genuinely happy, that much was clear to all the spectators looking up at the scene, Subaru included.

This was a situation that only Sirius would have laughed in.

Reinhard: [————]

Sirius flew upwards, and Reinhard pursued her from below.

With Reinhard as her target, Sirius delivered a quick, precise blow, slamming the chains of both her arms. Even facing that oncoming chain, Reinhard did not reach for the sword hanging at his waist.

If his words from long before were true, it was not that he did not intend to draw his sword, it was that he was unable to. Reinhard’s legendary sword would only allow itself to face worthy opponents.

In that case, he had been condemned to be unarmed while fighting that horrible freak. Even Reinhard, who Subaru had the utmost trust in, would need to undergo a bitter struggle—— perhaps he would even fail to live up to Subaru’s expectations, in a show of human weakness.

If so, then that trust would soon be shattered.

Aiming a follow-up strike of her chains at Reinhard, a high-pitched noise echoed.

Shockwaves and sparks danced violently. To Subaru and the other spectators, lightning seemed to flash through the sky. The ability to accomplish that kind of witchcraft was precisely the proof that Reinhard transcended the boundaries of human skill.

Reinhard met the chain head on, lifting his slender right leg to defend.

That attack had been so surprising that it would have elicited a laugh from anyone. Right after the impact, Reinhard wrapped the chain around his foot with a turn of his ankle, moving it to suit his own will.

The movement itself had not been anything special. Reinhard had met the approaching chain with his right leg and wound it around his foot in a makeshift weapon, using it to open an immediate follow-up.

In only a moment, he had easily shifted from offense to defense.

Needless to say, not everyone could keep up with the fight. Among those present, only the handful of people with combat training could follow those rapid, continuous shifts between attacking and defending.

In that moment of understanding, there was an urge to laugh. Subaru gave a long sigh and relaxed his shoulders. Fortunately, Reinhard was a comrade, and Subaru had never been happier that he was on his side. If he were the enemy, then Subaru’s shoulders, knees, and bladder would have all given out.

Sirius: [Haha, hahaha! Aha, HAHAHAHA!!]

Sirius laughed loudly, her right arm spinning wildly like a tornado.

Since her left arm had been captured by Reinhard, she could only resort to the use of the right one. However, although the whistling snake tore through the sky, flying from every direction, it was blocked by the chain on Reinhard’s right foot, creating a high-pitched whine and a shower of sparks.

Every spark dancing in the blue sky, was accompanied by the sound of a metallic musical instrument that permeated the square, in a whirling performance of red and yellow.

A strike, another blow, but during that period, Reinhard had further closed the distance between himself and Sirius. Soon, after exchanging an array of blows, he reached her.

Sirius: [How unexpected! You’ve actually reached this point! Amazing!]

Reinhard: [You are very proficient. I find it a shame that you’ve committed yourself to evil.]

In those moments, the two exchanged words the way they exchanged attacks.

Reinhard quickly pulled back his right leg and thrusted his left hand with aligned fingers. Sirius greeted it with a powerful swing of her arm, the undulating chain diving at Reinhard with exposed fangs. And, although that chain was made of steel, Reinhard had used his own hand as a blade and cleaved it in two.

In the past, Subaru had witnessed the perfect splitting of disposable wooden chopsticks—— a party trick. If Reinhard were to partake in those performances, he could split a steel blade like paper. The fact his strike had had the beauty of a sword was enough reason to believe so.

The severed portion of the chain continued with the same momentum it had into the clocktower, the violent collision shattering one of the building’s walls. The sight of smoke and the rubble crashing into the square shook Subaru out of his trance.

He had been completely fascinated.

Reinhard and Sirius’s fight―― No, Reinhard’s fight, had entranced him. Whether it was envy or fear that had caused said fascination was another matter entirely.

Subaru: [Leaving her to Reinhard is fine. Then, I…!]

He could not continue to dawdle here, blindly ogling the fight and waiting for an outcome.

Subaru squeezed through a gap in the crowd, running to the opening of the tower. Now that Sirius’s attention was fully devoted to Reinhard, Lusbel, who had been prepared for her speech, had probably been abandoned in the clock tower.

Saving him would ease Subaru’s worries.

Just in case, so that if Sirius got away from Reinhard, Lusbel’s safety would be guaranteed. Subaru climbed anxiously up the spiral staircase, again tasting that dark, damp air.

The tower was much brighter now than it had been fifteen minutes ago, much thanks to the light flooding in from the walls broken by Sirius’s chain.

After safely ascending the spiral staircase, Subaru discovered Lusbel, bound in chains, on the top floor. He had been left face up on the ground, the floor wet by his incontinence. The child’s sobs touched Subaru deeply.

Subaru: [Lusbel! You’re safe now, don’t worry!]

Subaru tenderly took the chained Lusbel into his arms. He ignored the warm moisture as he saw Lusbel’s desperate, tearful gaze turning away from his own, terrified of Subaru’s face.

Lusbel: [Mmm!]

Subaru: [It’s alright, I’m on your side. And as for that monster, a reliable hero is fighting her right now. So, let’s take this time to get you out of here.]

Lusbel: [Mmm.]

Subaru spoke with the utmost sincerity. Gradually, Lusbel’s body lost its strength, abandoning his struggle, and he faced Subaru with a tearful but clear expression.

After Subaru nodded in response to that inquiring gaze, Lusbel began sobbing anew, for a different reason than before.

Subaru: [Wait a second. Let me get this off you.]

After gently stroking the crying boy’s head, Subaru started cautiously working on the chain as not to hurt him. From shoulders to ankles, the chain had been wound tightly, and he had also been gagged with it. Subaru took care to avoid hurting the child as he unraveled it.

Subaru: [Well, I got it off. Can you stand up? If not, I can carry you.]

Lusbel: [D-don’t worry, it’s… thank you… hk.]

Lusbel rose unsteadily to his feet, shaking his stiff legs, offering his gratitude. Although his face was stained with tears, he was still a strong child. Subaru patted his head again.

Then, as he turned his gaze to outside, where the violent offensive and defensive sounds were repeatedly triggered,

Subaru: [Staying here might actually be safer, but we should probably get out just in case. Can you walk? Are you hurt anywhere?]

Lusbel: [My right arm, just a little bit…]

Lusbel frowned and obediently presented his wound to Subaru.

On his outstretched right hand was a sharp laceration that had been made by a snake-like weapon. Its origin was clear. Seeing the blood oozing from the wound, Subaru contorted his face in discomfort.

Subaru: [Bastard, tying up such a small child, and even doing this to him.]

Lusbel: [No, no. This just suddenly… suddenly started hurting while I was tied up.]

Subaru: [Suddenly?]

“While he had been tied up”, Subaru registered distractedly.

At least, Subaru should not have hurt him in the process of unraveling the chain. His movements had been cautious, and Subaru would have noticed if he had caused Lusbel an injury this serious.

——Terrible, ominous apprehension rose in Subaru’s heart.

Subaru: […At any rate, we can’t stay here. Let’s go.]

Subaru took Lusbel’s uninjured left hand, running away. Leading him to the bottom of the spiral staircase, to the exit of the tower. And upon Subaru’s return to the square, he heard——

Crowd: [——Kill her! Kill her! Kill her! Kill her!]

The mob had plunged into a frenzy, eagerly awaiting the execution of that captured freak, calling for vindication. Eyes filled with bloodlust, mouths twisted in snarls, howling for murder.

Endless abhorrence of evil. Incredulous aversion to unnatural monsters. Wanting to be rid of an enemy who could not be accepted at a physiological level. Such negative emotions called for murder.

And what was this called?

——This was known as Wrath.

Crowd: [——Kill her! Kill her! Kill her! Kill her!]

A crowd of complete strangers stood side by side as comrades, moving toward the same goal.

Crowd: [——Kill her! Kill her! Kill her! Kill her!]

Their very hearts united in the face of adversity, and the philosophy of good and evil being questioned in those extraordinary circumstances.

Crowd: [——Kill her! Kill her! Kill her! Kill her!]

Choosing to be united in such extreme conditions, pushing that limit, that was——

Crowd: [——Kill her! Kill her! Kill her! Kill her!]

Sirius: [Joining feelings into one… this is surely Love, correct? Well, there is no doubt that this is a scene only Love could achieve, don’t you agree?]

In front of that hellish scenery, Sirius murmured in her usual voice.

Sirius had been pressed to the side of the clocktower by the hero. The surrounding crowd eagerly cheered for the death of that unnatural person, knowing that their Sword Saint had the power to kill the abomination.

Sirius even seemed to have lost the chain on her left hand, now in a precarious situation. With both hands unarmed, the monster had no way to defend against Reinhard’s knife-like hand.

She was clearly facing a dead-end—— however, Sirius wore her usual placid smile.

Reinhard: [Are there any last words you wish to say?]

Sirius: [Thank you. Then, allow me to offer you a piece of advice. The other Sin Archbishops may not be as docile as me, so if you wish to ask their last words, you might suffer for it.]

Reinhard: [——I will keep that in mind.]

In the face of Reinhard’s warm kindness, Sirius spoke calm, provocative words. Reinhard nodded in compliance and stepped forward, ready to execute her with the blade that was his hand.

Crowd: [——Kill her! Kill her! Kill her! Kill her!]

As the voice of the crowd grew in intensity, Sirius’s fate had been sealed. This was obvious, so why?

Standing at the entrance of the broken tower, Subaru felt a throbbing chill, which threatened to break his heart.

Why? What did that mean? He desperately wanted to speak, but his mouth could not move. Once it did, Subaru knew what he would say.

Subaru certainly would join the loud cries of “Kill her!”.

Sirius: [We know each other. Mutual humility. Mutual recognition. We forgive each other. That is exactly the correct form that Love should take.]

Subaru feeling subdued, Sirius continued to preach her rhetoric.

At first glance, she seemed to make sense, but taking into account that it was Sirius saying so, the proposition and the atmosphere itself became horrifying.

Reinhard: [————]

Reinhard seemed to have made the same judgment as Subaru.

There was no longer any meaning in letting Sirius speak, so Reinhard moved forward. However, just before Reinhard reached her, Sirius smiled and held her arms into the air.

Immediately, accompanied by a crackling sound, chains were ejected from the cuffs of her coat. Those chains were fired through her sleeves, and then wrapped around the tower as Sirius began to fly once more. She intended to escape—— but just before she could, Reinhard stomped on the ground. Shockwaves spread upward, like an explosion, and a red flame attacked Sirius.

His hand struck at her in a smooth, upward motion. A one-hit deathblow. In that moment, Sirius’s life would end.

Crowd: [——Kill her! Kill her! Kill her! Kill her!]

And the crowd’s cry, would be fulfilled.

With tremendous momentum, Subaru’s heart spiked with fear. And driven by a sudden impulse——

Subaru: [Reinhard!!]

Calling upon the hero’s name, Subaru yelled, guided by the impatience of the crowd.

Subaru: [——KILL HER!!]

Reinhard slashed.

A clean line swept neatly from Sirius’s left shoulder to her right flank.

That exquisite cut was so sharp, that even Sirius’s slashed body did not react to the slash for a few seconds. Finally, the blood in her body noticed the wound, and her body collapsed diagonally as blood began to spray.

Sirius: […Ah, this gentle world.]

Her internal organs spilling out, Sirius’s body was cleft in half.

Her upper body continued soaring upward, pouring blood and intestines through the air, while her lower body, left in place, became a fountain, sprinkling blood through the square.

A nightmarish spectacle had been propelled into the heavens above and the earth below, respectively.

No one could bear to look straight at that horror. However, no one looked away.

No one could look away.

Reinhard: […It cannot be.]

After landing, Reinhard uttered a stunned mutter.

Subaru saw that his blue eyes were shaking with grief, the shadow of despair enveloping his fair, handsome face.

——And then Subaru could see no more.

Subaru: [————]

Subaru, and the rest of the crowd, lay scattered in the square that had turned into a pool of blood. From their left shoulders to their right sides, everyone had been bisected, as clear as day.

Subaru: [————]

Blood and viscera spilling out, Subaru’s consciousness did not have time to understand what had happened before being pulled into the embrace of death. Just before that happened, he felt something else.

A boy’s left hand, whose owner had also been split in twain, squeezed Subaru’s own right hand tightly, seeking salvation from him.

It seemed like he had felt that somewhere before.

※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※

Liliana: [After the song ends and they chat again, shouldn’t we prepare food and drinks for them, Natsuki-sama? Indulging in sweet snacks will certainly create a mood that will close the distance between them, don’t you think so?]

Subaru: [——Ghk!]

Beatrice: [Ow! Ow, that hurts! It hurts in fact, Subaru!!]

Immediately after the blink, Subaru was surprised to hear the voice he had just heard.

The sudden switch in consciousness had him clinging to Beatrice’s hand with the same vice grip that he had been making before his Return by Death, strong enough to crush Appas. [1]

Beatrice tearfully kicked Subaru’s shin after suffering from that sudden atrocity, who recoiled in pain and loosened his grip on her hand.

Liliana: [W-w-w-why did you do that? Why would you attack Beatrice-sama’s lovely hands so suddenly? You’re going to ruin then… but it’s okay, I… I-I’ll kiss and lick them and to heal them, ha… haha.]

Beatrice: [It’s alright, I suppose! That’s quite gross, in fact!]

Beatrice flushed with panic as Liliana grabbed her hand, blushing and breathing heavily. She ducked behind Subaru. Even if he had injured her hand, her trust in her partner had not diminished.

Emilia: [Subaru, are you alright? Just now, you suddenly turned pale…]

Subaru: [E-Emilia-tan…]

Emilia joined his side, reaching a hand to his cheek, her face rife with concern. Subaru saw himself reflected in her amethyst eyes and breathed a sigh.

He had come back.

He patted his shoulders and chest, which had been bisected. His abdomen had been cut, and his head had been smashed. Although Subaru was confident in his experience with deaths, this had been his first clear experience of being slashed down. Taking precedence over pain was a sense of astonishment and loss, the knowledge of death tugging at Subaru’s soul. This was a death that Subaru, who was commonly subjected to them, could accept.

Subaru: [Why, can’t I find a simple conclusion…]

Once again catching up with the memories he had inherited, the realization of death assaulted him, forcing him to recognize it. Although he had not registered much pain, the sense of loss and shock hit Subaru one after the other. His partial understanding of the phenomenon grew, albeit not completely so. There remained an event beyond his understanding.

That is, this time, the cause of death——

Subaru: [Disgusting…]

Needless to say, he had long understood.

Subaru had been killed exactly the same way that Sirius had been, this time. To put it bluntly, Subaru had died in the exact same manner Sirius did. Looking back thirty minutes, to that first death, Subaru died shortly after joyfully witnessing Lusbel’s death. The previously unknown cause of death had now been identified.

——Somehow, someway, Sirius could deliver death to any who witnessed death.

Not just brainwashing with emotional changes. Even changes that occurred in the body could be shared. It was not merely brainwashing, but bodywashing. Or could it be called soulwashing?

In other words, killing her meant that the people in that square would all be killed.

Subaru: [What to do…?]

Defeating Sirius using brute force could be achieved by calling Reinhard.

However, that would come at the price of the life of everyone in that square. In that case, the result would be no different from Sirius’s intended atrocities.

Summoning Reinhard was nothing more than a correct and easy-to-understand solution at first glance, but it was, in actuality, the wrong answer. In this case, what could he do?

Subaru: [Call Reinhard, and tell him to take her alive…?]

That was unlikely, but perhaps not impossible to him.

Since Reinhard was capable of killing Sirius, he should also be capable of depriving her of her consciousness. The problem was that it was not clear if her mental control would end would her being caught alive.

Subaru had come in contact with Sirius and Lusbel, and had gone mad and died. If that mysterious madness continued to infect everyone, then capturing Sirius would be fruitless.

If she were killed, everyone else would die with her.

If she were caught, there was a possibility that she would spread her contagion of irresistible madness.

Just existing made her a threat to others, she was this kind of bomb-like existence. She truly deserved her title of Sin Archbishop.

Subaru: [What else can I do?]

Unable to find a breakthrough, Subaru found himself in a dilemma.

If Reinhard were called, he would surely be able to kill or restrain Sirius. Would that be okay, ignoring the possibility of falling into madness?

Subaru: [————]

Time passed even as Subaru pondered. Seeing Subaru staying quiet, those around him all appeared uneasy. Subaru did not want them to remain worried, nor to reveal what was going to happen.

He hurriedly changed the expression on his face and announced,

Subaru: [Ah, right. That is… Yes, I suddenly felt like I was going to puke up the daisukiyaki from this morning. My chest was a bit uncomfortable.]

Liliana: [Ah, I see, I see. I, too, often feel nauseous, which is accompanied by a lot of gas…]

Subaru: [Stop right there. No matter how you act, you’re still a girl.]

Subaru interrupted Liliana’s jokes with a smile and turned towards Emilia. Seeing that, Emilia lowered her gaze.

Emilia: [If Subaru says so, I’ll believe it… this is a special case, okay?]

Subaru: [Mhm, thanks… Then, I’ll go buy desserts, as Liliana suggested. Emilia-tan, please continue to enjoy the song.]

Thanks to Emilia’s kindness, Subaru was able to make an announcement after wavering. Then, holding Beatrice’s hand again,

Subaru: [Beako. Come shopping with me. Let’s take a walk and flirt like we always do.]

Beatrice: [What are you suddenly—— Mhm. Betty understands, in fact.]

Beatrice, whose face turned red, showing her tsun side, changed attitude upon seeing Subaru’s face, showing the dere side. To put it more appropriately, she accepted his offer after noticing his pleading expression.

Subaru took the confused Beatrice’s hand and ran from the park for the fourth time, pulling on her hand. This time, rather than leaving Beatrice behind, he would bring his reliable partner with him. Even though he had yet to reach any kind of breakthrough.

Priscilla: [——Hmm.]

——Staring at the retreating figures of Subaru and Beatrice, the woman of crimson watched the duo with a thoughtful expression.

Translation Notes:

[1] – Translated name for apple(s) in the Re: Zero world, “リンガ” (ringa). The Japanese itself is a mispronunciation of “林檎” (ringo).

[2] – Tsunderes are characters with a personality who is initially polarized, displaying cold, temperature and even hostile sides (the tsun part), before gradually showing a warmer, friendlier side over time (the dere part).

--- Chapter 23: Disrupted Situation ---

※ ※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※

All rights belong to Tappei Nagatsuki, the original author of the Re:Zero series. This is an English translation of the free web novel which is available at:

http://ncode.syosetu.com/N2267BE/

Translated by:

Proofread by:

Realigned by:

Art Source:

※ ※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※

Beatrice: [So? Tell me what happened, in fact.]

Having left the park, Beatrice waited until they had left Emilia and the others’ sight, and slowed her steps, speaking up. Although she had slowed down to talk, Subaru grabbed her arm and led her forward.

Beatrice: [Subaru?]

Subaru: [Sorry. We have to talk where no one else is around. There are many things that I want to discuss thoroughly, but we don’t have enough time—— In fact, we have less than fifteen minutes.]

Beatrice: […I understand, I suppose. Explain while we walk, in fact.]

Beatrice marched along obediently as Subaru turned his face away, trying to hide his anxiety. The presence of his understanding partner lightened Subaru’s heart, and he carefully sorted through the thoughts swimming in his mind as he tried to relay them to Beatrice.

Subaru: [The Witch Cult will attack the square that we’re heading to, and we have to stop their evil deeds.]

Beatrice: [Witch Cult… hk.]

Beatrice’s breath caught, and she urged Subaru to continue.

What troubled him were the rules and penalties for giving out information learned through Return by Death. Even if he had been able to safely relay tidbits to Rachins, there was no certainty that he could do so with Beatrice―― That was the nature of the devil of shadows whose hand bound Subaru.

The Witch that interfered with Subaru’s disclosure of information acquired via Return by Death would make a decision and pass judgement only after determining not only what Subaru was divulging, but also the person he was talking to.

If that were not the case, then why had Emilia’s heart been crushed after the secret had been revealed? That was the only explanation he could come up with.

So that was why Subaru paid careful attention to what he told Beatrice. If it were just Subaru withstanding the pain, then that would be no problem. It was scary. It was. But it was not something he was unable to endure. However, if that devil’s hand reached Emilia or Beatrice, Subaru would be crippled by guilt.

She might be forgiving to Subaru, but that Witch would be merciless to others.

Beatrice: [As usual, you can’t say anything, I suppose?]

Subaru: […Sorry. I’m so unreasonable.]

Beatrice: [Fine, in fact. Betty will believe it without any basis, I suppose. They’re Subaru’s words, so Betty will believe them, in fact.]

Beatrice took Subaru’s hand with her own, who bit back his own powerlessness. Saved by the warmth transmitted from that palm, Subaru searched for his next words. Sirius, Wrath, emotion sharing, soulwashing—scrutinizing the information that could be conveyed, and he would share awareness of the danger with Beatrice, little by little.

Subaru: [First of all, the member of the Witch Cult that’s going to show up is the Sin Archbishop of Wrath, who is, uh… A freak.] [1]

Beatrice: [If that’s the information that needs to be conveyed then Betty thinks that Subaru is having bad thoughts, I suppose.]

Subaru: [I’m just probing what’s safe and what’s not. Anyway, there’s something very important that we’ll have to deal with. Her abilities… she can control emotions, or is it sharing senses between people?]

Beatrice: [Controlling emotions and sharing senses?]

Beatrice lifted her head.

She was unable to imagine it in concrete terms. Of course, Subaru also could not clearly understand the effect of that Authority.

Subaru: [Explaining is a little difficult… if the Sin Archbishop is overjoyed, then no matter how angry people around her are, they will also feel happy.]

Beatrice: […I don’t really understand how that’s a threat, in fact.]

Subaru: [It’s this big thing where recognizing danger is impossible. No matter how dangerous the situation is, you don’t get that feeling of crisis. You’ll accept it with delight and won’t be able to correctly grasp the situation, understand?]

A crying, pleading child who did not want to die had been cheered for by the masses.

They had found joy in everything in front of them. Horrifying. Subaru was sure that, in that state, he would have been delighted up until the point a knife touched him. Even if it meant his head would be disconnected from his body by that blade.

Beatrice: [I understand the sharing of emotions, I suppose. What about sharing senses, in fact?]

Subaru: [That’s not all. When someone else feels pain, I’ll feel it too. If the Sin Archbishop’s head is cut off, then the heads of everyone watching it will also be cut off.]

As he explained further, his frustration at the hopeless situation began to surface again.

If you decapitate her, your head will also be chopped off―― There were few abilities that would make one more hesitant to kill than that. He had been able to escape through Return by Death, so he could think of measures in advance now. But everyone affected by that Authority before had no way of overriding that at all.

Subaru: [But even if you try to catch her alive, then there’s the possibility you’ll go crazy just by being in the vicinity. If she dies, then we’ll all die too. She’s really the worst kind of enemy, troublesome alive or dead.]

On his second death, Subaru had been swallowed by fear and driven mad. The origin of that fear had been Lusbel, who desperately sought for help. However, on that occasion, Lusbel had continuously felt the horror that led up to that madness. It could be taken as meaning that Subaru had less mental fortitude than the boy.

For Subaru, it was hard to say, “I should have been better”. Because it was hard to imagine that Lusbel, who he had spoken to earlier, would be able to resist such overwhelming terror.

Something other than just being made to share fear must have killed Subaru, in his second death. Something beyond just sharing emotions and senses―― Without the knowledge of what that was, finding a strategy that could defeat Sirius would be difficult.

Subaru: [————]

Subaru did not continue to speak, but he kept a grip on Beatrice’s hand, nonetheless.

Obviously, he had taken Beatrice, but he still had not found a solution. As such, Beatrice would probably be entangled in a battle with no real hope of victory.

What should he do? The easiest thing to do would be to have Reinhard take Sirius alive, considering the possibility of madness being induced. Subaru considered just summoning Reinhard like last time, giving enough explanation, and having him capture Sirius.

Why not call Reinhard before Sirius appeared? Before the sudden attack on the square, he would talk to Rachins again, warning him of life-threatening danger, and Reinhard would be called to deal with the crisis. Reinhard would not attack instantly, without asking for details. Even if Subaru explained why he had made an emergency call, there would be at least a few minutes until Sirius would make a move.

Subaru: [Am I an idiot? No, I am definitely an idiot. If Reinhard’s called, then Sirius is going to react immediately. There won’t be time to explain, and everything will speed up just like last time.]

Subaru needed to inform Reinhard before his battle with Sirius started.

Could he do it? Subaru had no confidence that he would be able to express his thoughts in time. In that previous loop, although he had wished to tell Reinhard to capture her, his mouth had disobeyed him and joined the crowd in yelling “kill her”. This was an undeniable precedent.

Beatrice: [Subaru. There’s still more bad news, in fact.]

Subaru: […Seriously? I don’t want to hear more bad news.]

Beatrice: Betty understands, I suppose. But, I have to tell you… Betty would be useless in a battlefield with Reinhard, in fact. I’d just be a cute little girl, I suppose.]

Subaru: [Huh?]

Beatrice spoke suddenly, her eyes downcast.

Beatrice: [Because of his constitution, Reinhard acts as a beacon for Mana, in fact. It’s like it doesn’t belong in this world[2], I suppose. The surrounding Mana in the atmosphere will follow him blindly, causing damage to the environment, which becomes a shackle to him, in fact. Spirits and magic users will be unable to use Mana, and Betty won’t be able to do anything, I suppose.]

Subaru: [What… the… That there should be such a thing…]

Even as he said so, Subaru realized that it was nothing so unthinkable. On the day Subaru had been summoned to this world, Reinhard and Elsa had fought a battle over the Insignia that qualified Emilia for the Royal Selection, in that final loop.

Subaru recalled that, while treating Rom-jii, Emilia had mentioned that if Reinhard revealed his true ability, magic would be ineffective.

Beatrice: [If Reinhard can solve the problem, then it wouldn’t matter if Betty can’t do anything, in fact. But, if just Reinhard isn’t enough…]

Subaru: [Beako won’t have the option of being useful.]

That fantasy was also killed.

Just his presence would cause all magic to cease functioning. Calling Reinhard would now be counterproductive.

——Awful, awful, awful, awful, awful, awful, what a disaster.

Subaru could no longer see any light. Had he been right or wrong in calling Reinhard? What about bringing Beatrice? What would be the correct procedure, here?

Should he ignore Sirius and give priority to the task of saving the people in the square? In that case, Sirius would only find another place to do the same thing. There was no point.

As he contemplated, anxiety began to burn through Subaru’s mind. Subaru expended as much effort as he possibly could in desperate search of a solution, but could find none.

Even so, time ticked on mercilessly, leaving Subaru behind.

Beatrice: […Subaru, we’re at the square, in fact.]

Subaru: [——Hk.]

Hearing her, Subaru suddenly looked up and saw the square.

The two had arrived at their destination, which would soon be marked by tragedy. No solution had been found yet. Their time limit had been cut short, little by little.

The white clocktower. The crowded square.

There were less than ten minutes before the tragedy would take place. Subaru’s solution was insufficient. How to solve it correctly? What to do?

Beatrice: [Subaru, I might have come up a solution, in fact.]

As Subaru’s face was taut with tension, Beatrice spoke up. Subaru’s blank mind was startled by her sweet voice.

Subaru: [Came up with a solution!?]

Beatrice: [Betty might be wrong, I suppose. But Subaru’s description of that Sin Archbishop’s abilities sounds familiar… I’m thinking of a higher-level magic, called Nect, that has a similar effect, in fact.]

Subaru: [Nect…!]

To the words spoken by Beatrice as she raised a finger, Subaru’s throat let out a sound.

Nect—— It was a form of magic that Subaru had experienced in the past. With Nect, magic users could share the awareness and feelings of others. Indeed, it seemed similar to Sirius’s Authority.

While wondering why he had not noticed at first, Subaru thought out loud.

Subaru: [If it’s the same as Nect, is there any counter for it?]

Beatrice: […In the first place, countering Nect is unnecessary, I suppose. It is intended to unite comrades and express feelings, in fact. Using Nect as a weapon seems strange, I suppose.]

Beatrice gave her unhappy reply to an anxious Subaru. Subaru had once reluctantly shared his vision with Julius using Nect, so that the latter could defeat Petelgeuse, countering his Unseen Hands by making them visible.

Nect’s ability was used for cooperation between allies. It was absolutely not the kind of magic that should be used to take hostages.

Beatrice: [Normally, there is a condition for Nect, in fact. Enough trust between the two parties so that a passage of Mana can be established is necessary, I suppose. The Archbishop’s Authority probably has the power to circumvent such a condition, I suppose.]

Subaru: [So her Authority can forcibly achieve it. More than that…]

Beatrice: [How to deal with it, I suppose—— Shamak is the most obvious answer, in fact.]

Subaru: [Shamak-san has arrived! It’s too versatile!]

Subaru perked up at Beatrice’s proposal.

Shamak was an incredibly familiar magic. In painful, hard, dangerous times, in the hopeless of situations, Shamak had always faced adversaries alongside Subaru. Prior to contracting Beatrice, Subaru’s main sources of strength were Rem, Patrasche, and Shamak.

And even after the destruction of his own Gate, through his Contract with Beatrice, Shamak was still helping Subaru.

Subaru: [I see, Shamak, huh… If it’s Shamak then surely everything is somehow…]

Beatrice: [Subaru seems to have an unusual level of trust for Shamak, I suppose. It’s the most basic of Yin Magic and it’s really not that useful, I suppose.]

Subaru: [Even Beako isn’t allowed to badmouth Shamak like that…!]

Beatrice: [What’s made Subaru defend Shamak to this extent, in fact?]

Beatrice listened to the incomprehensible ramblings with a sigh, then glanced around carefully while holding a finger up.

Beatrice: [Shamak interrupts consciousness—— it’s a magic that forcibly disconnects one from their surroundings, I suppose. Subaru uses the magic strangely, in fact, but Betty doesn’t have any problem with it at all.]

Subaru: [In other words…?]

Beatrice: [When that magic is cast on the crowd, everyone’s minds will be blinded with Shamak, and it should be possible to escape the effects of the Authority of the Sin Archbishop, in fact. Though I’m worried about whether I can stop it from affecting Subaru, I suppose.]

Beatrice spoke with confidence and Subaru clenched his hands with excitement at this new glimmer of hope.

Subaru: [Alright, good. I’ll be depending on your magic. Then… what’s next?]

Beatrice: [Aside from Reinhard, who can defeat the Sin Archbishop, in fact?]

Subaru: […]

With Reinhard, Beatrice would not be able to use her Shamak strategy. Therefore, he needed to be excluded from their calculations.

However, on this occasion, Reinhard was perhaps the only one who could defeat Sirius.

Beatrice: [Speaking of which, since Betty needs to use Shamak on people the moment the Archbishop is defeated, Betty won’t be able to fight, in fact.]

Subaru: [That’s right. Then… we’re back at square one.]

Without Beatrice’s backing, Subaru would almost certainly be unable to defeat Wrath. Without his trump card, just his whip alone would not allow him to escape unscathed.

Subaru: [At that time, it seemed like there were other people who could fight in that square…]

Subaru thought of the first time at the square.

Upon detecting a threatening presence in the tower, several people reacted immediately. A beastman, a blindfolded woman, a serious-looking businessman, and Rachins.

Excluding Rachins, how would the remaining three fare? Adding Subaru to their number would total four, and would that mean that victory was in sight?

Subaru: [What a stupid train of thought, asking strangers to trust me. I don’t think there’s anything I haven’t thought of now…]

???: [——That’s where I come in, because I know what I’m capable of?]

Subaru: [——!?]

A sudden voice from behind pierced into his hopeless thoughts.

At that all too familiar voice, Subaru and Beatrice looked back in surprise. Standing behind the two with their hands on their hips——

Subaru: [E-Emilia-tan? Why are you here…]

Emilia: [Subaru seemed to be acting strange, so I was worried that something bad was happening. It looks like I was excluded, that’s one of Subaru’s bad traits.]

Having been criticized, Subaru pressed his mouth shut.

Astonished at Emilia’s sudden appearance, he could not respond. She should not be here. He did not want her to be here. Beatrice took his place and looked up at Emilia.

Beatrice: [You should have stayed in the park, in fact. Why did you come, I suppose?]

Emilia: […I just couldn’t wait. Subaru told me to stay, but Priscilla told me otherwise.]

Subaru: [That woman in red?]

Emilia: [She said that if I didn’t follow you, I’d certainly regret it. When I caught up and saw that nothing had happened, I thought about leaving quietly, but you two seemed to be discussing something serious. So I couldn’t go back.]

Emilia had been influenced, and the face of the villain who had driven her decision came to mind.

Subaru gritted his teeth, mentally cursing Priscilla and her arrogant, disruptive meddling. That malicious whimsy had perfectly arranged the situation Subaru wanted to avoid the most.

Subaru: [Emilia-tan, I’m happy. I’m glad, so, from now on…]

Emilia: [The Witch Cult will appear? I heard you loud and clear… So even if Subaru tells me to go back, I won’t. It’s not just another person’s business to me either.]

Subaru: [Emilia!]

He was not trying to keep Emilia out of danger for no reason.

He spoke sharply, desperate to drive Emilia away.

She must not meet the Witch Cult. Subaru could not quite articulate why, but it was not born of anything like stubborn protectiveness. He instinctively understood that it must not be allowed.

Emilia absolutely could not meet the Witch Cult. To Emilia, that cult was a poison to be avoided. Although that held true for the majority of people born in this world, Emilia was a special case.

Subaru: [We’ll manage something. Emilia doesn’t need to be involved. This has nothing to do with you.]

Emilia: [Even so, what if Subaru is hurt because I’m not there? I’d never let that happen. If Subaru fights, I’ll fight by his side. If Subaru wants to protect something, I’ll do my best to help. And since Subaru will certainly protect me…]

Subaru: [————]

Emilia: [I also want to protect Subaru. I promised I wouldn’t cry like that anymore.]

Emilia spoke with an unyielding heart.

In order to keep her away from danger, Subaru had to summon every drop of his courage, face adversity with a heart of steel.

However, Subaru, right now, was afraid. He was terrified of fighting.

Three times.

Three times Subaru had lost to Sirius, and three times he had lost his life. No matter how experienced he was with death, he had still died so many times in such a short span of time.

Death was horrible, unacceptable, and no matter how much he experienced it, he could never grow used to it.

Having his life taken was completely unreasonable. That denied his self, trampled on his existence, insulted his soul. It was something that stole from him.

Although he tried to cover everything up with frivolity, Subaru could not brush off everything that affected him. Even while stubbornly maintaining that he had people he wished to protect, he could never cast off his weak heart, that was afraid to die.

Natsuki Subaru, no matter what, had not been able to overcome that weakness.

Beatrice: […Subaru. You should give up, in fact.]

Subaru: [Beatrice…]

Beatrice: [Emilia is stubborn, I suppose. She won’t change her mind, in fact. Betty also understands Emilia’s feelings, I suppose. Betty wants to protect Subaru the same way… Betty isn’t able to deny her that, in fact.]

Beatrice was the key to their strategy and also the party who called the shots. If she waved the white flag, then Subaru would not be unable to resist.

Emilia looked to Subaru sincerely, and Beatrice sweetly. Under their gaze, Subaru finally gave in.

Subaru: […The Witch Cultists will target you. If that happens, think of yourself as a priority.]

Emilia: [Mhm, I understand. Even if I’m caught, Subaru will definitely save me. I believe in you and I’ll do my best.]

Subaru: [Don’t jinx it… So, how much of our conversation did you hear?]

Having been accepted by Subaru, Emilia gave a relaxed smile.

She touched her fingers to her lips.

Emilia: [I heard the gist of it. The Witch Cult is going to wreak havoc with a magic like Nect, which Beatrice wants to counteract with Shamak. During that, I have to work hard to beat that villain.]

Subaru: [That’s a child-like way of understanding it, but it works. Emilia-tan, can I depend on you?]

Emilia: [Leave it to me. I’m plenty strong.]

Emilia makes a guts pose with her hands in front of her chest. That lovely action showed a certain lack of tension, but she seemed to have understood the situation.

Subaru felt restless and useless about relying on Emilia. Moreover, the timing of Beatrice’s magic was difficult for him to get a grasp on, which made it another element of anxiety. But,

Subaru: [Emilia-tan and Beako are both here, so I can’t fail…!]

Instead of feeling anxious, the boy used that to fuel his determination.

Subaru: [Besides, it’s almost time.]

Between Beatrice’s proposal, and Emilia’s arrival, more than half of their remaining time had gone by. They would have to try their best responding to Sirius’s appearance. If possible, it would be preferable to knock Sirius down from the tower while keeping Lusbel safe inside.

Subaru: [Emilia-tan. Soon a strange person will appear on the tower. Attack them with a big first shot. Having her fall from the tower would be ideal. Afterward, Beako will prepare her spell, so when we get the signal, we’ll start the fight.]

Emilia: [Mhm, I understand. Although I do not know if things will go that smoothly, but I’ll try.]

Emilia’s expression stiffened and both Subaru and Beatrice nodded at each other. The plan was set.

Subaru: [——She’s here!]

A figure could be seen moving about in the clock tower’s window.

A slender body wrapped in a black coat and a head wrapped in bandages. The ends of her chain, hanging from her hands, struck the ground with rattling sounds, as the monster looked down at the square.

The people there had yet to notice that anomalous presence. Sirius stood on her stage, shaking her body and opening her arms as though admiring the people, who were unprepared for that imminent threat.

And then she clapped and made a sound—— the eyes of the people who heard the sound were drawn to the monster, and her speech would begin.

Subaru: [————]

Swallowing, Subaru witnessed the arrival of the moment with a sigh.

With imposing gestures, Sirius raised her chest to speak fiercely——

Emilia: [Ul Huma!]

A huge icicle appeared in front of the tower, hitting Sirius who stood on the edge.

The thick icicle, which was around the size of five people, struck the wall of the clock tower with a violent crash. An icicle speared through the front of the tower, and the walls split apart. Subaru’s jaw dropped in amazement, seeing the tip of the icicle piercing the tower.

Subaru: [E-Emilia-tan?]

Emilia: [Subaru said we needed to strike first, so I did… Did I mess up?]

Subaru: [No, good job ! I just didn’t expect you to attack before her introduction.]

Subaru had not motioned for her to act yet, and was surprised that Emilia had judged Sirius as a threat at a glance.

Now the biggest problem would be her behavior, since Sirius had been equally unprepared. Maybe the blow had even taken her out. Moreover, the panicked crowd seemed to be entirely fine, so perhaps Sirius had indeed been incapacitated before her sense sharing had been activated.

That had been entirely thanks to Emilia’s great contribution.

Subaru: [Beako, what do you think?]

Beatrice: [First of all, think of a way to address the people around us who are misunderstanding, in fact.]

As Beatrice’s surprise turned to pride, Subaru wanted to ask whether they had gotten Sirius.

Emilia surveyed the destruction of the tower while Subaru slowly turned to face the uneasy crowd surrounding them. The beastman and the blindfolded woman were there—— how unfortunate, they were people that Subaru had considered as possible allies in this battle.

Subaru: [Uh, well, what do I do now? Explain that we didn’t mean any harm?]

Emilia: [——Mm. You better do that, Subaru.]

While Subaru scratched his head, pondering the explanation, Emilia suddenly grabbed his shoulders, placing herself in front of Subaru, who fell down on the floor.

In that moment, a crack sounded through the air, and a blue sword of ice appeared in Emilia’s hands. She assumed a battle-ready posture, facing down the crowd, aiming the tip of the sword towards them.

Subaru: [Emilia-tan? You don’t have to go that far…]

Emilia: [It’s not that. Look closely, Subaru. Their eyes look insane.]

Subaru: [——Eh?]

Scared by Emilia’s suddenly firm voice, Subaru surveyed the crowd around them, and could not help but exclaim. Like Emilia had said, their eyes held no trace of sanity.

The people around them were tomato-red from the neck up, the blood vessels in their faces on the verge of bursting, bloodshot eyes glaring at Subaru’s group.

Rather than doubting their sanity, Subaru saw they were indubitably full of mad fury.

Subaru: [Beako! What about Shamak!?]

Beatrice: […It failed, I suppose.]

Subaru: [What?]

Beatrice: [This magic is fundamentally different from Nect… No, it’s evil, in fact. This is nothing like magic, I suppose. A curse… it is Curse Arts, in fact!]

Beatrice raised her voice in anger, and Subaru could only answer with a frown.

He was not sure of the specifics, but Beatrice’s Operation Shamak had not worked. He understood the issue but had no solution. And there were further problems.

Then, the masses had been completely engulfed by madness…

Crowd: [It stinks. It stinks. It stinks. It stinks. It stinks. It stinks. stinks, stinks, stinks, stinks, stinks, stinks, stinks, stinks, stinks, stinks, stinks, stinks, stinks, stinks, stinks, stinks, stinks, stinks, stinks, stinks, stinks, stinks.]

It was a terrible, viscous, sound, tenaciously cursing everything in the world.

Subaru: [————]

With the sound of a detonation, the wall of the clock tower collapsed.

A crack ran through the icicle that had been embedded into the tower, and it shattered to pieces. Shimmering, the ice crystallized in the sun, accompanied by the faint sound of footsteps.

The footsteps of an abomination.

She was not unhurt. Half of the bandages wrapped around her face were stained with blood, which also dripped from her left arm and her chain. She had a terrifying appearance

Emilia’s premeditated attack had no doubt had an effect.

Only, it had also caused something undesirable.

Sirius: [Disgusting, the stench of that woman, filthy and detestable, the stench of the half-devil who stole my husband from me, the stench of maggots, endless filth. Hate, I hate it so much, burning it to cinders isn’t enough.]

Subaru: […What are you saying?]

Sirius: [And that other woman, she’s obviously not her, but she has such a similar stench, how shameless, the stench of rotting insects, ah, ah, ah ah aaAAAAAAH! How hateful! How rancid! How vile! I hate you!]

The anomalous woman clutched her bleeding head with a harsh cry. Spit flew from her mouth as she ruthlessly stomped her feet. Subaru knew this odd behavior. It was wild as ever, but its direction was obviously different.

Sirius: [My! Are you testing the love for my husband, Spirit?! From me, were you not satisfied with taking my husband from me, YOU HALF-DEVIL WHORE!!?]

Gritting her teeth, she issued a wrathful cry as she leapt forward.

Sirius, who had fallen from the tower, folded her arms overhead, and red flames sparked into life. They sprayed from both arms, and a line of flame formed as she landed in the square.

Exercising her limbs, armed with her flame, the monster raised her head.

Emilia held her sword of ice ready as she stood in front of Subaru and Beatrice, guarding them. Swinging her gaze back and forth, Sirius yelled with a furious voice.

Sirius: [I am! A Sin Archbishop of the Witch Cult! Representing Wrath!!]

Red flames gushing forth, she bathed the crowd in heat as she raised her arms to the heavens. In a frenzied crisis completely different from the situation Subaru had expected, the madwoman introduced herself.

Sirius: [——Sirius Romanée-Conti!! Fucking half-devil and Spirit, I’ll scorch your corpses and scatter your ashes at my husband’s tomb!!]

Translation Notes:

[1] – The Kanji used (変態) has the double meaning of “abnormal/deviant”, and “sexual perversion”. Punny.

[2] – Very weird phrase. If it were to be translated literally, it’d be like “That thing is the pinnacle of things foreign to this world” (アレはこの世界の異質の頂点).

--- Chapter 24: Resolution of Ice and Fire ---

※ ※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※

※ ※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※

With flames of rising crimson on her arms, Sirius’s shrieking was infernal in nature. The reason why that was felt even through the bandages was her eyes, dominated by rage completely out of the ordinary.

Those light-crimson eyes[1], normally so clear they seemed capable of sucking people in, were now glaring at Subaru and the others with hatred, tinged by the red-hot blaze on her arms.

——No, that was not quite right. Because,

Crowd: [Stinks, stinks, stinks, stinks, stinks, stinks, stinks…!]

Sirius had not registered Subaru’s presence. She merely glared with passionate hatred at the two standing in front of Subaru—— that is, at Emilia and Beatrice.

Subaru: [What’s up with her? She’s not the same as before…]

Subaru could not hide his wavering confusion at Sirius’s rage.

In the short span of time since he had encountered her, Subaru had met a relatively normal Sirius three times. Among those encounters, although Sirius had not been a person that followed common sense, she had not been someone irrational, overrun by rage.

In fact, she had always been attempting to justify her claims to impose on others.

So, the Sirius in front of them was completely foreign. She had lost her rationality and fallen prey to rage. Putting it simply, she now seemed a perfect fit for her title as Wrath’s representative.

Sirius: [I could keep burning and burning you, but it wouldn’t be enough… like maggots, like flies. Haha, how much do you hate me!? Even in my saddest days, am I not allowed the freedom of mourning?]

Emilia: […I don’t know what you’re talking about?]

Sirius: [Ah, ha!?]

Emilia responded fearlessly to Sirius’s enraged allegations, and stayed fearless at Sirius’s fierce reactions. She pointed the tip of her sword of ice at the crowd behind Sirius.

Emilia: [If you feel angry at me, I’ll hear you out. After all, the sudden provocation came from us, it’s natural that you’re angry. However, this has nothing to do with the other people here. Please liberate them.]

Sirius: [That’s the wrong attitude! If you want to let everyone go, do it right! It’s natural that I’m angry? Then apologize to me! Apologize, repent, crawl on the floor and cry and beg for forgiveness, then let me shoot flames into your ass and scorch your internal organs away!]

Emilia: [Having my organs burned would be troublesome—— So, let’s settle this simply.]

Sirius tilted her head upon hearing Emilia’s low voice.

Emilia immediately twisted her upper body slightly and darted forward. Her pale wrists wielded her sword of ice as if it were weightless.

The sun glistened off the sharpened tip of the sword as she drove it towards Sirius’s shoulder.

Subaru: [Emilia-tan?]

Sirius: [——Tch!]

Subaru’s exclamation overlapped with Sirius’s snarl. Facing that swing, Sirius immediately lifted her left wrist, bringing flames to the swords. However,

Sirius: [Fucking half-devil!]

Emilia: [Please don’t say that anymore. It feels dirty.]

Emilia’s sword, although bathed in Sirius’s flame, did not vaporize into air. The pale tip of the sword did not lose against the heat, and met Sirius’s burning left wrist—— only, Sirius’s chain had been also wrapped around it.

With a high-pitched noise, ice sword and flaming chain collided with a brilliant flash of Mana. After only a brief contest, Emilia’s sword shattered with a crisp snap.

Sirius: [You, damn…!]

Looking at the ice sword, reduced to a mere handle, Sirius gleefully attempted to slam her arm against Emilia. The chain, tinged with the heat of the fire, would burn wounds on those it touched.

And so, Emilia’s beautiful face was wounded—— But on the verge of that happening,

Emilia: [Haaa!]

There was a shout that did not fit the scene, and this time, Sirius’s wrist was struck. Emilia’s sword of ice had deflected her.

Sirius: [Ah ah aaaah! Ah ah ah ah ah! Just die already!]

Sirius’s cries of wrath pierced the air as she swung both arms over her head. The center of the area she was targeting was occupied by Emilia.

Emilia’s ice blade extended at the hilt, its shape having been changed into that of a hammer. Sirius met its blow with both hands, retreating, only to be pursued by Emilia.

Emilia: [Haah! Hahh! Yah!]

Sirius: [Disgusting! Half-devil! Maggot! Fly! Insect! Loathsome bug!]

Through use of centrifugal force and control over her body, Emilia demonstrated an unimaginable show of close quarters combat.

Against that mallet of ice, the flame-wielding Sirius had been reduced to defense. Looking at Emilia’s one-sided attack, Subaru, as a third-party observer, judged that she would triumph. Even so,

Subaru: [This isn’t the time to be in a trance! No, Emilia!]

Beatrice: [Subaru, you can’t be distracted right now, in fact.]

If Emilia killed Sirius, the last death would certainly repeat itself. Death would be spread to everyone in the vicinity.

Although Subaru had foreseen this crisis, Beatrice quickly scolded him. Subaru, wondering what had happened, followed Beatrice’s gaze.

Crowd: [——Dirty insect.]

Subaru: [Crap.]

The members of the crowd behind Sirius were all flushed with anger. The crowd looked at Subaru and Beatrice and made cursing gestures reminiscent of Sirius. In fact, they were completely sharing her Wrath.

That wave of anger was focused on Subaru.

Subaru: [It’s not just sharing feelings, but also doing things like brainwashing a crowd into acting on her will?]

Beatrice: [Identifying the situation is good, I suppose. If a solution doesn’t exist, then all we can do is escape, in fact!]

As Subaru groaned, considering his troubles, Beatrice immediately jumped onto his back. The crowd advanced towards Subaru, supporting that light body with his hands.

Subaru: [Emilia, help stall for us!]

Emilia: [I won’t be too messy about it!]

Receiving her strong reply, Subaru broke into a sprint, fleeing from the crowd. Fortunately, the pace of the masses who had lost their rationality was far from normal.

They chased Subaru with hands outstretched, empty wrath in their gazes, looking not unlike zombies. The main difference was that rather than wanting to eat Subaru, they wished to rip and tear him limb from limb with their bare hands.

Subaru: [If we keep stalling like this, someone could come…]

Beatrice: [Even if someone comes, without figuring out the conditions of victory, it would be meaningless, in fact. Even if Reinhard comes, would he be able to solve this, I suppose?]

Subaru: [In short, our worries won’t end even if he comes…]

In any case, the one who could summon Reinhard, Rachins, was presently part of the crowd threatening Subaru, face colored bright-red. He was one of the people most motivated to push forward, trying to be the first to reach Subaru.

Maybe it was the influence of his own mental image of Subaru, formed even before Sirius shared feelings with him.

Subaru: [We have to think of something!]

???: [Dirty insects!]

A man leapt at Subaru, who ducked his head and threw himself past his opponent’s arms, grabbing one of them before sweeping the man off his feet and sending his body flying. The masses showed no consideration to the tumbling man until he knocked them over. Turning from this bowling-like scene, Subaru spoke.

Subaru: [They’re so angry that they aren’t thinking at all.]

Beatrice: [However, that isn’t what I would recommend, in fact. In such an atmosphere, they probably won’t hesitate on trampling on their friends accidentally, I suppose.]

Subaru: [That won’t do!]

He did not want any sacrifices. The reason why Subaru fought so hard for so many was precisely this. Of course, Subaru understood that there were things that he could not reach.

There were many things he wanted to protect. However, there was a limit to what he was able to.

Of course. Subaru was not an omnipotent being.

Subaru: [However, I’m the one who chooses that limit!]

Beatrice: [That’s Betty’s Subaru, in fact!]

Hearing the greatest possible support from his back, Subaru drew his whip.

“I’ll save as many lives as I can. So please forgive me for any injuries”, those were Subaru’s feelings. Aiming at the feet of the crowd, his whip launched through the air.

With the crack of a small thunderbolt, the whip hit the stone pavement. Although it was not lethal, it was still a weapon, and, when wielded mercilessly, could incapacitate an opponent if used with all its might.

If maybe, after witnessing that power, the mass of people be cowed into retreating,

Subaru: [It won’t go that smoothly.]

Then, there was no other way.

Subaru swept his whip through the crowd, this time targeting the leading figure. A medium stature, light-blue hair, sharp eyes—— wasn’t that Rachins?

Attacking people who he knew would make Subaru feel sad.

Subaru: [Although this aches my heart, I can’t let myself be torn apart either. Sorry, Chin!]

Rachins: [I’m not Chin!?]

Subaru lashed his whip at Rachins’s feet and yanked upward. His body spun in a half circle, and he caught the people surrounding him as he fell.

After doing that, Subaru moved himself to the left of the crowd, guiding the footsteps of those following him to another route so that the ones who had been knocked down would not be trampled underfoot.

Subaru: [Right, they can’t think… In that case, as long as I——]

Just as he was about to say, “stall long enough”, Subaru felt a chill rise on his back.

To Subaru, that chill was like the imposing intimacy of his gloomy lover. Even if he were reluctant to meet her, she gave Subaru the help he needed most. They had that kind of complex relationship.

——In other words, that was the breath of death.

Subaru: [Ah!]

Beastman: [You maggot!]

A large blade whistled towards Subaru’s head, accompanied by a shrill wind.

The beastman had leapt from the crowd, aiming at Subaru’s neck. Although he had prominent pointed canine ears, his nose and mouth seemed to resemble the cunning charm of a fox.

The half-fox, using his white tail as a brace, was unaffected by Subaru’s tricks as he took multiple other slashes in an attempt to separate Subaru’s head from his body.

Subaru: [Beako!]

Beatrice: [Shamak!]

Beastman: [——!?]

In a serious confrontation, Subaru could be cut down in only five seconds.

In a flash, Subaru had determined the difference in their power and called Beatrice’s name. She immediately realized Subaru’s intention and cast a Shamak which enveloped the beastman’s face. His slender body and large sword were also engulfed by the dark fog, stripping his combat effectiveness away.

Subaru: [Does that cut off the link with the others?]

Beatrice: [There’s nothing to that effect, I suppose. Even take the fighting, the link itself did not cut off, in fact! Most likely, that curse will stop only taking effect after that freak dies, I suppose!]

Subaru: [What do we do!?]

Beatrice: [Betty is thinking hard, in fact!]

Solving that mystery was a task best left up to Beatrice. So the only thing that Subaru could do was to give Beatrice ample time to survey and think, and to keep the brainwashed masses from disturbing her.

Subaru: [And on Emilia-tan’s side…?]

Subaru turned his gaze, worried about Emilia, who was still busy confronting Sirius.

During this year, Emilia had dedicated her time to learning about both politics and combat. Her combat effectiveness was much higher than Subaru’s, and she was motivated.

Even so, Subaru worried about Emilia, not because he thought he was better, but because Subaru was a man and Emilia was a woman, nothing more.

Most people would probably dismiss that worry as meaningless. And that was because——

Emilia: [Haaa! Yah! Hah!]

Emilia was shouting slightly listless battle cries accompanying her onslaught, but Sirius was ignoring all of them.

Emilia spun around, her twin ice swords slashing toward Sirius, who whipped her burning chain through the air and knocked the blade away while cursing angrily. With a crash, ice fragmented into powder and dispersed, but, bending down, Emilia pushed an ice spear upwards, its power sending Sirius flying away.

She was making use of her huge store of Mana, forging weapons of ice meant to be destroyed shortly after being used. Subaru had named this combat technique Ice Brand Arts, in honor of the ephemeral beauty of shattering ice, which reminded him of an ice fairy of fantasy.

The wreckage of smashed ice illustrated the intensity of the fierce battle between Emilia and Sirius. In that ballroom of scattered ice, the heated, fiery battle between the two warriors wielding opposing arms of frost and fire.

Emilia: [Haaa!]

Emilia spun around, twirling her spear at Sirius, knocking her back. She immediately followed up with another blow, lashing out with the tip of the spear. Sirius nimbly twisted her body in midair, avoiding her strike and capturing the spear in her grip.

Sirius: [Blazing! Boiling! Burning! My heart is trembling! Ah ah aaaaAAAAAH! This is Wrath!]

Emilia: [Ah!?]

As if echoing her call, the intense heat redoubled its efforts. Emilia’s spear was instantly turned into a spear of fire, and Emilia involuntarily released it because of the heat. Immediately after, Sirius, holding the spear, landed and attacked at once.

Sirius: [Your dirty amethyst eyes, your dirty bell-like voice, your dirty silky silver hair, your dirty fair skin, your dirty cute face! Those all exist purely to seduce men! Ah, such lust! You bitch, you dirty whore! Just die! You just want to tempt men? You want to take that person from me? You filthy slut! You disgusting half-devil!]

As a wave of heat passed over Emilia’s squinted eyes, she once again created a blade of ice. It met the spear of fire, which had broken into a three-pronged spear, head-on.

With an intense grinding sound, the madwoman and Emilia exchanged gazes.

Emilia: [My eyes, my voice, my silver hair! All of those came from my favorite person, from the most beautiful person in the world! Treating them like they’re dirty infuriates me!]

Sirius: [Fury!? Did you just say fury!? Don’t kid with me! Fury is mine! It’s the precious thing that I received from that person! This duty and the name are all gifts from that person! To, without authorization, without permission, take that away from me… I won’t allow it! Won’t, won’t, won’t, won’t, won’t, won’t, won’t, won’t, won’t, won’t, won’t, won’t, won’t, won’t, won’t, won’t, won’t!]

As her speech came to an end, Sirius’s attitude changed dramatically as she cried out in grief. She caught the spear in her grip and snapped it, driving the flames into Emilia. In response, Emilia created another pair of ice swords.

But had Emilia been affected by Sirius’s cries? Her face, which had previously worn a strong sense of purpose, seemed to have slackened.

Subaru: [——This is bad.]

After catching a glance of the side of Emilia’s face, Subaru’s instincts began to scream of bad news. There was no basis. But Subaru was sure.

Emilia’s expression had changed, or rather, her feelings towards Sirius had changed.

No matter how kind-hearted she was, there was no way she would be so easily moved by emotion mid-battle. Before the brawl had begun, there had not even been any kind of conversation to make her feel any emotion, either.

And if she was reacting the way she was nevertheless…

Subaru: [Emilia’s being affected by Sirius’s power.]

However, she had not immediately fallen into the palm of Sirius’s hand.

Emilia, currently in a defensive battle, was still matching Sirius blow-for-blow. She was not as far gone as the crowd, and was just as lovely as usual. Then, inspecting the situation——

Subaru: [When Sirius first appeared, why weren’t Emilia, Beatrice, and I affected by her emotional link?]

Emilia and Beatrice had resisted her power just as Reinhard had. Was there any individual trait, or something similar to that, which was shared between all of them? Subaru’s initial assumption had been that Reinhard had been able to resist it just because he was Reinhard, and discarded thinking any further about it.

But if there was in fact a specific reason, then he could start hypothesizing.

Subaru, who had fallen prey to Sirius’s Authority three times already, was now also able to resist her like this—— that was also something to take into consideration. If that was the key to a breakthrough——

Subaru: [Bea…]

Beatrice: [Subaru!!]

The moment Subaru had wanted to convey his newly found realization, an anxious cry echoed in his ears.

As Subaru’s eyes widened, and something collided with his right side.

Subaru: [Guu——]

His body folded into the shape of a “K” from the power of the blow, and Subaru immediately hopped to the left, attempting to lessen its impact. As he coughed up stomach acid, he attempted to check the damage the blow had caused.

The blindfolded woman, moving like a shadow, had suddenly approached him. That defenseless-looking woman had delivered a rather piercing blow with her palm into Subaru’s side.

Beatrice: [Subaru! Don’t die, I suppose!]

Subaru: [Even I wouldn’t reach a game over from that… but that hit was super-effective…!]

Although his ribs ached, Subaru judged that his other bones and internal organs had not been harmed; it was nothing too serious, as long as there was no internal bleeding.

Subaru: [This guy and that guy too, why are these enemies so troublesome?]

Beatrice: [Either Subaru looks unreliable just because the enemies are strong, or because he himself is too weak, in fact.]

Subaru: [That’s true, you…!]

His whip bounced as it chased the blindfolded woman’s feet, and as she turned her attention to below her, Subaru tossed a handful of grit in her face. Although it did not affect her blindfolded eyes, it distracted her enough for Subaru to throw himself at her shoulder, knocking her over.

Subaru: [My lack of fighting strength seems to have come in handy. If the attack had been serious, I probably would have died on the spot.]

Beatrice: […Although I can’t say that that’s something Betty would accept eagerly, that works, since we have more trouble coming up, I suppose.]

Beatrice reiterated her annoying remarks about Subaru, who breathed a sigh of relief after defeating the blindfolded woman. He tilted his head in a gesture of “I’m not listening”, as Beatrice frowned and gestured with her chin.

She indicated the large waterway connected to the square.

Subaru: [You’re kidding me…]

Subaru moaned as he caught sight of the waterway, where another gathering of enraged people had emerged.

Beatrice: [Betty thinks that they heard the commotion and rushed over to see what’s happening, in fact.]

Subaru: [Then they entered the scope of her power and were swallowed… Are you serious? Is her ability a ranged-type?]

——Panic, fear, madness, would be transmitted from person to person.

The sharing of feelings by Sirius had brought about precisely a result that reflected that phenomenom.

“Ah, so that was it”—— The magnitude of her threat was worse than even Petelgeuse’s.

Subaru: [The more you try to flee, the more victims she finds… How can that be stopped!?]

Beatrice: [However, something is off about this entire situation, I suppose… Subaru knocked over that woman, and I cast Shamak on that fox-man. Couple that with how the <u>damage</u> to Chinkarahoi didn’t appear on anyone else, in fact.]

Because the situation was dire, Subaru did not correct Beatrice mistakenly calling Tonchinkan Chinkarahoi. [2] And beyond that, the details that Beatrice had just pointed out could serve as a basis for speculating on the conditions of Sirius’s emotional link.

Subaru: […Are we going to have to defeat that whole crowd too?]

Beatrice: [If Subaru has the fighting ability to do that, then we can go for it, I suppose—— Betty’s Shamak can also lend a hand in stripping their consciousness away, in fact.]

Although a cruel means, that had indeed been Subaru’s initial plan.

He could avoid putting himself through unnecessary worry. Subaru needed to avoid the expansion of such a disastrous situation. Now, to act on Beatrice’s proposal——

Emilia: [Ah!]

Subaru: [Emilia!?]

Subaru attention was diverted to Emilia’s pained cry.

He turned and saw her lying on the slate ground of the square, with Sirius, who was brandishing her flaming wrists, looking down at her.

Sirius: [Growing! Growing! Love culminates! That quantity is power! There is love for all! Everyone! Human beings love each other, and become one! They can share thoughts, they can share wishes, and, be it joy or sadness, they can talk to each other and share their feelings! In that case, this is the inevitable result! The half-devil isn’t included in the bond of Love and should just disappear like a crushed insect!]

Emilia, who had held the initial advantage, had gradually lost her footing until the two were about even.

As time dragged on, had Sirius’s strength increased, or had Emilia’s strength decreased? Whatever the case, Emilia looked upwards at Sirius, breathless, regret displayed on her face.

Emilia: [Something’s off. What you’re saying is right, but… it somehow feels wrong too. Why?]

Sirius: [Because you go against the truth! Because you are a dirty half-devil who cannot understand Love, and you will live and die not knowing Love! The existence of a half-devil is evil! Even your birth, even the meeting of your father and mother are wrong! The union of trash and insects birthed an unholy piece of shit that needs to end its existence here!]

Emilia: [——Hk!]

At the end of that unbearable tirade of abuse, Emilia’s eyes changed.

Kind and gentle as she was, Emilia could not tolerate such harsh words, which demeaned not only her existence, but even her parents’ meeting.

Biting her lip, Emilia pushed against the slate ground, leaping to her feet. Her enraged gaze trained on Sirius, a silvery shimmer gathered in her hand.

Emilia: [————]

Her sword slashed through Sirius’s coat, splitting it wide open.

Emilia, in her rage, would stop for nothing as she took another swing at Sirius, her sword of ice reaching the thin body in front of her——

Emilia: [——Eh?]

???: [Mmph!]

———Subaru saw the chained girl and froze.

A blonde, curly haired girl, bound in the same manner that Lusbel had been, blood pouring from her mouth, sobbed. Her small body was firmly bound to Sirius’s slender body.

Tina—— the name flashed through Subaru’s memory.

Sirius: [——That Wrath you have is scary.]

Subaru who had noticed the girl, and Emilia, who saw the girl’s tears, were overtaken by rage. And at that moment, Sirius gave her most ferocious smile yet as a wave of heat blew Emilia’s body away with alarming momentum.

The explosion whistled through the air as Emilia was knocked backwards. She flew across the stone, tumbling until coming to a stop at the very center of the square.

Emilia: [Gah, ugh…]

Emilia moaned as she writhed in pain. Sirius gazed at Emilia as she clapped, her flames burning so high they could be seen from a long distance.

Sirius: [An insect shouldn’t give me such a sweet passion. It’s incredibly disgusting.]

Emilia: [————]

Sirius: [Well, thank you. My apologies.]

With her wrists held over her head, Sirius’s whirlpool of flame roared once again.

Even steel would melt with nary a touch of that flame. If it touched her directly, then not even a shadow of Emilia would be left behind. She would be completely burned from the world.

If he did not act right now, he would not be able to save her. And not saving Emilia was unacceptable. Subaru clearly understood all this, and yet——

Subaru: [Move already, feet!]

Tina: [Mmph!]

Subaru’s feet were trembling with something like fear, leaving him unable to walk.

Subaru’s inaction had begun the moment he had laid eyes on the terrified girl that was bound to Sirius. Beatrice, on his back, was similarly unable to move.

Feelings could be shared with Spirits. Idiocy, that was not the time to think about that.

Subaru: [E… milia…]

His throat vibrated but he could not even call the name of the girl who he loved so deeply. Emilia certainly could not have heard him.

Emilia’s thoughts as she lay on the stone floor, unable to move, watching the imminent blaze unfold before her very eyes.

——Even those were scorched by unforgiving fire, leaving them forever a mystery.

Terrifying heat baked the slate ground, and, as the heat wave became the impact, the world was dyed a brilliant gold.

Faced with that fantastical scene, Subaru’s knees shook, and he collapsed on the spot.

Beatrice: [Suba… ru…]

Beatrice, still clinging to his back, called to Subaru in a stuttering voice.

Subaru could not respond. His line of sight remained fixed on the ground beneath him, as he refused to face reality, swallowed by an overwhelming dread.

Right now, if he looked up, he would lose to fear.

No, the heart he had long lost to fear would shatter and break. If he had to see where Emilia had turned to ash, if he had to see where Emilia had vanished from the world, then—

Beatrice: [Su-Subaru. Subaru!]

Even so, Beatrice continued desperately calling Subaru’s name.

His head was knocked several times, but Subaru could only embrace his horrified and timid heart, shaking his heads slowly.

It was impossible. Even if that monster were standing right in front of him, Subaru——

???: [——I caught up.]

However, the moment he heard that sound, Subaru’s heart shook off that fear. Rather than fear the sight in front of him, he feared being left in the dark.

Raising his head, he looked to the direction of the sound—— the place where Emilia had been incinerated.

There, a man stood.

Smoke rose from the charred rocks, which still crackled with heat. In the midst of that destruction, the man assumed a leisurely pose. There, in his arms——

Subaru: [Emi… lia?]

In the man’s arms, there rested a girl who should have disappeared in flame. Although she had passed out from exhaustion, she was physically unhurt. Emilia had lost her consciousness from the accumulation of her exhaustion and fear, but she was peacefully resting, safe and sound.

Subaru: [You…]

The person who had suddenly appeared and saved Emilia’s life.

His horrified heart denying him a celebration of Emilia’s safety, Subaru involuntarily voiced his wavering thoughts with a similarly trembling voice.

The man who heard and turned around. Then, he spoke.

???: [I came to meet her, so it’s great that I was able to catch up.]

Subaru: [To… meet? What’s that supposed to…]

???: [——Isn’t it a matter of course that I come to meet a woman who I intend to take as my bride?]

At that abrupt utterance, Subaru fell speechless.

At Subaru’s stiff lack of breath, the man—— a white-haired youth, gave off an easy-going smile.

Regulus: [I am a Sin Archbishop of the Witch Cult, representing Greed—— Regulus Corneas.]

It did not intend to boast, but rather speak for granted facts.

Regulus: [As promised—— I’m here to take her as my seventy-ninth wife.]

Translation Notes:

[1] – Expression used is “薄紅の瞳”, “薄紅” meaning “light-pink” or “light-crimson”. As a comparison, Emilia’s eyes are described as “紫紺の瞳”, “紫紺” meaning “bluish purple”.

[2] – Could be a Doraemon reference (チンカラホイ). It’s hard for me to be sure. For some damn reason half the results from that show are panty shots…

--- Chapter 25: Leo’s Theatre ---

※ ※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※
