JAPANESE WEB NOVEL SOURCE

※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※

Reinhard: [Forgive me for not providing assistance at this critical moment. I can only reflect on how I was lacking.]

Receiving the gazes of those present in the room, Reinhard apologized.

At the sight of the Sword Saint with bowed head, everyone grew silent for a moment. It would be easy to sling negativity in response to his apology. But, words of blame were easier to form than ones which conveyed true intent.

In truth, the fact that they had spent all this time in dire need of power while Reinhard had been missing, his status unknown, had not changed.

To think how the attack on the City Hall would have gone if his strength were present at that moment, that could not be helped. So even simple, negative words, did not easily emerge from anyone’s lips. However,

Subaru: [Really, you idiot. Do you have any idea how much trouble we’ve been in without you?]

Approaching that crimson hero, only Subaru called out to him, while poking his chest.

As that fist lightly touched him, Reinhard, with an attitude like he could not justify himself to Subaru, turned his gaze away. At that scolded and crestfallen appearance unbefitting of him, Subaru snorted.

Subaru: [You know, if you were gonna come anyway, you should’ve shown up fifteen minutes earlier! Then I wouldn’t have had to give a speech that didn’t fit my character at all. That’s supposed to be your job, isn’t it?]

Reinhard: [Sorry… However, it was a great speech befitting you. Though many things are required of me, giving courage-rousing broadcasts of that magnitude is not something I could do. You were the right choice.]

Subaru: [Between me and you, the required role for that broadcast is a little different, I think.]

Subaru poked Reinhard’s chest once again, and he smiled wryly. And, he also poked the tip of that downcast hero’s nose with a finger.

Subaru: [Reinhard.]

Reinhard: [What is it…?]

Subaru: [Since you came, it’s like a hundred men did, no, a thousand. I can expect that much right? Can I count on you?]

Reinhard: [――――]

It was a force comparable to ten thousand men. Subaru’s hundred-fold, even thousand-fold evaluation was laughable.

At Subaru’s expectation-filled question, Reinhard’s blue eyes blinked. But that hesitation immediately faded, and Reinhard’s lips formed into a smile.

Reinhard: [Ah, I want you to count on me. If you expect that much of me, I will comply.]

Subaru: [That somehow-making-women-happy kinda talk, can you stop that? Well, no matter… And with that, if anyone has something they want to say now, please go while we’re at it.]

Seeing that initial discomfort disappear from Reinhard’s face as he laughed, Subaru turned and looked back. Gazing over at the faces that had not said anything until now, he pointed to Reinhard.

Subaru: [At these times, the side that gets special treatment suffers much more. Besides, a chance to scold this Sword Saint that wants to be scolded doesn’t come by often. So go ahead, do it, do it.]

Reinhard: [――――]

Subaru: [After you’ve railed on him enough, let’s talk―― About how to help everyone.]

Subaru puffed out his chest as he spoke.

At that attitude, people held their breaths. Otto and Garfiel, the only two who were used to Subaru’s bravado, smiled.

And it was good to have one or two fellows able to see through to his true intentions.

They did not have to hold in their thoughts, because it was right after he had made that kind of speech.

※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※

After that, Reinhard’s personal talking to (details omitted) was held, and again talk of how to recapture the city started up again.

However, other than Reinhard and Otto’s similar lines of thought, there was no clear improvement. The number of enemies that they had to attack, and the necessary strategy of striking all control towers simultaneously did not change.

Subaru: [But in the midst of this chaos, where was Reinhard and what was he up to?]

As they all sat around in a circle talking, Subaru suddenly interrupted with that question. Reinhard’s expression clouded at his words. Today, his face often became like that.

Subaru: [You don’t have Felt with you, and there’s a lot of things I want to hear about. Ah, I’m not blaming you, or anything like that, okay? Please believe I’m past that stage.]

Anastasia: [What Natsuki-kun was sayin’, well, it’s somethin’ that bothers me too. No way the Sword Saint got scared and went into hidin’, I wasn’t thinkin’ anythin’ like that. But I am wantin’ to hear a convincing reason.]

Following Subaru’s question, Anastasia joined in. Judging from the fact she was casting sideway glances, it definitely seemed like she had received reports from Julius.

Right before the turmoil began, Reinhard and Felt had been in contact with Heinkel. After her question, Reinhard’s expression clouding over doubly, seemed to be proof of that assertion.

Wilhelm included, the Astreas’ approach to the topic of Heinkel was very evasive. Subaru did not know if he should voice it, but the way they treated him was like——

Subaru: [Like someone who’s been stuck inside for ten years, and now is a <u>pro-NEET</u> child who’s treated as a tumor by his aging parents…]

Otto: [Natsuki-kun’s jumping to weird imaginings again, so I’m sorry, but what will you do? If it is hard for Reinhard-san to talk, then I can speak, but…]

While Subaru recalled flashes of an evening news special on shut-ins, Otto chimed in. His worried gaze was directed at Reinhard, and his tone held an apologetic sort of feeling.

Subaru: [Wait, you came together with Reinhard, so did you really stay with him during the turmoil?]

Otto: [No, there was nothing like that. I joined up with Reinhard-san at the last moment… However, I have mostly figured out the situation.]

Reinhard: [Thank you, Otto. But this is a problem of my family. Truly, it is a difficult topic to discuss, but it would be for the best to speak of it myself.]

Reinhard bowed his head and refused Otto’s considerate offer. He gazed ahead, and corrected his posture straight a moment later.

Reinhard: [Firstly, though I have said it many times, let me apologize once more. I was the one person who should have been the first one to assist, so I must apologize for not being able to join you for several hours. I am deeply sorry.]

Julius: […On that point, our view is as we said earlier. We cannot forgive everything like there was no problem. However, you are needed in the upcoming battle. If you seek to repent, then perform well in the fights to come.]

Reinhard: [I will do so, Julius… At the time of the Witch Cult’s first broadcast, Felt-sama and I were called to a corner of the Second Street. The one summoning us was Deputy Commander Heinkel.]

Reinhard, who had started relating the event, called Heinkel “Deputy Commander” in a stiff voice.

It was widely known that they were father and son. And yet, he called his father by title. It was enough to bring about the realization that the the two did not have a simple father-son relationship.

Subaru: [After that fighting and separation from before, Felt answered a summon from him?]

Reinhard: [Deep inside, Felt-sama too would have wanted to refuse. However, the talk regarded a matter related to authority over the Astrea territories, so we could not refuse. What request would be made was unknown to us… Felt-sama accompanied me, and we headed towards the appointed place.]

Subaru: [There, how did that discussion end up…]

Reinhard: [My apologies, but as that matter is directly related to the matter of the Royal Selection, I would appreciate being allowed not to elaborate. It is enough to say the talk did not go smoothly.]

Reinhard’s tone of voice fell, and it was easy to tell the talk had gone poorly. Even if it had not gone down like that, Felt lacked experience dealing with negative emotions. Taking Heinkel’s despicable nature into account, it was not difficult to imagine how the talk would have played out.

In the midst of such conversation――

Reinhard: [Then, the Witch Cult’s first broadcast happened. While we could hardly believe our ears, it was clear that we needed to move immediately. It was my intention to head out right away if there was a truly dire situation. The other retainers, they also had a method to call for me if needed, which we prepared beforehand.]

That method was to launch magic into the sky at any time as a signal. Upon Sirius’s appearance, had Rachins fired off the signal, Reinhard would have rushed to the scene within thirty seconds. There were no lies in those words.

However, Reinhard had heard the Witch Cult’s broadcast filled with clear malicious intent, yet still did not move. He did not come running to the scene, and not just that, but had kept silent for several hours.

Why was that?

Subaru: [You knew that the broadcast was coming from the City Hall, no? At that point, you would have had the option to run to City Hall… Then why didn’t you come?]

Reinhard: [――――]

It was not that he was scolding him. That was not his intention, but his voice was firm as he pressed for answers.

There were more than a few things that occurred to him. If Reinhard had been present during that fierce battle for the City Hall—— Crusch, who was suffering now, would not have been harmed during the fight. It might even have ended without that strange event befalling Subaru’s right leg.

Though it was not intentional, the gazes growing harsh here were not just Subaru’s.

Receiving the stares of everyone in the room, Reinhard, who had until then been speaking fluently, closed his mouth, and lowered his gaze once again. With long lashes and shining eyes, he was hesitant to speak any words beyond what he had already spoken.

Even so, after those few conflicted seconds slowly passed, the hero choppily continued his words.

Reinhard: [――Deputy Commander Heinkel… took Felt-sama as a hostage.]

Subaru: […]

Reinhard: [That is my irreversible failure. Felt-sama was taken custody, and a sword was held against her neck to stop my movements. And so, I could not act.]

Subaru clearly understood why Reinhard had struggled with those words so much.

The master he should give his all for, had been taken captive by none other than his father’s hands. Just how much had Reinhard’s heart been affected by humiliation and shame?

Subaru: […Tch, what the hell? That Deputy Commander, is he a pawn of the Witch Cult or something?]

Receiving that shocking confession, Subaru muttered to himself, while thinking of Reinhard’s feelings.

If it were true, it was certainly cruel. He had heard that Witch Cultists had hidden themselves here and there, so it was difficult to know just who could be one of them. But for one of them to appear among family like that was something he did not even want to think about.

After seeing how Sin Archbishops other than Petelgeuse really were like, his opinion was all the stronger. All the Witch Cultists were the lowest of the low, mere human trash.

Reinhard: [――If it were like that, how would I react? My feelings, how would they be…]

Subaru: [What?]

However, Reinhard responded to Subaru’s idea, an idea accepted by roughly half of those present—— with a somewhat uncomfortable voice.

That attitude of his, Subaru wondered about it. However, the other half―― made up of Anastasia, Julius, and Otto, were making expressions that said they had reached another conclusion.

Reinhard: [The Deputy Commander is not a member of the Witch Cult… At least judging from his remarks after seizing Felt-sama, I saw nothing that suggested so.]

Subaru: [Then what is he, some kind of idiot? No, even if he isn’t stupid it is fine… Then, why? Why take Felt hostage? Doing something like that, what point――]

“Is there?”, Subaru was about to say, when he realized.

The depressed look on Reinhard’s face and the pitying one on Otto. Seeing those at the edge of his sight, the conclusion he drew almost made him want to laugh.

He could not laugh at that. It was completely helpless. Then, Heinkel’s actions――

Subaru: [――Were just because he wanted to keep you there?]

Reinhard: [――――]

Subaru: [From the Witch Cult broadcast, he realized the city was dangerous… So, to get himself some protection quickly, he just wanted to dearly hold on to the strongest guy at hand?]

Reinhard: […The Deputy Commander said something like, “your precious master and father are both here. Will you abandon them to save some bastards whose faces you don’t even know?”]

Subaru: [Your own father spouted that bullshit!?]

His rage boiling over, Subaru struck the floor with his fist.

Throughout this day, ever since morning, he had been repeatedly coming face-to-face with this passionate rage. However, he had never imagined feeling this furious about an opponent completely unrelated to the Witch Cult.

Reinhard: [I had no words to reply with. Of course, Felt-sama was saying it was all a bluff. Since she would be fine, she told me to go rescue the others―― But remaining there even then was my decision. The blame indeed lies within me.]

Subaru: [Why does it have to be like that!? Whose fault it is, it’s obvious to everyone here who’s to blame here!?]

Reinhard: [Even so, the choice was mine.]

At the shouting Subaru, Reinhard would not concede his share of the blame.

That obstinate Reinhard, he probably would not bend on that, no matter what anyone said. Subaru furiously held his tongue and forced his violent feelings to calm down.

Reinhard: [Nevertheless, I was trapped in that stalemate. What happened after is nothing remarkable. Even after further broadcasts I was left unable to act… I was severely scolded by Felt-sama.]

Anastasia: [But she ain’t witcha. Is Felt-chan doin’ alright?]

Anastasia asked Reinhard, with a bitter smile. The girl’s expression was blank, making her hard to read as she fiddled with her scarf. Even so, she was showing concern for Felt’s state, as the latter had not joined them.

Anastasia: [Bein’ held hostage like that for hours’d be quite tiring mentally. Now that Reinhard-kun’s here like this, I’m thinkin’ the issue’s probably been all sorted out.]

Reinhard: [Yes, that is the case. Felt-sama has now joined her retainers at a shelter. The Deputy Commander has been arrested and Felt-sama is watching over him.]

Subaru: [Arrested… He was caught, huh.]

Reinhard: [I am content with that result. But without Otto’s cooperation, even that could hardly have been achieved, I think.]

Subaru: [Ah, so that’s where Otto’s name comes in, huh.]

Subaru furrowed his brows at the mention of Otto’s name, who had yet to appear in this tale. Having reached his turn, Otto lightly cleared his throat to call for attention.

Otto: [Those were the state of affairs. And so, I arrived at that scene by complete accident. Simply because I was aware of the relationship between the three, by happening upon the scene I could roughly come to understand the situation.]

The Astreas’ family problems and the situation with Felt’s problems related to territories. Knowing that much already, he had spotted Heinkel holding Reinhard in place with Felt as a hostage. Even someone slow in the head would be able to figure out what kind of situation was happening.

Otto: [I, too, understood that being unable to borrow Reinhard’s power in the fight against the Witch Cult was the worst-case scenario. I went pale at that thought, so I knew I had to do something about it.]

Subaru: [And so Otto somehow drew attention to himself, and Felt was freed. That was how Reinhard was able to move, and now he managed to reach us… Something like that, yeah?]

Otto: [Luckily, Natsuki-san’s big speech happened too, so the meetup point was decided without any worry. It would have been nice if we could have moved a little faster, but I had a lot going on as well.]

Reinhard nodded as well, albeit briefly, confirming Otto’s contribution.

Again, the silver-tongued Otto had played an active role somewhere unseen by others.

Garfiel: [But still, what happened to Ottobro ‘til then? Honestly, walkin’ ‘round the city with yer strength, isn’t it the same as committin’ suicide?]

Otto: [About that, there were a lot of twists and turns… No, I will explain it.]

Clearing his throat, Otto indicated the outside of the City Hall building.

Otto: [As scheduled in the morning, I left for the Muse Company alone to request the continuation of negotiations from Kiritaka-san. He had also cooled his head overnight, so it seemed like it would be easy to agree to restart negotiations…]

Subaru: [It seemed, but?]

Subaru assumed that the Witch Cult would have started their broadcast and interrupted discussions.

However, Otto resumed speaking while shaking his head.

Otto: [At the location of the Muse Company, in the plaza of the Third Street, the Witch Cult… A Sin Archbishop made an appearance. We found out about the Witch Cult’s attack when that figure created quite the uproar.]

Subaru: [A Sin Archbishop…!? Before the broadcast?]

Otto: [Yes. Before the broadcast.]

Otto confirmed for Subaru, who was leaning forward in surprise.

But, when thinking about it, that was not impossible. Sirius, and Regulus too, were two other Sin Archbishops who had acted before the broadcast. Other than Capella, who at that moment was attacking the City Hall, the likelihood that those Sin Archbishops would have been doing something else in their free time in Pristella was high――

Subaru: [Wait, Otto.]

Otto: [――――]

Subaru’s tone of voice had lowered, and Otto’s gaze turned grim. That worried attitude of his confirmed the thoughts appearing in Subaru’s imagination.

Sirius and Regulus were both encountering Subaru at the time, and so, they could not have been there. Capella too would have been participating in the attack on the City Hall. Then, the Sin Archbishop that had appeared before Otto could only be one.

Subaru: [The one you met by chance, could it be the Sin Archbishop of Gluttony?]

Otto: […Yes. That was his claim. There was no reason for him to lie, so I think it is the truth. The Sin Archbishop who appeared at the plaza, introducing himself as Gluttony, looked to be a child.]

Otto’s testimony matched up with what Subaru had seen of Roy Alphard.

The selection standard for Sin Archbishops, it was not that he wanted to know anything about that, but Gluttony was at least outwardly a child—— a rag-draped, dirty looking child at that. In both words and attitude, he seemed like a he was just kid.

Otto: [At first, unsure if it was an abandoned child, someone called them while drawing closer. Since he was guarding the Muse Company, I think it was one of the White Dragon’s Scales. That person was the first to succumb to Gluttony. I became unable to move. Literally.]

Subaru: […]

Otto: [Just like that, a person was simply done in. It seems so surreal, but there’s no choice but to believe. Immediately, more of the White Dragon’s Scales all moved to surround him, but it did not end well.]

With his face going pale, Otto quietly spoke of that wretched spectacle.

Gluttony, as if he were performing a casual dance, seemed to have cut down the mercenaries. What was even scarier was, the keen nose of Gluttony―― it was a sense of smell which never lost track of his prey.

Otto: [The situation was such that the people on the street tried to run for their lives. However, that guy did not allow that. What he did, I do not know in all honesty. But even those far away from him were caught up in Gluttony’s rampage. The same happened to those inside buildings.]

Subaru: [What was he after?]

After asking that absentmindedly, Subaru realized it was a meaningless question. The acts of the Witch Cult were not consistent with the nature of their goals. And in fact, Otto shook his head, signaling he did not have the answer to Subaru’s question.

Otto: [Well, what could it have been… But anyway, it became a dire situation. Even if I tried to flee from that place, I could have been caught up in his attack the moment I showed my back. It was a complete dead end… If it weren’t for Kiritaka-san, I doubt I would have made it here as well.]

Subaru: [Kiritaka, how did he do that?]

Otto: [To begin with, it seems he must be a careful person. In the office of the Muse Company’s president, there’s a concealed passage in the building connected to an underground waterway. I escaped using a small boat there. While running away, I saw Kiritaka-san’s back being cut open.]

Subaru: [――――]

Otto: [From the Third Street, I ran away. After that, the Witch Cult broadcast happened and it became impossible to walk around in the city carelessly. Nevertheless, I cautiously moved around the area. That’s when I finally came across the scene from earlier.]

In other words, by “the scene”, he meant the one where he found Reinhard, whose movement had been impeded. That was where his story ended, and at the same moment Subaru understood that Otto had gone through hardships, and had again managed to survive.

But what he was concerned about in his story was――

Subaru: [Why did Kiritaka do that? From what you’ve told us, he even sacrificed himself to aid in Otto’s escape. That was how it sounded like to me.]

Otto: […Yes, indeed. Kiritaka-san, by sacrificing himself, let me escape. In fact, right at the end, he was slashed because he pushed me to the floor and covered me with his body.]

Subaru: [Why go so far…]

Inside Subaru, his mental picture of Kiritaka was nearly non-existent. Even the slight image he had was fixed on that scene with his face going red, screaming, throwing a spellstone while throwing a tantrum. Of course, he had not assumed that was all there was to that man.

But to sacrifice his body trying to save a stranger… He had not looked like a man with that level of fortitude.

Otto: [Since I was a customer invited to his shop, he might have held something like a trader’s pride. But definitely, it would seem he had a better reason for himself as well. One a little easier to understand.]

Subaru: [Easier to understand, you say?]

Otto: [Have you not realized? It’s Natsuki-san.]

To the confused Subaru, Otto firmly asserted his reply.

With the abrupt appearance of his name, Subaru was shaken. At Subaru’s reaction, Otto closed his eyes for nary a moment.

Otto: [Witnessing the existence known as a Sin Archbishop cutting down his own subordinates, Kiritaka-san must have felt like there was something he had to do about it. He must have held onto some sense of duty, I think. Then the one that became his hope was you, Natsuki-san.]

Subaru: […]

Otto: [After the happenings of the previous day, Kiritaka-san already knew about Natsuki-san remaining here. And definitely about your achievement of vanquishing Sloth as well. If so, then naturally that would lead to hope. Putting my escape as his top priority must have been because he expected me to join with Natsuki-san.]

Otto’s explanation fit perfectly, and it slammed into Subaru’s chest with a thud. But that was nevertheless an unreasonable story.

Deep down inside, he knew. To go on, to carry that, it was true, he had decided that already. But then again… Was everyone expecting that from Subaru?

That small, hopeless, and useless person, were they really trusting the fate of the city to a bastard like that?

Otto: [Natsuki-san, please do not misunderstand.]

Unknowingly forming a cynical smile, Subaru was pulled back by a voice. Otto looked straight into Subaru’s eyes. He spoke to that stiffening Subaru’s expression while shrugging,

Otto: [Kiritaka-san had thought of various things regarding his role and responsibility to the city. I understand that Natsuki-san too is hesitating about bearing the fate of the city. But, definitely, what Kiritaka-san entrusted Natsuki-san with is a slightly simpler matter.]

Subaru: […What?]

Otto: [It is obvious. Somewhere in this city is the woman Kiritaka-san loves. Before wishing for the safety of the city, what he expected most from Natsuki-san was for his loved one to be safe.]

Subaru: [――――]

Otto: [That was what he told me when he pushed me onto the floor.]

In short, Otto wanted to tell Subaru that he struggled too much. Those words, spoken to Subaru who felt as if he were burdened with the fate of the city, trembling under that immense weight, unexpectedly pierced deep into his conceited heart.

His face growing hot, Subaru felt ashamed of himself.

What about this city’s fate, what about all these hopes and expectations, how ridiculously stupid.

All Subaru had been considering was the city, which would find itself in disaster if it were not lifted up and saved. But what Subaru had to protect was not something described with that grandiose, superficial word, but the individuals that make up the city. One life, and many other “one lives”.

And each of those lives in turn had others precious to them, and it was just a matter of saving those connections.

Otto: [To think of it not as bearing a single large entity, but instead as lifting many small parts of the whole on your back, does that ease your feelings a bit?]

Subaru: [Wow. It’s a different way to think, but it actually feels right.]

Otto’s assistant power was just so high that Subaru really could not think how things would be without him.

Subaru’s face, which had been gazing downwards, looked up, and, at that result, Otto seemed satisfied.

Anastasia: [What’s that, ain’t it a nice relationship? Lookin’ at it even makes me a lil’ jealous.]

Sensing a pause in their chat, Anastasia threw out a tease. Subaru and Otto, who had been sitting down while talking nearly face-to-face, reflected on her quip.

And then gazing again at all of them, Anastasia tilted her head.

Anastasia: [Even sayin’ so, based on what ya said… The Muse Company’s finished…]

Otto: [The truth is that we cannot know for sure. I only witnessed the events up to Kiritaka-san being slashed, but whether that wound was life-threatening…]

Julius: [Is thinking about Gluttony’s motives truly a waste of time? To me, no matter what, the idea that he caused that disturbance for no reason is unthinkable.]

The one who interjected was Julius, making a disgusted face. That assertive tone of voice stuck in one’s mind.

Subaru: [Don’t just get weird like that. Is there any reason you think that?]

Julius: […No, I cannot claim that there is some clear basis for it. It is merely my impression from crossing swords with him at the City Hall. I do not believe we should write him off as merely a simple hedonist.]

Subaru was also in agreement. He was not simply a hedonist; he was a malicious hedonist. But that impression was an answer different from what Julius seemed to expect.

Subaru: [According to the broadcast, Gluttony’s request was an Artificial Spirit, correct? Maybe there’s a chance he had gone to find it?]

Reinhard: [It is indeed a possibility. However, there is a problem even before that. Should we not suspect whether the being known as an Artificial Spirit even exists? Is there really such an existence in the first place?]

Subaru mentioned a possible motive that came to mind, and Reinhard joined in with an argument of his own. His question would be the question many others who had heard the broadcast’s demands must have had as well.

Of those present here, only Subaru and Anastasia knew the answer. Without meaning to, Subaru peeked at Anastasia’s face, but her expression was unchanged, as expected of her experience. She had no intention of revealing it, is that what she was saying?

Otto: [――Sorry, just one thing.]

In front of Subaru, who was wavering in his judgement, Otto was again requesting attention.

That guy, with a touch of anxiety held in his face, let out a sigh mixed with resignation. And,

Otto: [I also do not know anything regarding the matter of the Artificial Spirit. But regarding another request, the Book of Wisdom demanded by Wrath…]

Cutting off his words there, after a moment of hesitation Otto spoke,

Otto: [I apologize―― The one who brought it to the city was me.]

Everyone in the room was plunged into a state of shock, after Otto dropped that bombshell, raising his hand.

The unverified existence of the Book of Wisdom was just confirmed, not by anyone else, but by one of their own. It was only natural that they would be shocked―― with Subaru’s surprise being the biggest among all of them.

Subaru: [Wh-why would you have the Book of Wisdom?]

Otto: [Before you misunderstand, let me explain. I was indeed the one who brought the so-called Book of Wisdom into the city… but the book is not mine. I was pretty shocked when I heard the Witch Cult’s request as well.]

Anastasia: [“So-called”? That’s a curious way to put it. What do ya mean?]

As Otto’s answered the shaken Subaru, Anastasia picked up on that descriptor and piled on with a question of her own. At that, Otto looked around at the others, and――

Otto: [Do you guys know about the Book of Wisdom? Simply put, it’s like the Witch Cultists’ Gospels… a book of prophecy that is able to tell you the future, except it seems to be the original. I heard that the difference in accuracy is huge.]

Anastasia: [The Gospel’s original…? It might be a stretch, but that reminds me of the prophecies of the Dragon History Stone. Though of course, their credibility, reputation, and standpoints are nowhere near the same.]

Otto: [I never had an opportunity to witness the prophecies of the Dragon History Stone or the Gospel come to pass, so I cannot say anything about their reliability… and the same goes for the Book of Wisdom, I am afraid. By the time I got my hands on it, the book was already nothing more than mostly-burned remains.]

Subaru: [Burned remains…]

Otto’s description matched the fates of both volumes of the Book of Wisdom in Subaru’s mind. One belonged to Beatrice, and was lost in the flames of the burning Forbidden Library. The other belonged to Roswaal, having been reduced to cinders by Ram in Sanctuary.

It was hard to say how much the testimony of its creator, Echidna, could be trusted, but if her words were to be believed―― then both volumes in existence should have been burned. In that case, what Otto obtained must be its charred remains.

Anastasia: [I see. I think I know why Otto-kun brought the book into Pristella now. Seekin’ the help of Restoration Master Dartz, right?]

Otto: […That is correct.]

With that simple reply, Otto nodded to Anastasia’s conclusion. Though both Julius and Reinhard appeared to accept this with an air of understanding, Subaru seemed confused by the term he had never heard before.

Subaru: [Hey, don’t you all suddenly go “Ahh” and leave me out of the loop here. What’s a Restoration Master?]

Anastasia: [Just as the name implies, they’re magicians who specialize in Yang Magic, and can restore objects to their original forms. Dartz’s quite a famous member of their circle, he lives in this city. Even books that have been half reduced to ashes can be restored with pretty good results, if given enough time.]

Otto: [I managed to make contact with Master Dartz and leave him with the remains of the Book of Wisdom. So the book should be in his workshop at the moment.]

With Otto’s testimony, the Book of Wisdom’s whereabouts has finally been revealed.

Garfiel: [But then, when did Ottobro meet that guy?]

Otto: [Yesterday, after the negotiations with Muse Company fell apart. Once everyone went their separate ways, I paid a solo visit to Master Dartz. We had a chat in private, and he seemed pretty enthusiastic about taking on the job…]

Subaru could just imagine Otto going pale in the face upon hearing the “Book of Wisdom” come up during the upheavals today.

That explains how the burned Book of Wisdom survived and why it was brought to this city, but Otto’s true motives were still unknown. Just why would he want to restore the Book of Wisdom?

Honestly, Subaru had no good impressions for the Book of Wisdom. It was an ominous black book created by Echidna, and associated with the Gospels in the hands of the Witch Cult. It was the reason Beatrice had been bound to the Forbidden Library for four-hundred years, and the reason Roswaal’s plots wrought violence upon the Sanctuary.

In truth, Subaru had been relieved when he heard that the books were destroyed by fire.

Otto: [I will not delve into the details of its acquisition or why it was brought here to be restored. I only intended to clarify the Book of Wisdom’s existence and its current location. Anything beyond that is an internal matter within our faction.]

Julius: [But the Witch Cult is listing the Book of Wisdom as one of their demands. Whose responsibility do you think that is?]

Otto: [I do not believe anything the Witch Cult does can be blamed on anyone other than the Witch Cult. But if you insist on it, I shall have to make some unfriendly remarks of my own.]

Otto stood his ground resolutely in front of Julius’s protests. And, seeing Otto turn his gaze to Anastasia, Julius quickly shook his head.

Julius: [My apologies. I said something useless just now. Naturally, I have no intention of laying the blame on you. The Witch Cult’s crimes will be properly repaid when we exact punishment upon them.]

Otto: [Agreed.]

Otto nodded to Julius’s determined words while stealing a glance at Subaru. But, seeing that secret gaze, Subaru could not say a word.

What was Otto thinking? Even if Subaru had no intention of suspecting him, he still had no idea what he was up to. Seeing Subaru like this, Otto quietly, silently, moved his lips.

Otto: [Let’s talk later.]

The message got through. He would explain everything, then. In that case, they better put the matter on hold for now.

Reinhard: [Now that the Book of Wisdom’s existence has been confirmed, we cannot be so sure that the part about Artificial Spirits is just delusional ramblings.]

With that settled, Reinhard started off with the new topic.

Though it was only going with the flow of things, now that Otto had already revealed something potentially disadvantageous to himself, there was no reason for Subaru to continue withholding his.

Subaru: [Anastasia-san.]

Anastasia: [I know, I know. Well, this ain’t gonna be easy.]

Seeing Subaru seeking her consent, Anastasia took off the scarf around her neck. She spread it out on the table, while everyone else tilted their heads at her determined expression.

But what she did next made all of them turn their tilted heads straight.

Anastasia: [――No need to play possum anymore, Echidna. You can speak up now.]

Echidna: [In my case, rather than “playing possum”, wouldn’t “playing fox” be more appropriate, Ana? [1] ]

Everyone: [――!]

Following Anastasia’s call, the white fox scarf stretched out its limbs with a will of its own. Seeing this, the same expressions of shock washed over Julius and Ricardo’s faces.

It seemed Anastasia had hidden the existence of the Artificial Spirit Echidna, even from the members of her own faction.

Ricardo: [Hey miss… I dunno that thing. The hell’s that thing…]

Anastasia: [Sorry for hidin’ it from ya, Ricardo. Julius too―― This child’d be the Artificial Spirit we’re talkin’ about. Her name’s Echidna, and she’s been my accomplice for a long, long time.]

Echidna: [Hello, Ricardo. It would be pretty awkward to introduce myself like we have just met, when, technically, I have known you for ages. We can be all buddy-buddy just like usual if you wish.]

Echidna was exceptionally friendly to Ricardo, who looked like he was gazing at something creepy. And, as off-put as Ricardo was by the white fox’s attitude, Julius’s face looked even more shocked. Faced with the secret his master had hidden from him, his pupils were wavering with rare and unconcealable dismay.

Julius: […Then that means, Anastasia-sama is also a Spiritual Arts User?]

Anastasia: [Hmmm, not exactly. There’s no Contract of the sort between me and Echidna. I just ain’t got the knack for it. And also, unlike ordinary Spirits, Echidna can’t fight at all.]

Echidna: [That is correct, I am as incompetent as it gets. I am afraid I might even be the weakest Spirit there is. So weak that even the Spirit Knight could not sense my presence.]

Julius: [Is that, so… no, but then…]

Julius’s suspicions were dismissed by Anastasia and Echidna in turn. But, rather than being assured, he turned his gaze towards Subaru, who was standing at the sidelines.

There was a certain sharpness in the yellow gaze he directed at Subaru.

Julius: [Why does Subaru look like he already knows? When I, as your Knight, was not aware of it, how could he…]

Anastasia: [It ain’t anythin’ of the sort. It’s…]

Subaru: [It’s because she’s an Artificial Spirit, just like my partner, Beatrice. After we heard the Witch Cult’s demands, Anastasia-san explained it to me… So I only found out a little while ago, not much different from you.]

Julius: [She’s an Artificial Spirit…? Anastasia-sama, is this true?]

Cutting Anastasia off, Subaru succinctly explained the matter to Julius, suspicion visible in his eyes. Seeing Anastasia nod to his question, Julius muttered “Is that so…”, and briefly closed his eyes as if to take it all in before exhaling a deep sigh.

Julius: [I apologize for having held suspicions about your behavior. Please forgive me for any displeasure I might have caused you, Anastasia-sama. I am deeply ashamed.]

Anastasia: [I’ve got no right to chastise ya when I’ve been keepin’ it secret all this time. I should be askin’ for yer forgiveness instead.]

Julius gave Subaru a nod and apologized to Anastasia. But, seeing Julius’s apology from the side, Ricardo grabbed Echidna off the table.

Ricardo: [Still, that’s really mean, miss! How long have we known each other? Why’d ya keep somethin’ like that from me? I’m kinda hurt! Is that all we are to each other?]

Echidna: [I would appreciate it if you did not handle me so roughly. I am quite finicky about my hair. And you would not want to damage Ana’s adorable appearance, now would you?]

Ricardo: [Pretty glib-tongued, ain’tcha? Ugh, nevermind. I’ll let it go this time.]

After pulling and squishing it to his heart’s content, Ricardo seemed satisfied and let the white fox go. Landing on the table, the white fox quickly scuttled over to Anastasia, wrapped around her neck, and became inanimate once more.

Having resided there for long, it was impressive how quickly it could return to its lifeless state.

Anastasia: [And so, the Artificial Spirits exist as well…That said, just like Otto-kun’s Book of Wisdom, I’ve got no intention of handin’ this child over to the Witch Cult.]

Subaru: [Sorry for keeping it secret, but I feel similarly. Beako is my important partner. I won’t even let her hold hands with those lunatics.]

Anastasia and Subaru both asserted their decision to refuse the Witch Cult’s demands. Hearing this, Reinhard nodded, and,

Reinhard: [I know. Of course. We cannot accept a single one of their demands. Although, perhaps the one about someone marrying a bride could be overlooked.]

Subaru: [No! Absolutely not! Because the person that asshole’s talking about marrying and all that fucking bullshit is Emilia!]

Otto: [Pfft!? Emilia-sama’s been kidnapped!? Since I had not seen her around, I thought she had evacuated! Couldn’t you have brought it up sooner!?]

Reinhard widened his eyes, and the shocking news sent Otto’s eyes spinning. Subaru clenched his teeth in response to the pair’s reactions and continued.

Subaru: [Sorry. It was all my fault, she was taken away in front of me. But, since the guy’s talking about a wedding, he shouldn’t have done anything to hurt her. So we have to go over there, kill him, and bring her back. Absolutely, absolutely…]

Reinhard: [――Yes, we will. If that is how it is, we absolutely cannot allow this.]

Just the thought of Regulus sent rage boiling within Subaru’s mind, and, in support of that indignation, Reinhard’s fighting spirit peaked, as if agreeing with the other’s rage. It was an aura so dependable that it was terrifying. Without a doubt, his presence was tremendously reassuring.

And, at this thought, Subaru turned his gaze to the corner of the room―― towards the man who had stayed out of the conversation thus far.

Sitting there, leaning against the wall, his expression was hidden behind his helmet.

Subaru: [Hey, Al. You should join the conversation too. You haven’t said a word since the end of the speech. Our most lethal weapon got held up all because of that bastard you guys brought. You better do something to make up for that, you know.]

Walking over, Subaru called to the downcast Al. And, sighing at the lack of a reaction, Subaru brought up Reinhard’s father―― Heinkel.

Heinkel had taken Felt hostage and effectively pinned Reinhard in place.

This clear-cut betrayal by turning a weapon on a Royal Candidate was not only a crime of lèse-majesté [2] , but fell nothing short of treason. Normally, there was no way an offender could escape the death sentence after committing such a heinous crime, but just how would Reinhard handle this?

At least, Subaru could not understand that from the side of Reinhard’s face.

Al: [――I’m sorry, but I’m out.]

Subaru: […Haa?]

Perhaps distracted with his thoughts on Reinhard, Subaru did not react until Al had already stood up. Taking his back off the wall, Al looked like he was about to walk right past a confused Subaru. Realizing this, Subaru quickly grabbed Al’s shoulder, turning him around.

Subaru: [W-wait! You’re out? What’re you talking about? We need every fighter we can get right now, and you want to leave us? What are you, an idiot?]

Al: [Idiot or whatever, you’d be crazy to count me as a fighter to begin with. Any random guy you pull from the shelters who’s been in a fight’ll be better than me. So it doesn’t matter if I go.]

Subaru: [The hell is that!? Don’t give me that moody bullshit! What’s going on all of a sudden? If you got something to say, say it!]

Al: [――You’re the only person I don’t wanna hear that from, bro.]

Shaking off Subaru’s arm, Al’s penetrating glare pierced into Subaru from inside his helmet.

That indiscernible gaze and uncharacteristic tone sent a chill crawling up Subaru’s back.

It was unlike hostility or murderous intent, but a fiery emotion all the same.

Subaru felt as if he had seen that inexplicable emotion from somewhere before, but he could not remember where or what it was. And he went without understanding as they continued their standoff, when――

???: [Inspiration flashed. Please listen―― Your Gaze Makes Heat Swell in my Chest~.]

Subaru: [Shut up!!]

???: [Pyiichi!?]

Subaru reflexively lashed back at the happy-go-lucky voice that came out of nowhere. The target jumped at that shout and tumbled flamboyantly over the table behind her.

Rolling around, moaning and wailing loudly, it was a girl with auburn skin――

Subaru: [You’re… Liliana!?]

Liliana: [Ughhhhh, aww! My elbow! My knee! Every bone that can be called a bone in my body is shattered! All six of my ribs are broken! There’s no mistake about it!]

The one energetically rolling on the floor in front of Subaru was the Songstress, Liliana.

Seeing her the same as ever, Subaru did not even bother pointing out that humans had more than six ribs but only patted his chest in relief.

Subaru: [I was pretty worried after we got separated, but I’m glad to see you safe. That’s a relief.]

Liliana: [Safe!? Can’t you see I’m on the verge of death here!? How can you pat your chest in relief in front of a damsel in distress, what kind of sick humor is that!? Inspiration flashed. Please listen―― Fingers! Ears! And Then the Eyes!]

Subaru: [You’re still pretty lively, aren’t you?]

Sitting up cross-legged on the floor, she strummed her Lyulyre, suddenly a picture of health. Although the abruptness of her recovery was rather unsettling, Subaru was just glad that she was alright.

Subaru: [But, how did you get to the City Hall? It must’ve been dangerous wandering around outside…]

???: [Naturally, that is something for me to decide, commoner.]

Subaru: [Ugh.]

Before he could ask Liliana how she got here safely, an arrogant voice answered the question in her place.

With the ringing of high-heeled footsteps, a woman in resplendent red stepped into the conference room. Adorned in rouge from head to toe, she swept her blood-red eyes across the room.

???: [Looks like all the actors have gathered. It was good of you rabble to have gotten ready for the star to arrive. Be sure to keep it up in the future.]

Smiling in a good mood holding a spread fan over her lips―― Priscilla. Her sudden entrance surprised everyone including Subaru, but the first to react was none other than her servant, Al.

Al: [P-Princess-san! So you’re safe… I was worried when I couldn’t find you anywhere.]

Priscilla: [Mmm, is that Al? What is the meaning of this, dallying with these peasants instead of serving me? Is it not your duty to look upon my figure, listen to my voice, inhale my scent, and obey my commands? And Schult, making me have to look for him myself, there should be a limit to your insolence.]

???: [P-please forgive me, Priscilla-sama…]

While Priscilla mercilessly berated her worried servant, a little boy in butler’s uniform peeked out his head from behind her, timidly clinging to her dress. It seems that Priscilla not only saved Liliana but her butler, all the while strutting around a city overrun by the Witch Cult.

Subaru: [What kind of crazy audacity is that…]

Subaru spilled a sigh at the fine line between excess bravery and recklessness. Hearing this, Priscilla turned her glare to Subaru. Snapping close her fan, she briskly walked over to him.

Priscilla: [You there, do not move.]

Subaru: [――Hk.]

With a swoosh of wind, she held the tip of her fan to Subaru’s throat.

As usual, moving with inconceivable speed, she reached him before his eyes could even register her motion. But, since Reinhard had not intervened, Subaru figured he was in no actual danger.

Subaru: [What are you doing? We’re having an important conversation right now, we don’t have time for your…]

Priscilla: [Good―― So that clumsy broadcast earlier was your voice?]

Subaru: […Yeah, so what?]

As pathetic as it was to rely on Reinhard’s lack of movement as his indicator, Subaru chose to huff back at the huffing Priscilla. At that response, she squinted her eyes.

Priscilla: [It has been decided. I will not tolerate anyone getting more attention than myself. So, I will prove how obviously superior I am to the likes of you.]

Subaru: [Huh? Ow!?]

Flicking up the fan at Subaru’s neck, it snapped against his chin so hard that tears came pouring out his eyes. With this, Priscilla left him, and imperiously sat herself down in one of the seats at the round table.

Priscilla: [Such a worthless chair. I can tell how cheap it is just by sitting on it.]

Making that scalding remark about the quality of the furniture, she swept her gaze across the faces seated at the table. Then, opening her red-painted lips, a splendidly gruesome smile rose on her face.

Priscilla: [Come now, I will allow you to tell me everything about the current situation. Be my hands and feet, and fulfill your responsibilities to your utmost. As reward, I will lend you my help. Remember to be grateful.]

Al: [Wait, Princess-san! Now that we’ve found each other, there’s no reason to stay here, right? We should get out of this dangerous place and…]

Priscilla: [Are you suggesting I run away, Al? If so, then you are gravely mistaken.]

Seeing Priscilla reclining into her seat as if intending to participate in the conference, Al hurriedly protested. But Priscilla shot back a glare, instantly freezing Al inside his metal helmet.

Priscilla: [Are you listening? I am the one who decided to stay in this city. And I will be the one to decide whether to leave it. I do not accept instructions from anyone. Besides, you want me to turn my back on these rabid fools and shamelessly run away? Who do you take me for?]

Al: […]

Priscilla: [Everything in this world is made for my convenience. So why should I leave and allow this obnoxious mess to continue? If you wish to call yourself my servant, then know this, Al. I am favored by divine providence, and thus, my actions are divine providence.]

Priscilla’s will could not be swayed.

Everyone present, and most of all Al, knew this. Seeing Al slump his single shoulder, the young butler―― Schult, quietly snuggled against him. And, wryly smiling at his consoling gesture, Al made up his mind as well.

Subaru: [Otto, you have a minute?]

Otto: [Yeah, let’s go.]

As the round table began briefing Priscilla on the current situation, Subaru whispered to Otto. Apparently having anticipated this, Otto complied without a hint of surprise.

Subaru: [Garfiel, let me know when they’re done.]

Leaving this instruction behind, Subaru left the meeting room with Otto.

And as soon as they were outside, they turned and faced each other in the hallway. Meeting Subaru’s gaze, there was no hesitation in Otto’s eyes. He knew exactly what they needed to talk about.

Subaru: [Why the hell are you trying to restore the Book of Wisdom? No, before that, when did you pick up its remnants?]

Otto: [It was a year ago, after the problems in Sanctuary were settled. After the snow Emilia-sama brought down disappeared from the forest [3] , I was wandering around the premises of the village when I… Well, I cannot exactly say it was by chance. I heard what happened from Ram-san, so I was actively searching for its scorched remains as well.]

Subaru: [So then, what you found was what remained of Roswaal’s Book of Wisdom?]

Otto: [Yes. I was unusually lucky since that happened to be the place I wanted to check out.]

“Unusually lucky” must be a jab at how usually unlucky he was. Although Otto was wryly smiling, Subaru was in no mood to share that sentiment.

Because Otto’s reasons for doing this were still weighing down on Subaru’s chest.

Otto: [Tell me honestly, Natsuki-san, what do you think of Margrave Mathers?]

Subaru: [Roswaal?]

As Subaru sank into silence, Otto posed him this question. It sounded both somewhat relevant to the topic at hand, and yet not relevant at all. For a moment, Subaru pondered on the question.

Subaru: [Well… I think him to be a treacherous guy, especially after what happened a year ago. But, since that guy’s goals are clear now, and assuming they haven’t changed, I don’t see him as an immediate threat. In fact, now that we understand each other’s goals, I kinda feel like an accomplice.]

Otto: [I do not trust Margrave Mathers in the slightest.]

Otto declared, pointing out how naïve Subaru’s thinking was. Hearing this, Subaru widened his eyes at the sharpness of that statement.

Otto: [You mentioned what happened a year ago. Yes, that is true. But he has been plotting long before what happened in the Sanctuary one year ago. Natsuki-san, you and Emilia-sama seem to be awfully forgiving about that.]

Subaru: […It’s not that we forgave him. Everything that guy did was fucking ridiculous, and I’m still super pissed off. But, the fact remains that we need that guy’s influence. So there’s not much we can do, and Emilia has the same idea.]

Otto: [That is what I am calling naïve… Though I am not saying that it is a bad thing.]

Otto shot an impatient gaze at Subaru, the latter somewhat understanding the emotions seething underneath.

In other words, Otto was telling him that he was not nearly wary enough. Of course, Subaru knew that it was something he had to keep an eye on, but,

Otto: [It’s fine. The way you’re approaching it is fine. There’s no need to change that. Since I’ll be seeing to the necessary precautions.]

Subaru: [Precautions?]

Otto: [As the Internal Minister, I have had plenty of opportunities to interact with Margrave Mathers. From what I have seen over the past year, I did not notice any signs of scheming or strange behaviors. But that is not to say he could not have already laid his plans before this past year. He could easily have set up something that will only activate once a certain time has passed.]

Subaru: [――――]

Subaru closed his mouth. Otto’s wariness and concerns got through.

His distrust of Roswaal was justified. It was just the natural consequence of that man’s actions, be it good or bad. Though in this case, mostly bad.

Otto: [If he follows the Book of Wisdom’s every word, and believes that it foretells the future, then one look inside the book will let us know everything that he is planning. That way we can take the necessary measures to guard against any betrayals in the future.]

Subaru: [You mean, you are trying to restore that book… because you don’t trust Roswaal?]

Otto: […Quite the opposite. It is precisely because I do not want to distrust my allies that I want to make sure. I wanted some peace of mind that neither Natsuki-san nor Emilia-sama will be harmed or, at the very least, that there was no misfortune to befall us. So, I kept the Book of Wisdom in hopes of restoring it… I apologize for being so selfish.]

With this apology, Otto lowered his head. But, in front of him, Subaru could not say a word. He did not feel like he had the right.

Otto’s concerns and the actions he had taken to resolve them, those were all things that Subaru and Emilia should have noticed. In fact, the hardships he had endured were entirely for Subaru and Emilia’s sake.

Now that he realized how Otto had been silently helping him, Subaru felt at once ashamed, remorseful, and incredulous that he had not realized it earlier.

And why would Otto do this for him? Was it just because they are friends?

Otto: [I will not tell you why, though. It’s pretty boring anyway.]

As if having read Subaru’s thoughts, Otto replied.

Being beaten to the punch by this smiling Otto, Subaru breathed a deep sigh.

Subaru: [Somehow, it’s like I’m always bailed out by the people around me, you included, you know.]

Otto: [That may be, but I think you’re good just the way you were when you made that broadcast, Natsuki-san.]

Otto scratched his head, while Subaru clicked his tongue and dropped his shoulders, a bit embarrassed by his considerations.

Subaru: [I understand. I’m on board about the Book of Wisdom. But the problem is, those assholes are still looking for it. So what do we actually do?]

Otto: [Regardless of whether it has been successfully restored or not, I think we better get it back. There is a great chance that Master Dartz could get hurt, and that would be far from my intention.]

Subaru: [But we’re going to simultaneously attack all four control towers. We don’t have any forces to spare for that.]

Otto: [I may be a non-combatant, but I can more than handle myself if I travel by the waterways. I may not look like it, but duping animals like water dragons is one of my top strong suits, you know.]

Putting his hand beside his mouth, Otto must be boasting of his Divine Protection of the Soul of Language.

In fact, when it comes to running away, Otto’s Divine Protection would actually be quite handy. Besides, the enemy’s main forces were concentrated at the Control Towers. Assuming they had not brought any extra Witch Cultist lackeys, Otto should not be in too much danger.

Otto: [Rather than worry about me, you should be thinking about the assault strategy. You must save Emilia-sama, after all. That is quite the responsibility.]

Subaru: [Understood. I won’t let anyone have that Greed asshole’s head.]

That white-haired thug, that abomination demon, who had snatched Emilia, flashed across his mind. That, and the fact that he was a Sin Archbishop, meant that he was an enemy that must be defeated.

Otto: [Shall we head back? They must be about done with the debriefing.]

Seeing the invigorated Subaru, Otto turned his head to the meeting room. But, just as Subaru nodded and was about to head inside with him――

???: [――Subaru-dono.]

He was stopped by a low voice, coming from the stairway.

There was no mistaking who that voice belonged to. The person upstairs, watching him with narrowed, stern blue pupils―― Wilhelm.

Subaru: [Otto, you go on ahead.]

Otto: [Alright. We will continue this later.]

Otto went back into the meeting room while Subaru walked up the stairs to meet Wilhelm, waiting on the upper level. Then, as soon as they were at the same height, Wilhelm lightly bowed his eyes.

Wilhelm: [I apologize that I could not join the discussion. I apologize for the inconvenience.]

Subaru: [With the situation as it is, no one would think to blame you or your companions, Wilhelm-san. So, um… How is Crusch-san?]

He had heard her condition was far from good. Or, not just far from good, but in quite a terrible state. As a woman, she probably would not want her status to be exposed to the public, either.

Thinking back on the wretched state of his leg, he could imagine what kind of damage Crusch must have sustained. And that thought alone made him regret imagining it.

To Subaru’s query, Wilhelm softly cast down his eyes.

Wilhelm: [Crusch-sama has request to speak to you, Subaru-dono. May I trouble you to come with me?]

Subaru: [Crusch-san asked for me? No, of course I’ll come, but… is that really alright?]

Wilhelm: [It is her sincere wish. Though Ferris will not be happy about it.]

Subaru: […I guess not.]

Ferris would probably have some bitter words to say to Subaru.

After all, the only two who faced off against Capella on the top floor of the City Hall had been Subaru and Crusch, and Subaru alone should have protected her.

Wilhelm: [If Ferris says something disrespectful, please do not mind him. And please forgive him, if possible. Deep down, he does understand. It is just that he is facing emotions that he could not process.]

Subaru: [Watching the person most important to him suffer… I can understand why he’d want to curse the people around him, if only just to take his mind off the one he’s worrying about.]

If venting his rage could ease some of his pain, then who could blame him?

And so, Subaru steeled himself to take on some of his abuse as well.

Wilhelm: [This way.]

Without remarking on Subaru’s reply, Wilhelm led Subaru towards the place where Crusch would be waiting. Tick, tack, the regular rhythm of their footsteps echoed through the hallway.

And on the way,

Wilhelm: [Subaru-dono, there is something else I need to report.]

Subaru: [What is it? Is it something other than Crusch-san…?]

Wilhelm: [It regards the two swordsmen accompanying the Sin Archbishops.]

Unwittingly, he stopped his breath.

It should have been so obvious, how did he let it slip his mind? Mimi’s wound, one that could not be healed, inflicted by the Divine Protection of the Death God. The true identities of those super-class swordsman should be able to be deduced from that――

Wilhelm: [One of them is the Eight Arms, Kurgan. A formidable swordsman who was a General of the Vollachian Empire for a long time. A man who should have died ten years ago.]

Subaru: [A man who… should have died? Uhm, Wilhelm-san…]

Wilhelm: [And the other…]

Wilhelm cut Subaru off just before he could ask his question.

He stopped his steps, and Subaru followed suit. Then, Wilhelm turned his back, and sank into a momentary silence. Subaru took a step forward to peek at the side of Wilhelm’s face―― but instantly regretted it.

He should not have seen it.

Wilhelm: [――The other, is the previous generation’s Sword Saint, Thearesia Van Astrea. My wife… who should have died in battle against the White Whale, in the Great Subjugation that took place fifteen years ago.]

Subaru: [――――]

The fact that he had kept his voice so calm and steady was a testament to the strength of his will.

But upon witnessing the wrenching agony that twisted Wilhelm’s profile, that impression fell away. Chewing his lips, with rage and grief interwoven within his eyes, a crazed passion contorted his wrinkled face beyond recognition―― one look at that expression, and all his emotions were clear as day.

Subaru: [Your wife… and a General of the Empire? They’re actually still alive…?]

Wilhelm: [If that is… No, that cannot be possible. My wife and Kurgan, both of them should be dead. That cannot be overturned. The dead are still dead, but being defiled by someone.]

Subaru: [If they’re still dead, then… it’s something like Necromancy?]

Necromancy―― magic that manipulates the dead, was quite common in fictional universes. Of course, as far as fiction was concerned, magic able to return the dead to life was quite common as well. Although, nothing so convenient existed in this world.

This was something Subaru had painfully come to understand in the year-and-several-months he had spent here. And so, he believed the possibility not to be the latter, but the former――

Wilhelm: [Spells that manipulate the dead are forbidden. Though I do know of a being who once used it. In the Demi-Human War―― the civil war between humans and demi-humans, which took place in Lugunica decades ago, she was one of three people who joined the demi-human side and were made enemies of the Kingdom, fighting on the demi-humans’ side.]

Subaru: [Enemies of the Kingdom…?]

Wilhelm: [The Demi-Human Hero, Libre Fermi. The Great Strategist, Valga Cromwell. And…]

After pausing for a moment, Wilhelm continued.

Wilhelm: [The Witch, Sphinx. An abominable existence who, without batting an eye, mercilessly spilled the blood of human and demi-human alike. The only Witch other than Satella whose name remains in the history of the Kingdom.]

Translation notes:

[1] Punny. The exact expression used by Anastasia is “狸寝入り”, which uses the Kanji for “tanuki/raccoon” (狸), an animal reputed to be mischievous and associated with trickery in Japanese folklore, and “sleep” (寝). However, Echidna corrects her by using “狐寝入り”, replacing the Kanji for “tanuki/raccoon” to the Kanji for “fox” (狐).

[2] A French term meaning “to do wrong to majesty”, an offense against the dignity of a sovereign or a state. For more information, see here.

[3] In the Web Novel, Otto should know that the snow was brought down by Roswaal, not Emilia. Chalk this one up to a bit of an inconsequential, minor writing mistake. “Tappei kinda forgot”, the sequel to “Araki kinda forgot”.

--- Chapter 45: An Inescapable Curse ---
