ALL RIGHTS BELONG TO TAPPEI NAGATSUKI , THE ORIGINAL AUTHOR OF RE:ZERO STARTING A LIFE IN A DIFFERENT WORLD FROM ZERO, THIS IS A TRANSLATION OF THE FREE JAPANESE WEB NOVEL INTO ENGLISH

JAPANESE WEB NOVEL SOURCE

※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※

As Wilhelm spoke the name of a Witch he had never heard of before, Subaru shuddered.

Aside from Satella, the only Witches Subaru knew of were the six Witches of Sin he had met in Echidna’s tomb. The fact that Witches other than those somehow existed was devastating news.

Subaru: [Then, Wilhelm-san, if that Witch, Sphinx, is involved in this raid by the Witch Cult… Are you saying there’s a Witch too, in addition to the Sin Archbishops?]

The main enemies numbered four Archbishops and two warriors. If that was the case, adding a Witch to their forces made the disparity in strength become a desperate matter.

However, Wilhelm raised a hand at Subaru’s concerns.

Wilhelm: [Pardon me, my wording was unclear. The existence known as the Witch Sphinx perished in the Demi-Human War. There is no possibility that it might be participating in this assault.]

Subaru: [The Witch is dead? There’s no mistake? The impression I have of Witches is that they tend to fake being dead, and have lots of freedom even after really dying.]

Satella, too, was like that, as whenever Subaru violated the taboo, it would draw her out. And in the castle of dreams, enjoying her afterlife, Echidna was the same.

Even hearing a Witch was dead was no guarantee at all.

Wilhelm: [What impression Subaru-dono has of Witches I am unaware. But Sphinx is only named a Witch, merely an existence given that title for convenience. The fact is that the Kingdom’s military referred to it as such, but the concerned party never called itself the same.]

Subaru: [Calling them a concerned party… Did Wilhelm-san ever meet them directly?]

Wilhelm: [Several times, during the civil war. The event that may have triggered the end of the Demi-Human War may even have been the beheading of Sphinx. Roswaal, Bordeaux, and my wife were all leading figures of that time.]

Subaru: [Roswaal!?]

An unexpected name popping up caused Subaru to open his eyes wide.

At that reaction from Subaru, Wilhelm slightly lowered his head for a moment and became immersed in thought.

Wilhelm: [I knew the Roswaal-dono of two generations ago. Although back then I was not very friendly… she took care of me.]

Subaru: [Two generations ago… Ah, that’s right. The name Roswaal is inherited from generation to generation.]

Wilhelm: [Unfortunately, that predecessor passed away soon after. I grew distant from them following that, and the current Margrave Mathers is only a passing acquaintance… But this is all superfluous talk.]

He was now lending an ear to tales of surprising relationships, but the original topic was definitely not about that. Subaru nodded his head, and then Wilhelm continued his tale with an “And so,”

Wilhelm: [Not Sphinx, but some being using a spell that acts similarly, is my thought. The method of controlling the dead was at the time called cases of Corpse Soldiers.]

Subaru: [Corpse Soldiers… That… Does it have any weaknesses?]

Wilhelm: [From what I know, the Corpse Soldier is limited to a technique for moving the body. It does not seem to be able to bring back the abilities possessed in life. It merely shames the dead while keeping the appearance. A reflection of the user’s nature.]

Subaru: [But, the Eight Arms, and… that.]

He was at a loss for words.

The one turned into a Corpse Soldier, whose very death was being profaned, was Wilhelm’s wife. Even if Wilhelm had already accepted it, Subaru was speaking of it with hesitation.

Wilhelm made a bitter face at Subaru’s reluctance, loosening his lips.

Wilhelm: [I am grateful for your concern. But, it is necessary―― Yes, the skills of both my wife and Kurgan are close to their abilities in life. It exceeds the power a mere Corpse Soldier can pull out.]

Subaru: [Then, isn’t it possible that this is something different than a Corpse Soldier? If so, then your wife might not even have died…]

Wilhelm: [My wife is dead. Because my strength was lacking.]

The side hanging onto a fragile hope here was Subaru. Wilhelm’s clear voice cut down Subaru’s feeling with a single stroke.

And there were no words Subaru could say to that elder swordsman’s profile.

Wilhelm: [Even at the time, that which could not simply be judged as merely a Corpse Soldier did very rarely exist. Whether it was due to aptitude in the procedure, or another factor I am unaware of… We should perhaps believe that it may be the strength of those two.]

Subaru: [Is there a way to take them down?]

Wilhelm: [Thoroughly destroying the body, or cutting away the curse mark somewhere on the body. Then the Corpse Soldier will return to a simple corpse. It must be done this way.]

Wilhelm’s considerate voice could not easily be heard.

He was conscious of his calm, trying his best to focus on what he felt he had to do―― His trembling voice, his clenched fist, his scrunched eyes, in that moment he was unable to hide anything.

Wilhelm: [I apologize for holding you this long. Crusch-sama cannot be made to wait any longer. Now, this way.]

Wilhelm bent his back and indicated the door of the division they had reached. On the innermost part of the fourth floor, was a room with a crumbled plate labeling it as a lounge.

Inside, Crusch, who had called Subaru, was waiting.

Passing Wilhelm’s side, Subaru headed for the door, the sound of footsteps echoing.

Definitely, the distance to the door felt awfully long. There was even the impression that the soles of his shoes stuck to the floor and interfered with Subaru’s progress.

The fact that this reluctance was his own weakness, Subaru was clearly aware of that.

Subaru: [――It’s me. Natsuki Subaru. Is… Crusch-san?]

He knocked, and called out with a voice so quiet he wondered if it reached the other side of the door. Like that, after a brief silence, taking no more than a moment, the other side slowly opened the door.

The face that appeared was Ferris’s. But his appearance had changed entirely.

Ferris: [Subaru-kyun…]

Red eyes puffed up from crying and disheveled brown hair. Covering his entire body in black stains was, not his, but someone else’s blood, his white skin splattered. He must not have had time to clean it. His cheek and neck were also smeared with fresh, sticky blood.

Witnessing such a miserable appearance, his breath inadvertently caught in his throat.

Subaru: [Crusch-san called me, I heard. So…]

Ferris: [Yeah. Inside, she’s on the bed… Definitely don’t do anything unnecessary, please.]

A firm voice, with some hatred intermingled near the end. However, that hate was not directed at Subaru. It could be said to be directed at everything. Hating everyone in the world, Ferris was now controlled by rage with nowhere to go.

Taking a deep breath, Subaru followed Ferris inside.

It was not a very spacious room for a lounge. Long tables and chairs were arranged in two rows, and further back, the small room was divided by a threshold. The bed was past it.

And on that shabby bed she was laid.

???: [Na… tsuki-sama?]

Crusch, fully conscious, recognized Subaru had entered and called him by name.

Reacting to her voice, Subaru’s throat felt like it had constricted. Readying himself, feigning calm, calling out assuring words―― He was unable to even do something so simple…

Crusch: [My appearance is not presentable… My apologies…]

Subaru: […No, that’s not, like that… Haaa. It’s not like that.]

Seeing Subaru’s tense atmosphere, Crusch apologized in a lethargic voice. Subaru, feeling flustered by her sorrowful attitude, raised his voice to mend his vague words from earlier.

――Having been drenched in Capella’s blood and clothed in its curse, Crusch was in a wretched state.

Her neck, the back of her hands and feet—— over all exposed skin, dark-blackened veins were visible. It was not difficult to imagine that under the towels and blankets and clothes, the skin there would be afflicted with the same. These black blood vessels, which pulsed instead of circulating blood like regular blood vessels, gave off the appearance of a writhing serpent strangling Crusch’s thin body.

That formerly white, unblemished skin of hers was now being violated horribly.

Of course, the damage was not limited to areas below the neck.

Crusch’s dignified visage, reminiscent of a slender sword’s beauty―― its left half had received disfiguring stains. Compared to that, the right side of her face retained her beauty. That rather emphasized the contrast between the two sides, and made the unfairness of a noble person being defiled more apparent.

A patch had been placed to cover the left eye, the sight underneath difficult to imagine.

Subaru: [This is… The same curse left on me, the dragon’s blood?]

If it was indeed the same, then nothing could be crueler.

Because he knew Crusch Karsten, there was no limit to Subaru’s heartache.

He looked down at his own right leg. Like Crusch’s skin, it also was mottled and wrapped with blackened veins. However, Subaru’s leg, terrible sight notwithstanding, was otherwise unaffected. Neither pain nor feelings of pain were felt by him at all.

But Crusch was definitely different. Her breathing was labored, and whenever the dark veins pulsated, she sighed as if withstanding pain.

Subaru: [Ferris…]

How was it not cured, he wondered as he turned to gaze at the greatest healer in the Kingdom. However, Subaru’s brief thought only served to hurt Ferris, who further grit his teeth in helplessness. He bit down on his lips, stabbing his own arms with his nails while bowing his head. Ferris understood his lack of power and regretted it more than anyone else in the room.

Knowing the relationship between the two, Subaru had no reason to doubt all possible methods beyond his imagination had been exhausted already.

Subaru: [Crusch-san… What do you need of me?]

Why, in such a painful situation, had she called out for him?

He did not think that there was something he could do. Maybe there was something she wished to say. To ask for revenge on Lust, who had done this to her. Perhaps even some resentful words would be directed towards Subaru.

Even if fed insults, even if curses were poured on, he would accept it all.

At Subaru’s question, Crusch opened her mouth, enduring the pain. Leaning in close to her lips, he paid his utmost careful attention, to make sure her faint breaths would not go unnoticed. And――

Crusch: […Un-unharmed… I am relieved.]

Subaru: [――――]

Crusch: [I heard… that like me… you were cursed…]

Subaru felt a burden lift from her in the softness of her relieved sigh. At the same time, he understood the true feelings in her heart, and grew so angry at his own stupidity he wanted to die.

He had been thinking it would be easier to be criticized.

So he had doubted Crusch’s integrity, and had underestimated her noble heart. She had truly just been worried that Subaru had been afflicted with the same pain as herself.

Subaru: [Sor… I’m sorry… Crusch-san…]

Having suspected her feelings because it had resulted in her suffering, and being unable to suffer on her behalf, he squeezed out those mixed emotions in his voice.

Without realizing what he was doing, he stretched out his hand and grasped the hands Crusch had weakly laid over her stomach. The black blood vessels had no special texture even if touched. That the feel of skin with this ruined of an appearance did not change was even more pitiful. But,

Crusch: [Fuu…?]

Subaru: [Ugh!?]

The sudden sound of Crusch’s sigh, and the simultaneous pained noise from Subaru’s throat overlapped.

Agony as if he had grasped a hot iron stabbed into his whole body starting from his palm. In an instant, Subaru released Crusch’s hand and stared at the palm the sensation had come from.

That blackened erosion was spreading over it.

Subaru: [What the…!?]

Ferris: [Show me, Subaru-kyun!]

Grasping the groaning and hurt Subaru’s hand, Ferris inspected the erosion. The light of healing blanketed the spot, but there was no sign of either the pain or the affliction fading away. Instead――

Subaru: [Ferris… Crusch-san’s hand!]

Ferris: [Eh…?]

Subaru’s gaze was directed at Crusch in astonishment, and beckoned Ferris to direct his own the same direction. And those yellow eyes widened as well, witnessing the same occurrence as Subaru.

Subaru had grasped Crusch’s left hand―― on that hand, though slightly, the blackened erosion had thinned. Looking down at his right hand, noticing that shift, a certain idea passed through Subaru’s mind

Subaru: [No way, it moved from Crusch’s body to mine… Is that it?]

He could only think that. The change on the hand he had touched and the change on his own were positive and negative, respectively. There was no doubt that the curse had traveled from Crusch’s body to Subaru’s.

Ferris: [Bu-but I haven’t changed at all? I examined Crusch-sama’s body, I touched her many many times since… Me, for me…]

At Subaru’s hypothesis, Ferris shook his head.

That was not joy at a possibility for healing being found, but rather an appearance of suspecting that the hypothesis was false. No, his own feelings were definitely different.

Ferris: [I can’t make Crusch-sama feel better…]

Subaru: [Then, let’s try it one more time.]

Pushing aside Ferris, left in dismay, Subaru once again stood before Crusch. Crusch, her face showing she was unaware of what had occurred, directed her glistening eyes at Subaru. To not show a tense face to that eyepatch-wearing, single-eyed gaze, Subaru took a deep breath.

To check it again, this time, he lightly brushed Crusch’s cheek.

Subaru: [――Guh, ugh!]

Immediately after, Subaru’s brain was stabbed with pain as if magma had been poured into his veins. Through the tips of his fingers, the curse that was violating Crusch’s body flowed in, and seared his senses.

Subaru: [Gaaaaah!]

Feeling unbearable, severe pain, Subaru screamed loudly and yanked his body away. Like that, falling back with the momentum, the hand which had been touching Crusch lost contact with her body.

Subaru: [Ah, haaa, haaaaaa…]

His lungs shivered, and his eyeballs cramped.

Opening and closing his mouth repeatedly like a fish on land, Subaru desperately sought oxygen.

Ferris: [Su-Subaru-kyun… Are you okay?]

Seeing his breathing start to calm, Ferris spoke to Subaru. Barely able to spare enough feeling to notice the hard floor he had landed on, he raised his body with difficulty. And gazing up at the face of Crusch, as she laid in bed,

Subaru: [How is it, Ferris? Was it effective, even just a little?]

Ferris: [Ah…]

With a plop, Ferris sat back down again to confirm Crusch’s condition.

He too would have seen it with his own eyes. The cheek which was being eroded by the curse had been relieved, just a little bit. If such treatment was possible, then saving Crusch was also――

Crusch: [You cannot, Natsuki-sama…]

Subaru rose to try once more. However, it was none other than Crusch herself that stopped him.

Not understanding the meaning of her words, Subaru asked.

Subaru: [Did you not… notice? Your hand is…]

Crusch: [――Hand?]

Hearing this, she looked down at her right hand. And it was then that she finally realized the change that had occurred.

Similar to his right leg, blackened blood vessels covered the skin. That much was fine. With that alone, his resolve to take on Crusch’s curse would not be shaken.

However, there was definitely something strange.

Compared to the spots which had been taken from Crusch, the extent of the erosion was much greater. The corrosion on her body, the darkened parts of her left hand and cheek, those dark blood vessels had all grown a shade lighter due to Subaru’s touch.

However, Subaru’s right arm, having absorbed that dark erosion, had its skin completely covered in black, all the way up to his elbow. The concentration was clearly different. The ratio the curse was transferred at was not one-to-one. It was more on the level of ten-to-one, perhaps not even that.

Subaru: [No, even then…]

Whether that was cause to hesitate was another matter.

There was pain in the moment of transfer. But, once it had been accepted onto his body, there was no sign that the curse would actually hurt Subaru, so far.

Compared to Crusch’s constant hellish suffering, the pain Subaru felt lasted for only a moment. Besides, there was not even any need to consider which side should bear the burden of its torture, the man or the woman.

Whether it was his right leg or right hand turning black, if it was for the sake of saving Crusch, it mattered not.

Crusch: [Natsuki-sama, that cannot be… I am unable to accept those feelings.]

Subaru: [Don’t be silly. It only stings a little, so it’s fine. Compared to getting a tattoo while showing off and regretting it later, let’s think of it like dirtying a body that was already dirty in the first place. I can take away the pain too. It’s strange, but I don’t feel any pain, so…]

Crusch: [Can you guarantee that will be true in the future…? It could be that both Natsuki-sama and I will become unable to fight. In the current situation, that would be a fatal blow…]

Worrying more for the city and the people than her own body, that was Crusch’s judgement. It was logically sound, but not everything should be considered with logic alone.

Crusch: [Ferris, please stop Natsuki-sama…]

Ferris: [I… I am…]

Crusch: [Please. Because Natsuki-sama is now needed by people other than me…]

Ferris: [If Subaru-kyun resolved to help… C-Crusch-sama’s suffering…]

Ferris’s hesitation in making a decision was because he kept Crusch at the top of his priorities. That, nobody could blame him for. Of those present, no one was in the wrong, after all.

The notion that “whatever is not wrong is right” was mistaken.

Crusch: [You must not be overwhelmed by the emotions of a single moment. Natsuki-sama, I ask of you…]

Subaru: [Crusch-san, even then, I…]

Crusch: [Did you not say so before? ――”What is left, leave it all to me.”]

Subaru: [――Kh!]

Crusch’s pleading eyes took hold of Subaru and would not let go.

Had those reliable words come from his mouth? Was Crusch telling Subaru to fulfill the words she had heard?

Crusch: [Please say that to… me as well…]

Subaru: [――――]

Crusch: [“All that’s left, to leave it all to me.”]

A pained smile was awaiting Subaru’s words.

Swallowing his breath and shifting his tongue in his dry mouth, Subaru quietly closed his eyes.

Without thinking of the future, only immersed in what was in front of him, he was making her say things that did not need to be said, so at least――

Subaru: [Crusch-san, calmly rest here, please.]

Crusch: […Natsuki… sama.]

Subaru: [Because everything that’s left, you can leave it all to me.]

Crusch: [――Yes.]

If it was just filling the needed role and saying the desired words, then it just had to be done.

Hearing Subaru’s reply, Crusch took a deep breath and seemed to relax.

Her eyelids weakly blinking shut not a moment after proved that, up until now, by any means possible she had been holding onto her consciousness. At that moment breathing a quiet sigh, Crusch once more began her time of battling the effects of the curse’s erosion.

Subaru: [Sorry, Ferris. But I have to go now.]

Ferris: [I’m… What should I… Is it alright?]

Draping a towel like a blanket over Crusch and standing up, Subaru heard a small voice as he was leaving. It was the first time Subaru had seen Ferris showing weakness.

In his innermost thoughts, what he wished now was to remain at Crusch’s side. But in the current situation, Ferris’s ability would not allow for such a thing.

Subaru: [I need your strength. I’m not saying to leave City Hall. But I’ll tell them to evacuate the wounded here, if something happens. So, I’ll leave that to you.]

Ferris: […The one I wanted to help most, and I can’t help them.]

Subaru: [Ferris…]

Ferris: [Sorry. I said something stupid… Just give us a moment, please.]

While looking away, Ferris sat down on a chair next to the bed. Subaru lightly patted his shoulder and, finally, he stepped out of the lounge.

Unchanged from when he had entered, Wilhelm stood upright, waiting in the hallway.

Wilhelm: [Thank you very much for considering Crusch-sama’s feelings.]

Calling out to Subaru upon his return, Wilhelm spoke. Did the events that transpired within the room leak outside, or perhaps Subaru’s expression was just easy to read?

Subaru: [It isn’t some noble tale like I considered her feelings. Since it’s more a story of how I was encouraged… My body, what’s up with it anyway?]

Taking on Crusch’s curse, and its effect being weakened against him in the first place. Going back even further, everything about the Witch Factor and Return by Death was, in truth, ambiguous.

One day, would he get to see the reason and reach the conclusion for such things?

Subaru: [We will leave Crusch-san to Ferris. Once everything is settled, I’m thinking of trying what I did once more.]

Wilhelm: [Is that right arm fine?]

Subaru: [At first glance, it’s a bit iffy. If I wear long sleeves and gloves it might look alright… For the sake of rescuing a pretty girl, a scar that doesn’t fade away isn’t any trouble at all.]

Even though he had some aversion to it, those were Subaru’s true feelings.

If there was no other solution, then he would absorb Crusch’s curse in full, even if his body became pitch-black because of it. Emilia, Rem, and Beatrice, he would have to beg forgiveness from all of them.

Subaru: [But, that’s all something for after we overcome this turbulence. Wilhelm-san, let’s head down. The others may be discussing the plan to retake the control towers right now.]

Probably, all the top-class powers that this side could muster would already be gathered there.

What followed after would depend on their compatibility with the abilities of each Sin Archbishop, as well as the timing and execution of the capture plan. Only six hours remained until the deadline imposed by the Witch Cult.

Wilhelm: [Subaru-dono, regarding that matter, I have a request.]

Subaru: [A request?]

Wilhelm’s words stopped Subaru as he headed for the stairs―― The elder swordsman nodded his head towards the door behind him, showing concern in his eyes for his master within.

Wilhelm: [If possible, please recommend for me the task of subjugating Lust. Since I am aware of its powers of mutation and super-regeneration, I will request this of you.]

Subaru: [Revenge for Crusch-san, is that it?]

Wilhelm: [That as well. But beyond that, it is essential to capture Lust alive and have it explain what was done to Crusch. For that, I will even become a demon. Before cutting off its head, I will definitely question her about it.]

The killing intent given off by the Sword Demon felt like a wave of heat to Subaru. Furiously, darkly, having been unable to do anything, Wilhelm’s ardor to avenge his master now rose up like flames.

Subaru: [That spirit is fine… But are the Corpse Soldiers alright?]

Wilhelm: [――――]

Subaru: [Your wife, would you not know her best? Whatever else we do, it’s Wilhelm-san who needs to settle that score.]

Wilhelm: [Subaru-dono, has Reinhard arrived below?]

Wilhelm suddenly interrupted Subaru, while he spoke of his concerns.

Awkwardly, Subaru nodded. Reinhard’s strength was indispensable for the attack. However, it was possible that the previous generation Sword Saint could obstruct him.

Wilhelm: [The true nature of the Corpse Soldiers, could you avoid speaking of it to Reinhard?]

Subaru: […Eh?]

Subaru was perplexed, unable to grasp the reason for the abrupt request.

Subaru: [That’s… Don’t tell that guy about Wilhelm-san’s wife, is that what you mean?]

Wilhelm: [Yes, that is correct. For Reinhard… for my grandson, I want to avoid him meeting my dead wife. He will surely blame me. Because the fault is none other than my own.]

Subaru: [That sorta thing, that it’s Wilhelm-san’s fault, that…]

“Is not true”, he wanted to say, but Subaru could not carelessly remark so.

Because the image of Heinkel’s appearance ruining the mood earlier in the morning had appeared in his mind.

There was no credibility. However, it could not be denied. Wilhelm had once accused Reinhard of being the cause of his wife’s death. And he had not rejected such a difficult and unbelievable past.

Wilhelm: [Does Subaru-dono know that the Divine Protection of the Sword Saint is special?]

Subaru: […Honestly speaking, I’d say I know little about it. Maybe the people called Sword Saint all had the Divine Protection and having it means you become incredibly strong. I only have that impression of the Divine Protection…]

Wilhelm: [That understanding is rough around the edges, but it is correct. But if there is a difference between the Divine Protection of the Sword Saint and other Divine Protections… it is the fact that it can be inherited.]

Subaru: [An inherited… Divine Protection…]

At Subaru’s sigh, Wilhelm nodded. The elder swordsman closed his eyes as if recalling a sorrowful past.

Wilhelm: [That Divine Protection has been passed down for generations since the time of its founder, Reid Astrea. The Divine Protection lives on in the bloodline of the Astrea family, and selects one person in the family as the next Sword Saint. My wife’s Divine Protection definitely passed down to Reinhard.]

Subaru: [A Divine Protection that is inherited down the family… Is that so? And when your wife passed away, the Divine Protection transferred to Reinhard.]

Something caught in Subaru’s head as he tried to understand and make sense of it.

After the preceding Sword Saint had been defeated and slain by the White Whale, Reinhard had inherited the Divine Protection. It was a painful past, but one that could also be described a proper passing on.

That flow did not fit at all with what had been said in the argument between the members of the Astrea family this morning.

Wilhelm’s mourning, Heinkel’s mockery, Reinhard’s silence, those were all interfering with the idea of a legitimate succession. And the answer was――

Wilhelm: [It was… at the time of the battle against White Whale.]

Subaru: [Wilhelm-san…]

Wilhelm: [Reinhard received the Divine Protection during the Great Subjugation, which my wife had joined. During that battle, my wife was abandoned by the sword, and could only participate as an ordinary woman.]

――That was the truth of the Astrea family division.

Amidst the great expedition that had been sent out to subjugate the White Whale, the Divine Protection was suddenly passed down to the next generation. And, during the skirmish, the former Sword Saint lost her Divine Protection, having been left behind in that battlefield.

The previous generation, having now become an ordinary person, had still fought against the Witchbeast to protect the many other soldiers that had accompanied her―― And then disappeared.

Wilhelm: [The one that took away the sword from my wife was none other than me. Overruling my wife, who was loved by the sword, forcing her to cast it aside, and turning her into an ordinary woman, I was the one who did it. That… was what called forth the death of my wife.]

Subaru: [――――]

Wilhelm: [The Sword God did not forgive my wife’s betrayal, and so her Divine Protection was taken away while on the battlefield. She could rely only on a single blade. I think of how she must have felt then… It was true that I could not accept it, and defamed Reinhard, whom the Divine Protection had chosen. Driven by impulse, I could not forgive my grandson, even as he wept over the death of his grandmother, bearing a burden too heavy for his shoulders… I regret that now.]

The regret that Wilhelm had revealed to Subaru on the previous night―― He was referring to that mistake.

Even knowing that Reinhard had not done anything wrong, Wilhelm was unable to accept that fact as he mourned his wife’s death. As a result, the Astrea family had split apart.

Wilhelm: [I do not want to repeat it again. Reinhard has no responsibility in my wife’s death. I have no reason to blame my grandson at all.]

And so, he was saying he would bring this to a close himself, instead of revealing it to Reinhard.

That feeling he now understood painfully well from this talk. Even Subaru would wish the same to happen if possible. But the burden Wilhelm carried was too high.

Subaru: [About Crusch-san and your wife… They will be taken care of, Wilhelm-san. And even if I don’t talk about the Corpse Soldiers, you never know where they’ll show up…]

Wilhelm: [That is definitely a needless worry, Subaru-dono.]

Subaru: [Eh…?]

Wilhelm shook his head at Subaru, as the latter was about to point out that it was not certain. And the Sword Demon spoke as his expression twisted into a fearsome grimace.

Wilhelm: [――Because, there is no chance of my wife not coming to meet me.]

Upon returning to the conference hall with Wilhelm, everyone was looking forward to Subaru’s return. Reinhard saw Wilhelm, the grandfather welcoming the reunion with his grandchild with a nod.

While the two stood together along the wall exchanging sidelong glances, Subaru sat down next to Otto at the round table.

Subaru: [I’m sorry for being late. How’s the conversation?]

Otto: [I have just been briefed on how we got here. Natsuki-san, you were above us… how is Crusch-sama doing?]

Subaru: [She isn’t doing well. However, it’s not like we can say that there is no hope already. Once we discuss things after driving out the Witch Cult, we might be able to do something.]

Otto: [Is that so? If that is the case, then that alone is good news.]

Along with Otto stroking his chest, everyone else, having listened to the story, also made a similar gesture of relief. While viewing their reactions, deep down, Subaru wanted to give them a heartfelt apology.

Although it was no lie, it was a statement far removed from reality. There could be a way to save Crusch, which would also be considerably risky for Subaru. If her conditions were similar to Subaru’s, he would expect her chances to rise considerably [1] .]

Subaru: [Either way, Crusch-san won’t return to the frontlines for this battle. Since it seems that Ferris also doesn’t want to be separated from her, I think it’d be best if the relief party were to stay behind at the City Hall. Additionally, there’s the possibility we’ll become unable to communicate wherever we go.]

Anastasia: [The plan to attack the four places simultaneously hasn’t changed. If we use the City Hall as a base, we’ll be able to see each of the control towers from here, since it’s at the center of the city, right? Then…]

With a clap, Anastasia gazed upon everyone’s faces.

Anastasia: [In that case, let’s get to the real deal? ――There are four control towers and four Sin Archbishops. Time to start discussin’ how we’ll allocate our attack forces.]

From the Crusch Camp, the Sword Demon, Wilhelm.

From the Felt Camp, the Sword Saint, Reinhard.

From the Anastasia Camp, the Finest of Knights, Julius, and Captain of the Iron Fang, Ricardo.

From the Emilia Camp, the Spirit Knight, Subaru, and the Shield of Sanctuary, Garfiel.

And, from the Priscilla Camp――

Priscilla: [Me and Al shall move together.]

Subaru: [I can’t believe you’re saying this… you’ll fight as well? You’re a Royal Candidate, aren’t you?]

As he confirmed the forces from each camp, Priscilla boldly raised her own name. When Subaru scowled at that, she snorted at him like one would snort at a fool.

Priscilla: [What if I am a candidate for the throne? Do not lump me in with that fool who is now useless on such a grand day, or with the weak, who do not even possess the strength to battle to begin with. I stand above all others, both at the sword and on the stage, precisely because I am who I am.]

Wilhelm: [You have become difficult to ignore. Surely you are not referring to my master as a fool?]

Priscilla: [I am sure of my ideations. There is a roundabout expression, old soldier. Withdrawing due to a mere trifle, before important matters even take place, is not how the chosen ought to act, it is said.]

Wilhelm and Priscilla clashed with a dangerous presence as soon as they struck dialogue. Even though he would habitually ignore it, Wilhelm could not afford to because of various circumstances. Since Priscilla’s side generally operated in an excessive manner, her hateful language was likewise excessive.

Anastasia: [Yeah yeah, let’s get a move on, both that weaklin’ and fool stuff is all fine by me. We ain’t gonna turn on each other.]

Priscilla: [Oh, that’s boring. I am not so easy to deal with as to obediently listen to the groveling of the weak, you know?]

Anastasia: [I guess it wasn’t like the story was “bout the victory of the weak? If ya don”t show a lil’ bit of generosity, no one’ll follow ya. Everyone here’s getting irritated with’cha. Have some patience.]

Priscilla: [Hmph.]

As Anastasia’s remark struck true, Priscilla did not object, only snorting in reply. Seeing that she had retracted her previous point, Wilhelm, who had been staring daggers at her, also withdrew his own.

Since it was natural to have disagreements between the factions, he made a serious face.

Wilhelm: [Well then, from Priscilla-sama’s faction, we will have Priscilla-sama and Al moving together… May I assume that your boy is not to be taken into consideration?]

Priscilla: [Can something even be done by such a delicate and weak child? That child has been accompanying me throughout merely for the sake of serving me. Naturally, we will put him aside beforehand.]

Wilhelm: [Understood. Then it has been decided that we shall capture the four locations with no less than eight fighters.]

The boy who was Priscilla’s butler―― Schult, drooped his head, and the people at the roundtable were split between those able to fight, and those unable. Leaving out the names of the eight combatants, the non-combatants were Anastasia, Schult, Liliana and Otto, with Crusch and Ferris on the upper floor making six people.

Anastasia: [Before we split up our fighting force, we’ll go ahead and confirm our knowledge of the Sin Archbishops once more. Let’s see, the person who’s met all of “em… that”s just Natsuki-kun, right?]

Subaru: [Yeah, I think so. Although even talking about the Witch Cult’s leaders disgusts me, I’ll try to give you an explanation. I know their abilities, though to a certain extent.]

While gathering everyone’s attention, Subaru stood up and began to speak. About the Witch Cult, which had attacked this city, and the horrible Sin Archbishops who controlled it.

Subaru: [First up, Wrath. This one’s a person who’s completely wrapped in bandages, and calls herself Sirius. I don’t know what she looks like, though I believe she’s probably a woman. She attacks using the chains wrapped around her arms. In addition, it seems like she also uses Fire Magic.]

Reinhard: [She does not seem to pose a significant threat, from what you have said. Is she considerably talented?]

Subaru: [If it’s said by you, then it’s difficult for anyone to answer, Reinhard… Talking about simple fighting strength, then Wilhelm or Julius’d be able to provide sufficient opposition. She seemed to be an equal match with Emilia in pure melee combat. However, she has the Authority of Wrath.]

Reinhard: [An Authority…]

Reinhard frowned to that sound, as he brought his hand to his chin. Subaru continued as he nodded back at him,

Subaru: [The biggest point about a Sin Archbishop’s repulsiveness is their unique ability, their Authority. It’s useless to even think about how it works, as it’s a force that differs from both magic and sorcery. Since every single one of them is powerful, defeating the Authority will be the main focus in defeating a Sin Archbishop.]

Wilhelm: [Subaru-dono has defeated Sloth in the past, did he possess one such Authority?]

Subaru: [Yes. The Archbishop of Sloth’s Authority possessed two abilities, the Unseen Hand, and Sloth. The first was the power to grow many powerful arms which were not only invisible, but also had incredible strength. If someone were to be caught by them, they could easily completely tear their body apart.]

Julius: [Having witnessed them myself, I have also verified their repulsiveness. It is believable that its power would be able to slaughter someone by just squeezing their body.]

Julius followed up on Subaru’s explanation.

During the united front against Petelgeuse, it was because Subaru had lent his own eyes that Julius had been able to see Petelgeuse’s Unseen Hand. He was in an ideal position to reinforce his explanation.

Subaru: [Moreover, Sloth’s other ability enabled him to forcefully snatch away the energy of humans in his range. Whether this was the Authority is difficult to tell, but people with good affinity for Spirits could easily overcome it, becoming immune. This was why me and Julius both easily dealt with it.]

Julius: [The one thing that can be said for both abilities is that, no matter how formidable an opponent that Sin Archbishop was, he could be dealt with by assigning the correct people to the correct places.]

Subaru: [You said an unusually good thing, Julius. That’s pretty much it.]

When Subaru praised him in his own way, Julius looked at Subaru with a discerning though lukewarm gaze. While getting an uncanny feeling from that gaze, Subaru once again continued, after clearing his throat.

Subaru: [So, let’s go back to the discussion about the Authority of Wrath. So far, what we know about Wrath’s power is that it is the sharing and propagation of both emotions and senses.]

Everyone: [Sharing… emotions and senses?]

Since Subaru’s explanation was one they were unable to wrap their heads around, most people in the discussion tilted their heads. Because it was difficult to explain, Subaru had to choose his words carefully.

Subaru: [In other words, Wrath is able to synchronize the emotions of people in its range. It makes one person’s anger into everyone’s anger and one person’s sadness into everyone’s sadness.]

Ricardo: [The heck’s that? I ain’t got an idea what that means.]

Subaru: [If you said this is a power that forces people to read the mood you wouldn’t be off-mark, but it’s not like that. The scary part of this ability is because it can even transmit feelings of hostility. That means Wrath can convey her hostility to those around you, even if they believe her to be their enemy.]

Otto: [So it turns the townspeople in its range against us?]

Subaru: [Exactly.]

By snapping his fingers, Subaru indicated that Otto had drawn the correct conclusion.

Although everyone’s complexion darkened upon hearing that, the problems were not limited to just that.

Priscilla: [Foolish commoner, did you say this Wrath’s power is to share emotions and senses?]

As the first to finally reach an understanding, Priscilla reclined on her seat.

Piercing through Subaru with her crimson eyes, while concealing her mouth with her folding fan,

Priscilla: [If the explanation from just now was about sharing emotions, then sharing senses is a different matter. And if we then assume that my imagination is correct, is it not a considerably repulsive ability?]

Subaru: [I don’t know how you’re imagining it, but it’s the worst. The Authority of Wrath make it possible to share the wounds of people in its range. Wrath’s own wounds are no exception.]

Ricardo: [If even the person herself ain’t no exception… Hey, bro, you’re kiddin’ me, right? Ain’t that the worst? In other words, wouldn’t everyone else die if Wrath were to be killed?]

He had already once experienced that terrible scene, realized by Reinhard’s own hand.

Even if they defeated Sirius, that source of that maliciousness, that act alone would inflict permanent wounds to the people surrounding them. They did not know if anyone dragged into the fight would be fine if they managed to kill her.

Priscilla: [――Interesting.]

To this hopeless information, everyone held their tongue, incapable of coming up with counter-measures. In the midst of that, only one person, only Priscilla was cheerfully warping her cheeks into a sneer.

Priscilla: [Very well. I will separate that foolish Wrath’s head from its body myself. You may rejoice.]

Subaru: [Well, wait, wait, wait! Although I don’t know why you’re so eager, it’s not something you can take so lightly! Were you listening to what I said!?]

Priscilla: [Let us establish that I was listening. Thus, having listened to that, I have declared that I will execute it. They are indeed a disgusting opponent with cowardly methods, so it is appropriate for me to cut them down.]

Without even listening to Subaru’s attempts to stop her, Priscilla looked over everyone while folding her fan to make a sound.

With that sharp gaze and zeal, she overwhelmed even the strongest fighters present.

Priscilla: [If you have stated everything about this Authority, then there is a saying that comes to mind about its mechanism [2] . It is impertinent to think someone other than myself can subjugate the common rabble. The vulgar masses exist entirely for my sake. If some insolent worm dares to tamper with my own property, I shall immediately dispose of them, and launch them out of my garden.]

Al: [P-Princess… Isn’t that a little too much?]

Priscilla: [What sort of foolishness are you saying, Al? I know of your cowardice, but what about such an insolent opponent who dares sour my mood is making you get cold feet? With myself, and the singer as well, there is nothing to fear.]

Al: [I’m not saying it because there is something to fe… Singer?]

When Al tried to stop his master’s irrational behavior, he stopped as he heard an unexpected word. While generously nodding at her follower’s surprise, Priscilla, pointed with her folded fan at Liliana, who sat at the corner of the round table.

As she suddenly became the topic of the discussion, Liliana opened her eyes wide at the fan thrust towards her.

Liliana: [Did mean m-me with that name!? Why are you doing that so suddenly and neglectfully again!?]

Priscilla: [You must not be forgetting about your travels? How much your songs have shaken the hearts of the masses? Here, you can replicate it. In short, you should compete for the emotions of the vulgar masses.]

Liliana: [I just encouraged those who were anxious. You might say that under no circumstances you are overestimating me, but pressuring a weak young girl like me…]

Priscilla: [Hoo. So, if that is your choice, you admit the defeat of the song you have inherited from your ancestors?]

Concluding with a snort, Priscilla’s words, which sounded like she despised Liliana wholeheartedly, made the latter’s expression shift. Before, it had a friendly smile, attempting to parry Priscilla’s words subserviently, but now, it had become serious.

Liliana: [That is, what do you mean…?]

Priscilla: [It seems as if realization has yet to reach you. Does your song, which has been passed down so zealously, seem like it is being sung when the hearts of the people are seeking salvation, as they expose their unsightly cowering? The howling and whining of such losers, is that not all a bunch of wasteful futility? Even a dog’s barking is still better than insisting on such selfish proclamations. Why do you not consider that? It is like a loser’s anthem.]

Liliana: [Ahh, ahh! Are you really saying that much!? Are you really blurting that out!? Fine! I’ll go! I’ve understood alright!? Catching me, the Songstress Liliana, like that! Using such language! A woman will become obsolete with this silence! Like this, even the late Kiritaka-san would come crawling out of his grave with regret!]

Because of Priscilla’s fierce provocation, Liliana became excited as she intensely exploded back at her. With her face becoming a bright red, she violently strummed the musical instrument placed on top of her lap.

Liliana: [If you were thinking about letting even a requiem be sung to comfort Kiritaka-san’s soul, who pitiably fell into the city’s waters, stop it! I am a scramble of emotions? Bring it on! I, the person who has come to inherit the song, and my song, which has dazed the people of the world, will we lose to something like an incomprehensible power!? We don’t even understand the song’s power, after all! Grrr! [3] ]

Schult and Otto hurriedly dragged down Liliana, who had become excited, performing while lying sprawled on top of the round table. Looking far away from the corner of the room where Liliana had started playing her music, Subaru shifted his focus to Priscilla.

Subaru: [Her manageability aside, you seem sure of her success. But even if you’re right, to just throw her into this when you don’t know her chances…]

Priscilla: [I am not planning to lose. Everything in this world is at my own mercy. Besides, it is because I was together with that singer that I have come so far as to this City Hall. After taking her around with me, I recognized that singer’s usefulness. And precisely because of that, I have again decided to take her with me.]

Subaru: [Are you saying that Liliana has the power to oppose Sirius?]

Priscilla: [It would be my defeat if it were not for that singer. And something like my defeat is impossible in this world. Therefore, that singer must come. Need I explain this any further?]

Because none of the insufficient explanations were feasible, it steadily became unbearable for Subaru. However, it was Schult who raised his hand instead, attempting to follow-up on Priscilla’s remarks.

The butler boy’s adorable eyes quivered as he chose his words with utmost care.

Schult: [U-uh, well… I think that it’s true that Liliana’s song has a special power. It’s true that they were released from anxiety or irritation when listening to Liliana-sama’s song… That is also what we learned from several refuge shelters we went to before we came here.]

Subaru: [You went around visiting shelters and let Liliana sing to them?]

Priscilla: [I believe I have stated such.]

Subaru: [You didn’t say that!]

Even the insufficiency of her explanation was excessive.

While being troubled by Priscilla’s attitude, Subaru turned his head to Reinhard.

Subaru: [Hey, Reinhard. Do you know of an innate ability that can see people’s powers… Or rather, their Divine Protections. Can things like Divine Protections be seen?]

Reinhard: [I think there is a Divine Protection that can analyze others’ Divine Protections. I have heard that the owner of the Divine Protection of Judgement can see them. It seems they are not located in Lugunica, but in Vollachia. I see, so we want to check what kind of Divine Protection Liliana-sama has? It will certainly become one of our main questions.]

When he understood the purpose of Subaru’s question, Reinhard went deep into thought.

He just tried to ask because there was nothing to lose, and even he knew that he had asked something unreasonable from Reinhard. Subaru shook his head to the pondering red-haired youth and continued with a “Never mind”,

Subaru: [Although I strangely expected something, since you’d said that you’d heard all kinds of incredible things, it’s not like you’d be convenient to that extent. It’s fine. For now, we can test Liliana’s song to check whether it can cancel the Authority of Wrath somehow…]

Reinhard: [You don’t need to worry about it, Subaru―― I have received it now.]

Subaru: [Wha?]

Patting Subaru’s shoulder as he tried to propose an experiment with Liliana’s song, Reinhard smiled. After that, while narrowing his blue eyes, he gazed at Liliana, still performing in the corner of the room. And then,

Reinhard: [What a surprise. Liliana holds the Divine Protection of Telepathy.]

Subaru: [I’m more surprised at you right now, rather than the Divine Protection. Eh? What did you say just now? Did you say that you received it? What did you receive, the treasure that is children?]

Reinhard: [Subaru, this is not a situation to be making fun of. I have been able to confirm Liliana-sama’s Divine Protection. The Divine Protection of Telepathy is, so to speak, a Divine Protection which transmits the owner’s thoughts to others. It is a Divine Protection which primarily transmits trivial thoughts to someone the owner has a close bond with… a song, huh? I had not even thought of something like that.]

While Reinhard was honestly admiring Liliana, Subaru’s jaw dropped after gazing upon his profile.

He had always said that Reinhard’s power was already a cheat, this guy, who was said to be beyond superhuman, was being loved way too much by the gods.

The Divine Protection he needed, that Divine Protection which he thought of, had arrived at his hands upon merely wishing it.

Subaru: [――――?]

Having managed to reach a point with his thoughts, Subaru felt trapped between a rock and a hard place.

Reinhard could acquire a Divine Protection he thought of, if he wished for it. At least, what had happened to Reinhard today, could be expressed that way. Though that in and of itself was an extremely and reassuringly enviable power.

Subaru could not put it into words, because he could be mistaken about it.

The members of the Wrath capture group had been decided―― Priscilla, Al and Liliana.

Translation notes:

[1] Probably referring to the conditions needed for the Dragon’s Blood injected by Capella to not be rejected or something like that. It is possible that Subaru is thinking about other people that were not completely rejected by the Dragon’s blood, using them to absorb Crusch’s curse, but it is not one-hundred percent clear.

[2] “Mechanism” here is written as “カラクリ”, a reference to Karakuri puppets (for more information, see here).

[3] Probably somewhat inaccurate in some places here. Liliana’s manner of speech feels weird in general.
