Liliana: [Eep! Apologies, I misspoke!]

I wanted to decrease the distance by telling her of a shortcut, but it was a failure! Speaking of which that “oh” was too scary! The gaze of a beast… No, the gaze of a beast that hunts beasts!”

Priscilla: [Follow my instructions, and nothing shall go wrong.]

Liliana: [Hehe, this lowly one will now completely obey Priscilla-sama!]

Following Priscilla-sama’s directions, after this we took several winding routes. For some reason, during this not a single person was encountered. Time was running out!

Liliana: [Let’s be cheery as we walk and sing?]

Priscilla: [You said that song chooses neither place nor its audience. But even if you do not opt for others to listen, others have the right to choose the song.]

Liliana: [——?]

Priscilla: [Allow your throat to rest for a time… it shall not be long until your opportunity to sing arrives.]

Liliana: [Ahhhhh.]

Like that, Priscilla-sama’s eyes held a hint of having predicted something. That twisting and turning manner of talking felt suffocating to someone like me who took straightforwardness as a duty, but I shut my mouth and kept silent.

And so, this odd and silent tour through the city――

Priscilla: [――Here.]

Having paused her footsteps, what Priscilla-sama was regarding was one of the shelters in the city―— the Convention Center of Second Street. If the City Hall at the center was the a place of assembly for the entire city, then the Convention Center of each numbered street was where each of their standpoints would be discussed.

Kiritaka-san was not only the manager of the Third Street convention center, but he also had influence in the operation of the City Hall.

Liliana: [Oh, being unexpectedly taken somewhere safe! Quite honestly, I was even a bit scared on where I was going to be taken!]

Priscilla: [Hm? What are you saying? Hurry and get inside, blabbermouth.]

Since this was a Convention Center, inside were probably one or several extraordinary people. Besides, because it was a place where the people living in the area had escaped to, it was at the same time place to heal the loneliness of not seeing anyone—―

???: [You, the fuck are you saying? I’ll kill you!]

This lovely daydream dissipated like fog after being met by a cry of rage.

An enraged roar filled with real murderous intent, with no intent of letting off those words as a simple strongly worded threat.

Those uncouth men had cast aside their usual frivolity, to exude genuine killing intent―― I am a bard, but also a woman, and having wandered through so many places, taking not only safe paths, but having travelled dangerous ones as well… This was what was known as “rage”.

That which could not remain unfaced, the Wrath that accompanied violence and murder.

Liliana: [P-Priscilla-sama…? This is…]

I was about to break down, and without being aware of it, I clung onto Priscilla-sama beside me, but she avoided my outstretched hand, glancing around the convention chamber with an extremely listless gaze.

On my knees, with disbelief, I surveyed the scene that Priscilla-sama was examining.

――The sound of a scream.

Inside the meeting room, the crowd shoved each other and flung insults, voicing loud words of hatred.

They must have numbered fifty… no, a hundred? Two hundred?

In summary, a mass of people pushed over those beside them indiscriminately, male and female and old and young together.

Insulting each other… those insults tinged with hostility and malice, displaying violent behavior, full of intent to wound and kill. Many had fallen and shed blood, and, in the corner of the convention chamber, there were the quivering forms of children.

What in the world was happening?

Priscilla: [Hmph… Amidst such a mass of random people, finding just Schult is indeed difficult.]

Casting me aside in my astonishment and sense of defeat, Priscilla harrumphed, face calm as ever in the face of those annoying screams.

…No, but, this situation was a disaster? Why was she so unaffected?

Priscilla: [It is certain that this kind of event has occurred through the city. Perhaps you may have been too slow to realize it―― as I did avoid a path of trouble.]

Liliana: [Avoid…!?]

After saying it out loud, I finally understood the meaning of those words.

The reason that Priscilla-sama had gone out of her way to take the long way around―— was to avoid those where people were coming into conflict with one another.

I alone had failed to notice, while leisurely complaining about things like the lack of people――!

Liliana: [Pushing and fighting each other like this… Does this have to do with the Witch Cult?]

Priscilla: [Were this just bickering because of their anxiety, I would have dismissed it as the extreme of the masses’ stupidity, but that is not the case. These people… No, the area of this entire city has been covered in some asinine power. This is the result.]

I couldn’t understand the most important parts of Priscilla-sama’s words. But at least I realized that the people hurting each other right now, were not doing so of their own intent.

Liliana: [Why, why am I untouched? Do I have the unique ability to counter something like this… Or rather, did I awaken in this moment!?]

Priscilla: [‘Tis the majesty of mine Sun Disk. Without it, perhaps you would have been swept along with it… But more importantly.]

Priscilla-sama narrowed her eyes, surveying those who shoved at each other. With the same gaze that she’d given me a “Oh——?” with. Which was to say that it was terrifying. Looking at those two eyes, her next words would presumably be equally terrifying.

That presumption was right.

Priscilla: [To find someone in this commotion, is practically the dream of a madman. With a small display of intimidation, they shall shut their mouths.]

Liliana: […Eh?]

As her words fell, Priscilla-sama casually “drew a sword from the air”. No, to say it like that was wrong. To be more precise, the light became a sword?

Priscilla: [Be enchanted by the brilliance of my Yang Sword——]

The sword which Priscilla-sama held was decorated with a beautiful floral pattern, dyed in red from pommel to blade. Radiating sunlight from within Priscilla-sama’s hands, illuminating the entire convention chamber… How dazzling! How wondrous! A degree of illumination that regular light was incapable of reaching, scorching the eyes as if it were the sun. Kya, kyaaaaaaaaa――!

From up close, how damaging to my two eyes!

Ducking away to keep my distance, planning to raise a complaint to Priscilla-sama―— And then I noticed it.

The convention center had grown quiet, the people fighting now focusing on Priscilla-sama. But of course, if such a blinding light appeared, it was only natural that everyone’s quarrel would end.

And just when their hands and voices stopped,

???: [Priscilla-sama―― Hk!!]

A boy who had been sobbing near the wall approached, running with cheeks reddened as he jumped towards Priscilla-sama. Priscilla-sama caught the boy directly from the front, stroking his peach-colored hair with gentleness.

Priscilla: [To be so troublesome, only you alone could receive my attention like this. Schult, have you realized what a fool you’ve been?]

The sight of the boy having his hair so gently stroked was surprising.

No, Priscilla-sama had come all the way to look for this child, so I’d assumed she cared very much for him, but witnessing this showed that it was not the case. It felt very uncomfortable, because Priscilla-sama’s attitude was frigid. Thinking about it nearly made my neck twist.

However, it couldn’t be assumed that with such a spectacle, it would be easy to escape. After all, we’d become the target of the attention of this convention center!

The enraged crowd was now focusing on the radiant Priscilla-sama. And in addition, they had just noticed that the shining blade had disappeared.

Liliana: [Priscilla-sama, where did the sword from just now go?]

Responding to my question, Priscilla-sama looked towards the ones who gazed at her. Her gaze was calm as always… Which was to say, apathetic.

Priscilla: [What are you lot staring at me for, you fools without reason? It is natural that you commoners worship my beauty, but understand time and place plus your own position. The first and most polite action would be to kneel.]

Liliana: [Why are you provoking them——!?]

Pressing Schult into her chest, with a fierce expression Priscilla-sama pointed at the ground, ordering everyone present to fall to their knees. Although as expected, the crowd, much more short-tempered than usual, became enraged and rushed forward.

The ground rumbled violently, and I hurriedly dropped my bottom to the ground as I tried to curl up. However, Priscilla-sama remained standing there. No, wait.

Man: [This woman! What kind of joke…]

Priscilla: [First of all is you―― At least soar with grace.]

The large man attempted to grab Priscilla-sama in a fit of rage, but she immediately dodged aside, shoving his broad chest away.

A man who seemed to have twice my weight was blown away like a leaf. No, really, that easy, not exaggerating.

Man: [――Hk!?]

The body of the man flew away in the direction of the mass of people rushing in, causing a dramatic and pitiful sight. One after another they were pushed back and knocked over, toppling like dominos.

And so, due to that initial loss, the crowd’s momentum came to a halt. The legs of those lined in front trembled upon seeing Priscilla-sama’s strength.

Priscilla: [As you can see, were it what I will, all of you could be cut down with ease. Although it is bothersome, if you desire to attack, approach in turn. For only today I shall spare the time to thoroughly respond to your desires.]

Refugees: [————]

Priscilla-sama spoke in a regal tone, glaring at those surrounding her.

That said, there was no one who would approach after hearing those words. The enraged demeanor of before went who knows where… Or rather, the rage lingered on in everyone’s hearts. It was merely that they had yet to lose their minds enough to direct it at Priscilla-sama.

Priscilla: [It appears that there are none. Well then, there is no longer meaning in remaining here. My attendant has been found safe and sound. You lot are free to enjoy yourselves, once I have departed.]

Liliana: [Eh!?]

As soon as Priscilla-sama finished speaking, she took the hand of the crying Schult, striding toward the exterior of the Convention Center with lavish steps. She’s on her way, but is this really how she’s going to go? Is this really okay?

Liliana: [Ah, but! Just leaving everyone here like this…]

Priscilla: [After my departure, the quarrel will start anew… It would not be surprising if it ultimately led to slaughter. However, do I have any reason to terminate it?]

Liliana: [That is…]

It might be the case, but was it really fine like this? No matter how you looked at it, just leaving them behind was far too terrible.

Liliana: [P-Priscilla-sama is a candidate in the Royal Selection…]

Priscilla: [Even for me, there are things that I cannot accomplish. Without question, I am indeed in that annoying position, but to use it as an excuse is too forced.]

Liliana: [Guh…!]

She stopped me before I could finish, and I was no longer able to raise voice to any retorts!

But, but, once we’re gone, the quarrel would start anew. Could I really do something so ruthless such as escaping?

Something like this, I——

Priscilla: [Or is that to say, you’ll solve it?]

Liliana: [——Eh!?]

As if provoking me, Priscilla-sama folded her arms over her chest. Was it a quirk, to raise her chest like this?

That violent cleavage could be seen with ease. I brushed my hand over my chest. Flat. I stared down at that hand.

That palm was wet with cold sweat.

Liliana: [Is it… possible?]

Priscilla: [It matters not if you do it—— If that is what you believe, then it shall merely amount to wasted effort.]

If you don’t have the ability to sing, but yet think you do, then, so be it. If thinking that songs had no power, such a line of thinking was not wrong.

I’m sure I do, I’m sure I do, I’m sure I don’t――!

Taking up the Lyulyre from my back, I gripped it tightly with both hands.

The people who had yet to become my audience, people who had stored all their rage in their core, were watching! How dare they! When clearly from now, I was about to sing!

——To hope that, when everyone savored the sound of song together joyously, that they would not fight!

Priscilla: [Schult, wait for a little. You shall witness something entertaining.]

Schult: [Understood.]

Priscilla-sama and Schult stood behind my figure as I held the Lyulyre.

I don’t need to see what they looked like, ugh, despicable, it was obvious without looking!

The girl, Liliana! Wandering the world with only a Lyulyre, a bard who forever held heroes in her heart! If she failed here, both the woman and her life would be ruined!

Return to sanity, then show me a frenzy! If this takes away time that would be spent fighting, it’s all the more meaningful!

Liliana: [————]

Fingers sliding across the strings of the Lyulyre, reproducing a movement that was completely bound with familiarity. For many years, for many tens of thousands of times, for as long as I can remember, these fingertips have played these notes.

For me, to sing was as natural as drawing breath, as natural as exhaling laughter when encountering amusement, so it was far too difficult to remember when it had started…

Throat opening, diaphragm inhaling, rhythm intertwining  with the melody I had started playing.

What I sang were all the words, all the feelings that emerged in my mind in the moment. All of those were overlaid atop the melody that would surface in my mind in a similar fashion.

Liliana: [————]

When creating a new song, although I would say “Inspiration flashes”, to truly say that it was inspiration flashing was rather absurd.

In other words, it was no sudden flash, but a discovery. Calling it that would perhaps be more suitable. In this instant, the melody and words emerging in my mind were things hidden within this world in origin.

Discovering a melody somehow forgotten by the world.

Stumbling across it by coincidence, taking it up by chance, as if a gift had descended from the skies―― a tune concealed in the corners of the world. I have all along regarded it as such.

And thus I had told Priscilla-sama that even without learning anything whatsoever, music could be enjoyed. If one completely gave up all their wisdom, all their knowledge, it would be the same.

Because music was sung, even if not by a human being.

Ever heard birdsong? Ever heard a chorus of cicadas? Ever quietly listened to the wind sweeping across a stream, felt it raise a murmured voice?

Did they also have humanity? Perhaps, or rather, no, they shouldn’t have. At the very least I think they don’t! I don’t!

From the sun that illuminates all, from the moon that waxes and wanes, from the earth that diffuses its aroma, from the firewood that crackles, have you ever felt music? I have! I’ve felt it—— that is proof that music permeates this world.

That is proof that the world is constructed by music, this world is filled with music, this world is connected by music.

Liliana: [————]

Us bards merely borrow songs from this world filled with music. Music that was originally present everywhere, can be made slightly easier to notice with a little meddling.

Without shyness, without apology, we selfishly enjoy this exquisite melody alone.

It doesn’t matter if you think of it like that. It doesn’t matter that we think of it like that.

However, isn’t this music something lovely?

There is joy in sharing with strangers that which is interesting, and that which is fun. There is joy in laughing out loud when something is funny and when something is amusing.

Music is like that. Music allows you to do that.

Because the entire world is singing, who would scold those who sing?

Come, immerse, immerse, immerse your all. Come, devote, devote, devote your all.

Submerge in joy, fill your heart with glee, be imprisoned by happiness!

Use not only your ears, but also your eyes, nose, skin, heart, soul, all of those to “join” with the “music”!

Frenzy swallowed the audience, washing away the extreme Wrath in one wave.

Swaying in dance, raising their voice, like that, they became one with the performance. Should their gazes overlap with those around them, they would notice they were now sharing the same feelings.

Of course. Music has always been by your side, an ever-present comrade, from birth to death. You’ve seen it, heard it, felt it.

We are always here, calling for such music——!

Liliana: [So, hell yeah! You weren’t quiet at all, but thank you for the attention—— Ahhhhh!]

Singing on, uwaaaah!

In addition, the City Hall would be the place where the brains of the city would gather! Surely Kiritaka-san would be there, in an emergency like this, he can be relied on!]

Right. Lust currently occupied the City Hall. Which meant that if the City Hall was serving as a base, the operation would have been stunted from the start.

And so, certainly the City Hall’d be completely empty…

Leaving the Convention Center took a while, since the people became anxious again after the second broadcast, and they had to be calmed down with my song. Frankly, that performance could only be called unintentional.

No matter what was sung, any behavior lacking reason could not be included. However, at its basis, adding extraneous impurity to the song was not permissible.

Becoming intoxicated by the song, becoming immersed in the song―― to sing with these feelings was what I had intended. But if it turned out that way in the end, if I, the singer, began to think of song like that, I would no longer be sincere when singing. After leaving the Convention Center, with steps which were as always self-assured, only I shakily followed behind. Rather than calling it a loss of assurance, perhaps it was a loss of identity?

Without doubt I existed for singing, but was it myself who was requested of by these circumstances, was it the song, or was it the consequence of the song?

Although all three originated in me, the three were not in sync. I couldn’t help but feel that way.

——But that feeling of satisfaction was short-lived, as the Hero’s recklessness had led to a suicide mission with Priscilla-sama!

Yay! There would still be a chance to sing! Well then!

The licks of the fire were so red that they even appeared to be white. As if to reject any description of ‘wavering’, mournful light scattered forth, proving how terrifying that heat was.

That which was being scorched was the waterway, even the surface of the water itself. Water which should have been fire’s natural opposing enemy, water which should have been the opposite of fire, this was a sight which overturned such natural notions.

The flame of Priscilla-sama’s Yang Sword could ignite even water.

And in addition—— all of the waterways surrounding the courtyard, simultaneously!

Sirius: [This is…]

Before the sight which did not belong to this world, the bandaged freak—— No, let’s stop that at once. Wrath, indeed, even Wrath was lost for words. This couldn’t be described by words like “smoldering”, but flame did exist. It stopped the steps of the crowd attempting to cross the waterway, nailing them in place.

That was a matter of course. That moths fly into a flame was nature’s decree, but humans held wisdom and instinct that was capable of resisting such an end.

Priscilla: [Even if solely in form, your use of love as an excuse to name this not as dominance became a critical weakness. If this is a force that can be overcome by obeying one’s instinct, something of this degree could never stop someone in their steps.]

Taking anew a stance with the Yang Sword, like that, Priscilla-sama ridiculed the silent Wrath. Ridicule, mockery, derision, contempt—— that was all I could say, you malicious expression of beauty.

Ahhh, something so important, I had overlooked. I had all along only been watching Priscilla-sama’s dashing expression of severity, although that was beautiful in its own right, indeed it could not compare.

Clearly, there could be nothing more beautiful than this malice, which yielded a beauty that caused shivers.

Priscilla: [Even if free will is curbed, if instinct is not restrained as well, this is precisely what you shall see. Seems as if no one is willing to go to the extent of being consumed by flame, which speaks loudly of the love that you speak of.]

Sirius: [————]

Priscilla: [This is the result of the cheap love that you have pronounced. Such a scene is precisely what is defined as “ridiculous”, Sin Archbishop. How truly incapable you are of measuring up to that exaggerated title.]

With mockery, with momentum, Priscilla-sama continuously chastised the silent Wrath.

My hands couldn’t help but moisten with sweat, gaze flicking over to the scene. The thought of whether Priscilla-sama was truly so incredible, which had persisted until now, had been completely swept away.

Priscilla-sama was incredible! Priscilla-sama was powerful!

Priscilla: [In the end, expressions such as “love becomes one” are mere superficiality. My peerless self is at the very peak, and thus, no matter how much you struggle, commoners like you could never become one with me.]

Wahhh, Priscilla-sama was amazing! Although she was amazing, but huh, wasn’t this situation weird?

Priscilla: [Even if you are capable of approaching me, to catch up with me is absolutely impossible. The love that you speak of has already been defeated, has it not? And thus, ranting of becoming one is naught but wild words.]

Liliana: [Uhm, Priscilla-sama, it’s about time…]

Priscilla: [Even as a misconception, to become one is far too erroneous. Born as something else, and wanting to become one is a denial of the self. Why would something you yourself lack have any value when drawn closer? What is flawed is the entire premise, and to act according to this incorrectness is to exist in commonness—— Something so vulgar.]

Liliana: [Uwaaah! Why such an absolute rejection!?]

Oh no! Clearly because blood had rushed to the head! Clearly!

Even if Priscilla-sama’s blood had rushed to her head, perhaps she was still able to do something, but for someone insignificant like me, the preference would be for you to refrain from doing this, and end it as quickly as possible!

Perhaps she had noticed, for Wrath, being faced with Priscilla-sama’s words, had wordlessly bowed her head, immersed in silence. Well, to have been met with so many arrogant words, anyone would be infuriated. Talking back felt like it would bring a multitude of words in response, so even infuriated, silence would be kept.

It could be said this had turned to be entirely uncomfortable, so if possible, if Priscilla-sama could just beat down on Wrath-san and call it a victory, that’d be a relief.

Priscilla: [Fool. To do so would mean everyone but myself would be bisected, is that not correct? Although the sight of a city stained red with blood would be appealing to see at least once, there is no need to bring it about in my country. Well then, this first opportunity should be delayed, and likewise, you should fulfill your use.]

Ah—— right, that was the case. In the first place, that was my duty.

Being under the influence of Wrath, the pain and even wounds inflicted on that person would be shared by others. My song was required precisely for being rid of such a condition.

Liliana: [After seeing the actual scene, I’ve actually become quite unsettled, so who knows if my song will actually work!]

Priscilla: [If unwilling, your head, and those of that crowd, are free to fall alongside that being’s. If you feel that such a scene is best avoided, without fail, place your heart into song.]

I continued to clutch the Lyulyre, shrinking back now that such heights of responsibility had been cast upon me. The burning waterway was keeping the crowd away, yet the crowd remained as hostages, and the method to free them was my song! Priscilla-sama’s duty was——?

Liliana: [So that’s to say, that’s to say, until I’ve used my song to sway the captivated crowd, Priscilla-sama’s duty is to keep me from dying, isn’t that how it feels!?]

Priscilla: [If you die, well, all that’s left is to sever their heads as soon as possible. Best to think of it as all their lives being wrapped around your throat.]

Liliana: [Ukya——!]

Priscilla: [Such slow understanding. Now then… Hm.]

After I had covered my face and cried out loudly, Priscilla-sama’s expression changed. Priscilla-sama now regarded Wrath, who had maintained her silence until now, with brows frowned,.

With an uneasy premonition, I snuck a peek in that direction through the gaps in my fingers.

Sirius: [——How amusing.]

Liliana: [Eh?]

Sirius: [How amusing, such joy. Perhaps this should be called delight. No, perhaps it is not possible to name this ascendant feeling in my heart.]

Speaking with a low voice, languidly, Wrath raised her face. On that face obscured by bandages, impassioned and assertive eyes swept back and forth. They gazed at Priscilla-sama, at the wall of flame, at me, wait no, please, don’t look at me!

Sirius: [My apologies, I was scattered for a moment there. However, thank you. I have awoken. You are correct, expressions such as “desiring to effortlessly achieve understanding” were far too selfish.]

Was that a smile and laugh? The monster’s mouth split open horizontally, revealing a smile which showed white teeth, the monster laughed. Intimately, as if welcoming a friend or family, having been rejected like that, and despite that!

Sirius: [Please allow me to once more introduce myself. I am a Sin Archbishop of the Witch Cult, representing Wrath, Sirius Romanée-Conti. I do hope my affairs can be taken to heart.]

She bowed, politely giving a greeting.

And then the bandaged freak—— the monster, Sirius, undid the chains on her arm. Rotating wrists, untying bondage, lengthening the reach of the chain, the chains rotated, slashing through air, layer upon layer of metallic sounds becoming malice itself, cutting through the atmosphere.

Even so, the monster wore a smile.

Sirius: [This is the Ordeal! Indeed, this is without doubt, the Ordeal! In this city, in which I reunited with my husband once again, to meet him once more, to express love in words, the Ordeal has descended upon me! The correctness of my love is proven by fate, which had me meet that person once more! You are the Ordeal that stands in the way of that!!] [4]

With a ringing voice, with the flourish of a maiden in love, the monster ceaselessly waved her chains, shortening the distance to here in one breath. Ohno ohno, just being brushed would mean death for me.

Priscilla: [Quell the crowd, that creature’s opponent shall be me. At the very least, do not perform anything insolent.]

Liliana: [Uwah? Priscilla-sama!?]

Priscilla: [You are to prepare your song—— Should a shadow fall across the Yang Sword, I shall, no matter what, sever that abomination’s head. And so, before that happens.]

Even the limit she gave was arbitrary——!

As if not hearing a trace of my words, Priscilla-sama and the monster Sirius exchanged opening blows, beginning their battle!

Listening to the fierce collisions of chain and sword, I thought that I had to at least do something. Rather than calling it a sense of responsibility, it was more like being urged onward by some indistinct feeling, but in any case I began running toward the wall of flame on the waterway. Hopelessly.

Run faster! Damn it, I hadn’t even though of anything!

Liliana: [And so for now, please listen for a moment—— Hoshin of the Wilderness, uhhhhh, hot!?]

Nearing the boundary of the waterway, I had prepared to whisk those in hearing range into a whirl of song, but immediately upon drawing close, my face was destroyed by flame!

It can’t! Really can’t! Although forcefully trying to put on the air of a performance, Priscilla-sama’s wall of flame was beyond hot! Extremely hot! Hotter than was normal!

But without drawing close to this extent, no one would be able to see for real!

Liliana: [Owww, hothothot——! My hands will be scorched! If my throat or lungs are burned, this battle will be lost… Wait, huh?]

Having been licked by a tongue of flame, while regretting my carelessness for having gotten my face that scorched beyond repair, I discovered that the hands that should have been swallowed by fire were unharmed… Or rather, even the wooden Lyulyre hadn’t been destroyed by the blaze, which was to say?

Liliana: [This… is no ordinary fire…?]

Nono, from the start it’d been evident that this was no ordinary fire, but this seemed to be one which did not burn? Although the heat was scorching, it would not burn?

In that case, then this! Would be crossed through in no time, wouldn’t it!? What was this!? Was this a bluffing imitation of a fire, only meant to scare people off!?

Coming along was indeed a failure of a decision—— Ah!!

Translation Notes:

[1] – Priscilla was calling her the arrogant “kisama” (貴様) again in the City Hall, which was different from before (going around the shelters), but after the City Hall, Priscilla calls her the more polite “sonata” (そなた). Man, this difference really translates poorly in English.

[2] – Back to the arrogant “kisama” (貴様).

[3] – As in, “gap moe”. In this case, merely a contradiction in exhibited characteristics, or contrast, really.

[4] – Albeit the Kanji used is the same as the one used for Echidna’s Trials, I am using Ordeal out of my own wish to distinguish them somehow, much like was done for Pete’s “試練” in Arc 4 Chapter 72.

--- Chapter 66: The Stage of Liliana Masquerade ---

JAPANESE WEB NOVEL SOURCE

※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※　※

Liliana: [Gah! What a disaster! This fire is way too hot! Way too, way too hot! Seven times hotter than regular fire! Being burnt by this would mean dying with seven times the agony!]

The white wall of flame now stood before me! Since it was a flame that would not burn me if touched, but miraculously appeared to only let off waves of heat, in truth, being able to withstand the pain would mean that it was possible to breach it.

And so, to keep the truth hidden from everyone, too scared to rush forth, I pretended to be someone writhing in agony because of the flames, to convey to everyone surrounding the waterway of the dangers of the flame!

Well, even with everyone’s mental state being a tad insane, it seemed their instinct had left them with the notion that flames were dangerous. So my desperate act was perhaps not of much use, but even so, not performing it was something I couldn’t justify.

Liliana: [It was easy for Priscilla-sama to order me to sing and dance to snatch the peoples’ hearts back, but—]

In all honesty, snatching spirits back, rahhhhh! As a mood to sing with, it would completely serve as an obstacle, and it went against the principle of song in the first place.

As a result of frantic singing, to say that something airy would be left within the hearts of those who listened, that very something would be the natural intent of the heavens. And if they felt something in that intent of the heavens, and gave a tip because of that, the world would be so kind and gentle!

First of all, singing with the attitude of wanting to earn a tip would be an ulterior motive that would make its way into the song. A song with such a desire contained within was not what I wanted.

And so, couldn’t this plan be said to be a losing battle from the very start?

Liliana: [Thinking back on it, although this life was short-lived, days filled with tumultuousness were experienced. Father and Mother, even though there was resentment when I cast myself into this cruel world at the age of thirteen after declaring my independence… Now I’m only grateful that I was born so cute. Although I was quite the unfilial daughter, the gratitude and wrath I felt towards the two of you was something integral to my every way… Guhhhh! Ahhhh, hothothot, a neverending summer, huhuhu!]

While speaking of gratitude toward parents and various other whims, I felt a sign that those on the other side of the wall of flame were about to approach, and once more put on an act of overheating. I was really hoping the bunch that was unable to read the atmosphere would react appropriately!

Butbut, no matter how realistic my performance was, it would fall through sooner or later. And then if it were exposed, there would be no way to contain Priscilla-sama’s extremely limited temper.

And then, it’d be no good! It’d be over!

Sirius: [Oh my, oh my, do you have the leisure to see? The girl you have expectations of is wearing an expression as if there is no path forward, is she not? I can clearly feel the sorrow and exhaustion plaguing that child’s spirit. Do you not feel sorry for her, weeping and aching?]

Priscilla: [Not in the slightest.]

Without regard to me, who had begun to clutch my head and count down the seconds to the end, in the center of the courtyard surrounded by waterways that had been set alight, an exchange of dialogue between Priscilla-sama and that freak Sirius was in progress.

That said, the dialogue was entirely composed of Priscilla-sama mercilessly turning a deaf ear to Sirius’s modest words! And setting aside Sirius’s manner of speech for now, the figure now rotating the chains of both arms could not be called steady in the slightest.

Air being slashed, atmosphere being sliced, the path of metal chains being swung through the air changed freely! Tumbling, prancing, front, back, left, right, it struck toward Priscilla-sama like a metal snake!

The extending and retracting chain produced an ear-piercing level of sound, continuous to the point that it seemed to me that Priscilla-sama had been enclosed in a cage of iron.

The stone steps that took direct hits from the chain were exploded mercilessly, were caved in, were scraped, which spoke volumes of the power. If direct contact with the skin were made, the result would be hideousness akin to that caused by a snake’s fangs and tongue! If the recipient were someone whose skin was white and delicate like Priscilla-sama, their cruelty would be even more pronounced!

Butbut, Priscilla-sama in fact ferociously attacked that metal chain——!

Priscilla: [Tumultuous and yet tasteless noise, the heedlessness which is projected indiscriminately, a base weapon from which even a hint of elegance cannot be felt, superficial and yet unseemly idle talk… Such a number of measures that incur my anger were prepared as entertainment. The disrespect you show me is rather admirable.]

Liliana: [Priscilla-sama is awesomeeeeeee!!]

However, Priscilla-sama wore an expression of boredom, waving the Yang Sword to welcome the chains that approached from every direction. But, never mind front, side, top and bottom, how could a blow from somewhere unseen like the back possibly be intercepted?

In addition, perhaps this power was unique to the Yang Sword, but whenever the Yang Sword deflected the chain, the point of contact would be scorched white. That firepower did not seem negligible, and the chain would burn and become gradually shorter and shorter! If this were repeated, for sure, she would run out of chains!

Liliana: [Heheheh——! Priscilla-sama, please be rid of it, rid of it, rid of it——!]

Priscilla: [Regarding that, that is what is known as candid thoughts which forget to cover eyes. Although exposure of that level is presumably difficult for a commoner, it certainly inspires more pleasure than boring, twisted theory. Well, merely one person in this world would be enough.]

Liliana: [Ehhh~!? Just now, you praised me, that was a praise, right!? To consider that praise would be fine, right!? I’m about to feel happy you know!! Amazing, truly amazing. Yay!]

Even if I were to be told that it hadn’t been praise, I’d already felt happy, so it was too late!

Accepting my support, Priscilla-sama also gained more momentum. She continued to advance, ceaselessly burning the chain away. The imposing atmosphere seemed to overwhelm even the Sin Archbishop of Wrath, and I was now entirely just waiting! It was a yam in the oven!

Liliana: [No, wait a second, Priscilla can’t solve this so effortlessly! If that happens, we’ll also be offed effortlessly, ehhhhhh~!?]

Priscilla: [Mhm, that is indeed the case. Too fun a time was being had.]

How dangerous! If I hadn’t stopped her just now, she was going to go for it!

As Priscilla-sama stopped, Sirius, having been overwhelmed, took this chance to leap far backward. Although Priscilla-sama was out of the norm, the opponent that was meeting her match was none other than a Sin Archbishop, perhaps it should be asked whether or not humans were able to move in such a way?

Sirius: [It is rare for someone to be so stubborn in not opening their hearts even though I have spoken so much. For what reason is your soul so tightly closed?]

After gaining some distance, Sirius flickered her gaze to her two arms as she spoke. That chain had already been trimmed short, but as the freak yapped, she rotated her wrists to restore its length. It seemed that many chains were wound firmly on her arms, but whether they were cutting off circulation was unknown.

Sirius: [Everyone’s hearts have openings, some greater, others smaller. To live means to have feelings, no matter the color of the feeling that peeks out from there, they are something every person possesses… Even a feeling you have staunchly bore all along can be understood, as long as it is revealed.]

Priscilla: [————]

Sirius: [You too have a soul that can anguish, feelings that disorient. Although unwaveringly keeping weaknesses hidden from others is a condition to living strongly… there is only so much that can be reached on one’s lonesome. What one person can achieve on their lonesome has a limit. After becoming one with other people, new peaks can be discovered. In order to allow others to see that place, mutual understanding and shared feelings are necessary.]

Sirius swayed her body, speaking to the silent Priscilla-sama.

The sound of that voice seemed as if it permeated one’s heart. That attitude seemed as if it was from someone truly close. That manner seemed tender as if it dissolved the guards of others. The content of those words seemed as if it enticed others.

Clearly as if a sweet poison that melted slowly, even my extremities felt numb.

Sirius: [Could you allow me to help you reach understanding with others? Truly your love is so deep, and loving of the world. Looking forward to be loved. Wanting it. I can understand this. And I hope that others can come to understand this. So that you are kept from spending a lonely night on your lonesome.]

Priscilla: [Truly a shame to rely only on delusion and conjecture and prattle on without embarrassment. If you hold no doubts in your own words, you are precisely what is known as a lunatic.]

Sirius: [Oh my, thank you very much. That is a title commensurate with my husband’s. Those are the delusional words of someone to be reprimanded, who cannot comprehend in the slightest how outstanding that person is, and spits wild words of admiration, envy, jealousy towards that person.]

Priscilla: [Cease speaking. What belongs to me belongs to me alone. Your narrative is the sole delusional, nonsensical thing here. Even the surface of my enigma cannot be skimmed by those alike you.]

Priscilla-sama, with self-assurance, rejected that sweet, enticing proposal beyond doubt. However, in terms of self-assurance, Sirius did not lose to her. The freak’s head tilted as if having expected Priscilla-sama’s rejection,

Sirius: [To say that even the surface cannot be skimmed, this is the epitome of stubbornness… is it not? In that case, how does such a significance sound? “Iris and the King of Thorns”.]

Priscilla: [————]

Sirius: [Or perhaps, “The Rose Knight of Tieros”? “Magrizza’s Guillotine”.] [1]

I didn’t understand the significance of Sirius’s words, nor the intent behind the monster saying such words.

However, it prompted an immediate effect.

Priscilla: [——Better off dead.]

As I thought I’d heard a low murmur, Priscilla-sama’s figure vanished from sight.

As I expressed my confusion, the distance that had once existed between Priscilla-sama and Sirius became zero. Priscilla-sama swung the Yang Sword from above, arc mercilessly tracing towards Sirius’s neck. In an instant, the world slowed to an incredulous extent, and even I was able to see the path that Priscilla-sama’s blade followed.

Just aiming it, Sirius’s slender neck would be caressed and severed.

If that were to happen, my neck, and the necks of everyone nearby would break in the same way.

Could it be, that it was because I understood this, that it seemed to happen so slowly? Say, if a life-threatening danger were to approach, humans would, with great focus, see their perception of the world slowed down, right?

Although if that were the case, in a situation where the celestial scales of my own life were being tilted by others, what could I and the many people around me do about it?

The crimson radiance of the Yang Sword, with imposing manner, sliced through the atmosphere——

Liliana: [——Eh?]

Being unable to understand the sight before me, I couldn’t help but let out the voice of a dazed fool.

Having made that noise, my neck was still firmly anchored upon this small body. That was a matter of course. My neck had not been severed. Neither my own, nor Sirius’s.

In substitution, Priscilla-sama’s body, which should have leapt at Sirius, had been flung backward forcefully. Having been intercepted by Sirius’s metal chains head-on, she was hurled backward perilously.

Liliana: [Priscilla-sama!?]

I let out a cry towards that figure, which had obviously not leapt of its own will.

If Priscilla-sama were to be killed, the situation would become an irreparable wreck—— I could hardly even think of such a thing, crying out solely because a sense of disaster dawned. And yet, Priscilla-sama suddenly spun back, still in midair, halting her momentum by stabbing the Yang Sword into the cobblestones.

Priscilla: [Cease the racket, the true damage is yet to come.]

In reply to my wail, Priscilla-sama landed, the high-pitched sound of her footwear echoing. However, immediately after that, Priscilla-sama’s necklace changed. It had originally been a necklace with three green jewels, but one of those had just shattered.

Almost as if it had taken the attack in Priscilla-sama’s stead.

Priscilla: [The retaliation for my necklace shall have a rather tall cost.]

Sirius: [So that’s how it is. Is it that wounds you suffer are transferred onto what is valuable to you? That is truly a manner befitting Pride… Nono, that couldn’t be, that couldn’t possibly be.]

Priscilla: [Deliberately putting forth demeaning speculation is malicious to the extreme, audacity to this this extent cannot be redeemed with even ten thousand deaths. A scorching heat that burns and burns yet never dies out is most fitting for the manner of your death.]

Priscilla-sama’s rage was directed at Sirius, whose attitude had not wavered in the slightest. Rather than to say that the Yang Sword in her hand had increased its radiance, perhaps it should be said that the heat was increasing? Priscilla-sama’s regal attire, to me, appeared as if it swayed under the scorching rays of sunlight.

Though gazing at that, there truly was no way to think that Priscilla-sama was at a disadvantage… but there also was that incomprehensible happening from just now.

Sirius had taunted Priscilla-sama with words I couldn’t understand. Priscilla-sama had seemed to rush forward as if falling for that provocation, and she had been intercepted because of such predictable movement―― But that was not the case.

Rather, in my amateur opinion, in my eyes Priscilla-sama’s movements had appeared to be fast to the point of disappearing from sight, but perhaps to Sirius this was not the case. Although this possibility couldn’t be denied, that couldn’t have been.

Because when the Yang Sword lashed out, Priscilla-sama’s movements were stopped.

Appearing as if suspended, although such words did convey the general idea, what had happened was on a level different to that, more precisely, it was as if it had been completely frozen.

I didn’t think that it was Priscilla-sama’s intention to freeze in such an unnatural position, nor that it was something humans could consciously do. In that case, that stoppage should have been connected to some kind of incomprehensible ability, but what could it have been?

Sirius: [Please do not rage like that. Although you appear to be constantly raising your temper over something, such a thing will bring exhaustion and will only parch the soul? Something like Wrath is the tomb of the feeling that should be most shunned in this world. People’s hearts are full of emotion… And so, they should be always filled by ecstasy and joy.]

Liliana: [W-well, even if you think that, the people outside don’t look very happy, d-d-do they?]

Sirius: [Hmm?]

Huh!? Just now, could it have been a voice that had been audible!?

That freak Sirius looked directly at me, her eyes visible from a gap in the bandages coiling tightly around her body. Uhyiii, what a disaster, have I <u> kanchou ‘d</u> myself!? [2]

Sirius: [Indeed, within the hearts of everyone outside, unease and lament reigns. Although this too is something tragic, this is merely the result of human hearts overflowing with tenderness and compassion.]

Liliana: [Wha-what are you saying?]

Sirius: [Once under the influence of my Authority, people become capable of opening their hearts and resonate with one another. And so, feelings that cannot be put into words can come to light. To be human is to be able to empathize, a precious existence from which feelings can come to be. If the hearts of others are cherished, once sorrow is witnessed, in one’s own heart sorrow will also bloom. And a new sorrow will also sprout in the hearts of those who witness that sorrow. As the cycle repeats, those drops of sorrow will become a pond, become a lake, become a river.]

This person spoke such an outrageous thing.

In other words, the more people gathered, the worse it would get, because, with this person around, their emotions would be amplified to the extreme. Such a mechanism could rile up and spread suffering to everyone in the city… And it didn’t just stop at creating unrest.

This person had referred to it as a connection of the heart.

Priscilla: [If this seems a tragedy, then, by all means, take the lead in saving everyone. Choosing not to do so and only voicing laments is but an irritating noise for the commoners.]

Sirius: [Mhm, I can understand those words. I’m merely being overwhelmed by a one-sided attack by my own helplessness. However, I possess a means to save all those enveloped by sorrow!]

Sirius clapped her palms together, her demeanor like she had just had a wonderful idea.

Although it was doubtful that the freak’s notion of a good idea could make the situation take a turn for the better, neither I nor Priscilla-sama spoke up. Although I didn’t know about Priscilla-sama, rage boiled in my heart.

A feeling that could not be described with words was surging within my chest, was igniting.

Sirius: [A means to offer salvation to all those enveloped in sorrow… is to use delight, use joy to sweep away that sorrow. Which is to say that I, who is to be a conduit for such salvation, must find happiness!]

Priscilla: [————]

Sirius: [My, my, my. Within this city is the husband from whom I have been separated for quite some time. Confirming my love with my husband, with that person, having it returned. A happily married couple is the emblem of happiness. If my heart is filled to the brim with such joy, all those crying out in lament will be saved. By mutually enjoying happiness, the hearts of everyone will be saved——]

Sirius spoke her discourse, Priscilla-sama wore a completely disinterested expression, and I, who flickered glances at both, was thinking of many things.

I knew that this was the one time I couldn’t escape reality by pretending not to understand. Or rather, it could be said that now I understood. Thoroughly and completely, I understood the fact that this freak, Sirius Romanée-Conti, was our enemy.

Liliana: [————]

I raised my head and gazed across the surrounding waterways engulfed in flame. On the other side of the white-tinted wall of flame were the figures of people who stood in place, lacking a means to cross the waterway. They had all fallen under the charm of unwanted feelings, having lost their self-awareness.

I could hear the sound of their corpse-like voices.

Much thanks to my peculiar ears; as a bard, I was proud of my voice and hearing. To me, those voices seem to echo endlessly.

——So terrifying, so sad, save me, how painful, how, why, so unpleasant.

I could hear those kinds of voices, of resentment swept up as if in a vortex, of wails drawn out as if for eternity.

Was this the result of that so-called empathy, then? Was this the result of that so-called becoming one, then? That so called unity, was it something like this?

Liliana: [I have, to free…]

――Becoming one, and being the same as everything else, had to differ.

Men, women, adults, children, infants, elders, humans, demi-humans, were all clearly different.

To condense all that together, to blend it all up, and to say “like this, everyone will understand each other and become one”—— such words were certainly nothing to joke about.

Nothing to joke about!

Priscilla: [There is no necessity for your happiness. Shut that pettily clever talking hole of yours while still able, and die on your lonesome.]

Sirius: [I don’t like that. Do not insist on using the loneliness of disconnect to comfort yourself. If you are one who cannot recognize the form of happiness, taking a look at my happiness and giving it a chance is not so bad, is it? Or perhaps, if you understand the joy of connecting with the one you love, then you have come to understand the joy of being a bride!]

Priscilla: [Unfortunately, I have already walked the aisle seven times. And on each of those, there was nothing approaching something like happiness. Apply not your paltry standards to me, for they are nauseating.]

Sirius: [Seven times… ehh…]

Priscilla-sama treated Sirius’s words as a jest, and brought the Yang Sword down from above. However, Sirius also commenced her own ferocious attack of steel chains. Sparks ignited and scattered, the burnt chains flew away, and the clash caused the figures of the two to be pushed away from the center of the courtyard.

Having been burnt off, that chain. Burning white, that inextinguishable flame. In a state of being unable to give voice, those people wailing in agony.

Within me, slowly it came together. Could it be accomplished?

If the situation that had been imagined was indeed reality, was indeed correct, in that case, it shouldn’t be unachievable.

Sirius: [Even though I have clearly expended so much time on this, all for the sake of reaching the heart of that one person… You have had seven chances, and wasted all of them.]

Priscilla: [Do not pin the blame for your own lack of allure on me. That is the reason as to why that pitiful man who has been imprinted on you refuses to even meet you——]

Sirius: [I and that person are intimately connected, and thus are deeply in love with one another——!!]

Suddenly, a voice of fury lashed out, one that inspired a jolt of terror.

Immediately after, bisecting the courtyard was a snake of flame which burned red! In the instant, Priscilla-sama blocked the chains that originated from Sirius’s arms, and from there the flames followed the chains, the surging flame swallowing Priscilla-sama’s body.

The snake of flame reared open its maw, consuming Priscilla-sama’s slim body headfirst. Without a means to counter that fiery tactic, Priscilla-sama was swallowed and tossed outside of the courtyard now soaked by flame. Just as she was about to plummet, she suddenly stabilized herself with dignity using her sword. And yet, after being submerged in such flames Priscilla-sama’s body remained completely unhurt.

But with a sound, a jewel from the necklace once again shattered. The two clasps of the necklace came undone simultaneously, landing on the ground with a resounding noise.

Sirius: [Me and that person share a deep love! That just and sincere person just cannot help that he has yet to finish what he began! Misconstruing that person’s sincerity as pure love is just too obscene! Ahhhh! AHHHHHHH! How irritating!]

Priscilla-sama had once again survived at the cost of the necklace, but Sirius’s demeanor towards her had entirely changed. The freak opened her mouth as if baring fangs, spitting ugly words as she violently expressed her temper. And her arms had swept up a vortex of crimson flame.

Sirius: [Why is it that you so inconsiderately shake my heart to this degree!? These violent emotions that shake my heart, Wrath, or in other words, passion! This quaking will give way to heat, burning away the accursed sinners! Is this what you want for yourself as well, you pretentious lonely wench, AHHHHHHHH!]

Priscilla: [With that mouth, with those eyes, such babble… Hk.]

A vortex of flame appeared over Sirius’s head as she raised her arms, immolating herself in that detestable Wrath. What had struck just now were a pair of slim twin snakes which emerged from her arms. And as those arms crossed, their forms merged into one singular powerful snake.

The arm struck vertically downward, and the enormous snake of flame rushed at Priscilla-sama. Rather than evade it, Priscilla-sama took a stance of meeting the attack.

The Yang Sword was swung from below to above, its tip lodging in the head of the giant snake. With a sound that was not of chain meeting sword, the flaming snake’s aim was strayed greatly!

However, Priscilla-sama was sent flying by the impact, making it impossible to follow up!

After Sirius summoned the snake in a fit of fury, the positions of offense and defense had suddenly reversed. Priscilla-sama had been forced on the defensive, and the metal chains and flames chased her retreating figure.

Why was that? Although it was clear at a glance that Sirius’s abilities couldn’t be underestimated, considering the earlier stages of the fight, I didn’t think that Priscilla-sama was inferior. Earlier in the day, she had said that the Yang Sword had poor consumption, but was that what was pressing her like this?

Or could it be, that, perhaps, merely as speculation. That Priscilla-sama was unable to attack——

Liliana: [Is it me!?]

A quick end, not just for me, but for everyone in the vicinity as well. In order to avoid such a result, was this a battle for buying time!? Wait, no, hang on, how could it be, that the arrogant Priscilla-sama, who thought the highest of only herself, would do something like that!?

Priscilla: [ You are to prepare your song—— Should a shadow fall across the Yang Sword, I shall, no matter what, sever that abomination’s head. And so, before that happens. ]

At that time, something had shook my brain!

Right before the battle had started in earnest, Priscilla-sama had told me.

Before the Yang Sword met its limit, I was to prepare a song. And she had added that if that time were to approach, Sirius’s head would be mercilessly severed, and everyone else along with her.

But that meant that I shouldn’t wait around for the right moment, it had a much deeper meaning than I had thought initially, right?

If so, Priscilla-sama was waiting. Waiting for me to prepare a song.

At the very least, for the time that I took responsibility for those words.

Liliana: [Guhh, guhhhhh! Mmmm! Mmmmmmm!]

How bothersome! That person, so damn bothersome! If there are feelings, just confess to the feelings already! That person absolutely has feelings for me. No, I had been told I was liked, so it had definitely been said before. Ahhh, what a pain, screw this, this was terrifying, was there no other way——!

Liliana: [Priscilla-sama——!]

If the situation was as I suspected, then as she was fighting at a bothersome disadvantage, she must have understood what I was thinking right now. I pointed toward the stone tower that had been ignited by Sirius’s flames.

Priscilla-sama turned her head at the sound of my voice, looked to the place I was pointing towards——

Priscilla: [——Hoh.]

With terrifying expression and terrifying gaze, but despite such a terrifying visage inspiring a feeling of reliability, she smiled.

An expression so wicked which made it difficult to figure out just who the Sin Archbishop was here!

Sirius: [Stop looking away——!!]

Priscilla: [With the likes of you as an opponent, looking away is no distraction. Do not lecture me on my actions.]

Priscilla-sama leapt back, while at the same time parrying an approaching chain with the midsection of her sword. Her body gathered momentum, moving with speed beyond that which one motion would allow, and landed by the burning tower. Priscilla-sama gazed up at the burning tower, and, directing the tip of the Yang Sword at its base, she stabbed.

Priscilla: [Such an unsightly flame. Truly beautiful light shines like this.]

Differences in aesthetic between the lights of flame and such, were incomprehensible to an ordinary person like me.

Although incomprehensible, even a layman’s eye could clearly make out that a decidedly different sort of flame now surrounded the control tower!

The rising, white-tinged flames that now shimmered there were of the same type that surrounded the waterways.

Even though the snakes of flame originating from Sirius’s chains also burned crimson and scorched with bright and staggering heat, the flames emitted from the Yang Sword held a sort of sanctity that gave the impression of being untouchable.

Priscilla: [The stage is prepared—— Ensure that you perform your utmost.]

Liliana: [Right, right! Understood!]

After smothering the flames of the control tower with another layer of flame, Priscilla-sama spoke one sentence. I replied with fervent confidence, rushing over to the control tower.

While watching the situation with an air of being set off by anything that happened, Sirius flickered her gaze towards this scene and extended both her hands in our direction!

Sirius: [What are you doing to the flame I lit as an emblem of my love for that person!?]

Liliana: [I think it’s best you don’t speak of outlandish ridiculous things such as setting an entire building on fire to flirt!]

I said it, I said it, I said it! Wa~hh haha!

Rushing towards my back as I spoke while running, I felt that Sirius freak’s chain coming after me in one smooth motion! Burning chains! A heat wave, heat wave!

I knew that before the flame burned me, my head could be sent flying the very instant I was attacked, but heedless of what was behind me, I ran! And the reason was――!

Priscilla: [This is a situation where I shan’t hold back until whatever that one comes up with is witnessed.]

Liliana: [Chiiiiiii!]

Taking the place of my fleeing self, Priscilla-sama landed where the chain would strike. The Yang Sword sliced downward, deflecting the licking tongue of flame!

Hearing the intermittent sounds of Priscilla-sama and that freak clashing anew, I finally reached at my destination, the burning stone tower.

Liliana: [Haaa, haaaaa…]

Although the distance covered hadn’t been too long, drawing breath grew laborious, and my body felt fatigued! In all honesty, right now, nothing would feel better than a drink of ice-cold water before collapsing on a bed. This was something not meant for a travelling bard, but after spending so long in greenhouse-like surroundings, anything but a soft bed wouldn’t work!

Liliana: [Ahh, really… isn’t this all Kiritaka-san and everyone else’s fault——]

Allowing me to reside in this city, showing me warm hospitality. Whether the Scales of the White Dragon or the citizens of the city, everyone had expressed their love, and the likes of Kiritaka-san with such enthusiasm that even I was taken aback, it was all their fault! Their fault for having me remain in this city, so that my ability to keep on the path of a travelling bard had been weakened!

Well then, just a bit of extra effort here—— recall the ruthless determination of your waist and legs from before!!

Liliana: [Ihhhh, ihhhhhhh!]

Myself prepared, teeth clenched, I held my steady Lyulyre in my arms, and rushed toward the blazing tower! So hot, so hot, so hot, so damn hot——!

Liliana: [——Guh, giiiiii!]

Anticipation of the scorching pain sent a sharp jolt through me.

However, although I felt an overwhelming heat wave, neither my skin, nor my hair, nor the Lyulyre, had been burnt by the scorching flame. The heat of the flame could be clearly felt, but nothing had caught on fire.

Much alike the white flames that were rising in the waterways, there was painful heat, but no burning. And because of that, I recognized this flame as the Yang Sword’s bluff.

However, it was different. Different indeed.

The Yang Sword wielded by Priscilla-sama had indeed burnt through the metal chains upon collision. Even though it was clearly the same sword, sometimes it burned through, sometimes it didn’t.

Priscilla-sama’s flame could choose what to burn. Which meant, that it could also choose what not to burn.

Liliana: [Ohhhh——!]

So that was why! The white flame enveloping this control tower definitely wouldn’t burn me!

Even though it was hot enough to burn me, agonizing enough to seem fatal, painful enough to make whoever experienced it want to collapse and roll on the ground, it would not burn, it would not injure, it would not be deadly!

Eyeballs melting, tongue withering, hair alight, skin simmering, Lyulyre scorched, bones cracking, flesh burnt, consciousness eroding to nothing, was all an illusion——!

Not hot, so hot, so hot, so hot, not hot, not hot, so hot, craving death, not wanting to die, so hot, not hot, hothothot, even though it was so hooooot——!

Sprinting up the stairs of the control tower, first floor, second floor, just how many floors were there!? Where was the roof!? How far did the fire reach, where had the hands of the fire reached towards, looking left and right yielded only the sight of white fire, sohotsohot, how could such agony be, so hot, heat beyond heat, I——

Liliana: [——!]

Right now, I wanted to wail about the intensity of the heat, wanted to shriek until my throat burst.

Absolutely not. If this agony were given voice to, it would ruin my throat in one cry. This throat could absolutely not be spent. These fingers as well. I wanted to scratch, wanted to express the suffering no matter how. But no, absolutely not, if these fingers were damaged, they could not strum a melody.

Whether eyes, or skin, or hair, would be okay; it couldn’t be helped if they melted. But this throat, these fingers, and these ears as well, were not okay, because they were all indispensable for what would come next.

Forcefully ascending the steps, slamming open the incredibly heavy door with a kick, appearing now before me was the night sky—— the wind howling in frenzy, heat continuing to flow from beneath my feet, but there were no more walls. I wobbled along the cobblestone to the edge, where I could look at below.

The wind was blowing, and underneath, a red figure and a white figure were waving dangerous objects, amidst white flames surrounded by a wailing crowd.

I was so hot, so hot, I felt as if I would die at any instant.

Right now, I wasn’t completely free from that heat yet, the soles of my feet were still burning, the white flames seemed to intensify when the wind blew, sorrow suddenly rose in my heart, and I wanted to squirm——

Liliana: [Eek, eeep… Alright, this is a once-in-a-lifetime stage!]

Reaching the place I had dashed for, through heat and agony that inspired a craving for death, from here, everything was visible, and could reach everywhere with sound.

I was dying to die, but before I died, there was still something left to do, and so――

Liliana: [Come, come, gather around, everyone far away, make sure you listen! Everyone close by, make sure you watch the dance! For everyone even farther away, I’ll be even louder, so just listen!! Liliana Masquerade, is here to sing and dance and perform for you! So listen well! ——The Sky Overtaking the Morning Glow!!]

——Just gather all those passionate feelings, and spit them all out at once!

--- Chapter 67: Liliana Masquerade ---
